A12_034.text: I am Ilyra Sen. Voice of the Concord. Keeper of the first seal. I was asked to sing the world asleep. I'm going to sing it awake instead.

A12_035.speaker: NOVA
A12_035.text: First seal restored. I am reading the lock on the far side of the planet shifting by a fraction of a degree.

A12_036.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A12_036.text: Listen to me. The sixth was our promise. You were meant to open the lock when this world was ready to meet what lies beyond it.

A12_038.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A12_038.text: You opened it to save us. I've been angry with you for longer than this world has had a name. I don't think I am anymore.

A12_039.speaker: NYX
A12_039.text: I'm coming with you. Kael would never forgive me if I let you get her killed on the way out.

A13_002.speaker: SERAPHINE
A13_002.text: Dr. Seraphine Vale. I don't believe we've met.

A13_003.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A13_003.text: We have. You wore a veil then. And you sounded exactly as tired as you do now.

A13_005.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A13_005.text: Perhaps. I've been mistaken about a great many things. Never about a voice.

A13_007.speaker: SERAPHINE
A13_007.text: There's nothing to talk about. I have a doctorate, a dead research division, and the same nightmares as everyone else.

A13_008.speaker: NOVA
A13_008.text: Seraphine's genetic profile does not match any civilian database. I assumed it was classified.

A13_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A13_009.text: It was. By me. Can we please find the people who are actually trying to kill us?

A13_010.speaker: NOVA
A13_010.text: Rainer's key opens a door that does not appear on any Frontier Defense map. Lab Three. Under the harbor.

A13_011.speaker: VOSS
A13_011.text: I ran security on Genesis for a year. There was no Lab Three.

A13_013.speaker: NOVA
A13_013.text: Door open. Lights are on. Somebody has been working here this week.

A13_014.speaker: NOVA
A13_014.text: Armed personnel. Continuum markings. They are not cloaked.

A13_015.speaker: VOSS
A13_015.text: Then they're not here to hide. They're here to kill.

A13_017.speaker: NOVA
A13_017.text: Because they were. Their records list them as dead in Frontier Defense operations over the last decade.

A13_018.speaker: VOSS
A13_018.text: ...I knew two of these men. I went to their funerals.

A13_019.speaker: NOVA
A13_019.text: Their database is open. They did not expect anyone to reach it.

A13_020.speaker: NOVA
A13_020.text: Observers monitor Fracture activity. Executors eliminate threats. Collectors retrieve artifacts. Researchers experiment. And above them all, the Inner Circle.

A13_022.speaker: NOVA
A13_022.text: The records call him only the Architect.

A13_023.speaker: DR. CROSS
A13_023.text: Log entry. Day 412. The vessel performed beyond projection. The Architect is pleased, though he would never say so.

A13_024.speaker: VOSS
A13_024.text: Day 412? Cross died on Day 184. I read the report.

A13_025.speaker: NOVA
A13_025.text: The report was written by Continuum Observers.

A13_026.speaker: SERAPHINE
A13_026.text: They let the lab fall on purpose. To see what would come through.

A13_027.speaker: PLAYER
A13_027.text: To see what I would do.

A13_028.speaker: DR. CROSS
A13_028.text: The sixth is not a weapon. The sixth is a variable. We cannot predict it. That is precisely why the Architect wants it near.

A13_029.speaker: NOVA
A13_029.text: Something has been released from the test chamber.

A13_031.speaker: NOVA
A13_031.text: Continuum armour. Fracture-grown body. It was built here, from someone.

A13_032.speaker: NOVA
A13_032.text: It is down. Its last transmission went to an address I can't trace.

A13_033.speaker: VOSS
A13_033.text: So they know we were here.

A13_034.speaker: PLAYER
A13_034.text: Good. I want them to know.

A13_035.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A13_035.text: Every screen. Forgive the theatre. It's the only way your machine lets me speak.

A13_037.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A13_037.text: A title I chose because nobody alive remembers the name I was born with. Not even me, most days.

A13_039.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A13_039.text: I let a great many things fall. Cities. Continents. Whole worlds, once or twice. I am trying to keep the one thing that matters from falling with them.

A13_041.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A13_041.text: Continuity. A world that goes on. Yours has broken eleven times. I have rebuilt it eleven times.

A13_045.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A13_045.text: My predictions end before your story does, sixth. Nothing else in creation does that. You should find that frightening. I certainly do.

A14_001.speaker: NOVA
A14_001.text: Second coordinate. Solmara Desert. Surface temperature forty-seven degrees.

A14_002.speaker: GOLIATH
A14_002.text: And climbing. Commander Voss sends his regards. And me.

A14_004.speaker: GOLIATH
A14_004.text: I'm what Frontier Defense sends when it doesn't trust the desert. Or you. Mostly the desert.

A14_006.speaker: GOLIATH
A14_006.text: Kael always describes me sitting down.

A14_007.speaker: NOVA
A14_007.text: The Ascendancy has three salvage teams digging near the old colonnade. They arrived yesterday.

A14_008.speaker: GOLIATH
A14_008.text: Crane's people. Always first to the shovel.

A14_009.speaker: NOVA
A14_009.text: Sandstorm forming to the south. We have about twelve minutes.

A14_010.speaker: GOLIATH
A14_010.text: Then don't stop for anything. Including me.

A14_011.speaker: GOLIATH
A14_011.text: Dunegate. Last town before the deep desert. They've survived three Fracture storms on salt and stubbornness.

A14_013.speaker: NOVA
A14_013.text: There is a story repeating in the market. A map that redraws itself.

A14_015.speaker: NOVA
A14_015.text: Nobody can. Everyone who tries says the map was sold the day before.

A14_016.speaker: TRADER
A14_016.text: The glass map? Sold yesterday. It's always sold yesterday.

A14_018.speaker: TRADER
A14_018.text: To an old man who walks out of the dunes every spring with sand on his eyelids. He pays in drawings.

A14_019.speaker: TRADER
A14_019.text: Last spring he drew me a road that didn't exist. A week later the Fracture made it. Saved my caravan.

A14_021.speaker: TRADER
A14_021.text: Down. Under the colonnade. Where the Ascendancy are digging now. If you find him, tell him he owes me a map.

A14_022.speaker: GOLIATH
A14_022.text: Shielded diggers. Crane spared no expense.

A14_023.speaker: PLAYER
A14_023.text: We're not here to kill them.

A14_025.speaker: CRANE
A14_025.text: Operator. Again. Do you follow me, or do I follow you? It's getting hard to tell.

A14_027.speaker: CRANE
A14_027.text: Gladly. We found nothing. The entrance only opens for someone it recognises. I suspect that's you.

A14_028.speaker: NOVA
A14_028.text: The door is reacting to your signature. And to Seraphine's map coordinates. Both.

A14_032.speaker: NOVA
A14_032.text: A sheet of glass. Four metres across. It is drawing.

A14_034.speaker: NOVA
A14_034.text: Us. Our positions. It drew your next step before you took it.

A14_036.speaker: NOVA
A14_036.text: There are other marks. Five. One in Eldergrove, glowing. One here, flickering. One beneath the sea near Verdant Forest. One in the far north. And one... outside the edge of the glass.

A14_037.speaker: GOLIATH
A14_037.text: How can a map have something outside its edge?

A14_038.speaker: NOVA
A14_038.text: I don't know. The glass is still drawing it.

A15_001.speaker: CIPHER
A15_001.text: Don't touch it with your hands. It remembers fingerprints. And it judges them.

A15_003.speaker: CIPHER
A15_003.text: Cipher. Until last week, chief cartographic researcher for the Ascendancy. Until last week, Crane's favourite.

A15_005.speaker: CIPHER
A15_005.text: I read what Crane does with the people in his cells. I left. With his best equipment.

A15_007.speaker: CIPHER
A15_007.text: I'm an ex-employee with severance. The map has been drawing my face for three days. I assumed it wanted to meet me.

A15_008.speaker: NOVA
A15_008.text: I detect the same neural resonance in Cipher that I found in the tower's cells. Weaker.

A15_009.speaker: CIPHER
A15_009.text: Yes. I was one of the volunteers. Don't look at me like that. It's how I can read this thing.

A15_010.speaker: CIPHER
A15_010.text: The map needs power to show more than us. The array can give it a sunrise's worth in a minute.

A15_012.speaker: CIPHER
A15_012.text: Then we'll have a very bright minute.

A15_013.speaker: CIPHER
A15_013.text: There. Do you see? Every line it draws bends toward one point. Not a place. A person.

A15_016.speaker: NOVA
A15_016.text: A figure is walking out of the dunes. The map drew him an hour ago.

A15_017.speaker: NOVA
A15_017.text: A Fracture storm. It's following the walking figure.

A15_018.speaker: GOLIATH
A15_018.text: Everybody behind me. I'm the widest thing here.

A15_019.speaker: NOVA
A15_019.text: The storm has passed through him. He is unharmed.

A15_021.speaker: NOVA
A15_021.text: He has stopped beneath the bones of something very large.

A15_023.speaker: CIPHER
A15_023.text: Nobody knows. It was here before the desert.

A15_024.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_024.text: You're late. The map said noon.

A15_025.speaker: PLAYER
A15_025.text: We got held up by a storm.

A15_026.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_026.text: The map said that too. I drew you this morning. You looked taller.

A15_027.speaker: NOVA
A15_027.text: Biometric match. Auren Thale. The Cartographer. Second keeper.

A15_028.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_028.text: Thale. Hm. That's what the first map was signed with. I always thought it was the name of a road.

A15_029.speaker: PLAYER
A15_029.text: Do you know who you are?

A15_030.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_030.text: I know where I am. That's usually more useful.

A15_031.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_031.text: I mapped every road out of the end of the world, young one. Every one of them goes through you.

A15_032.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_032.text: Forty years I've walked this desert. Drawing roads that don't exist yet. They always arrive.

A15_033.speaker: CIPHER
A15_033.text: You're not predicting the future. You're surveying it.

A15_034.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_034.text: Clever. The Ascendancy taught you well, before you robbed them.

A15_035.speaker: PLAYER
A15_035.text: The Continuum says I ended this world nine times.

A15_036.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_036.text: Then they've been reading the wrong map. I've seen your roads. Nine of them end. Two don't. The two that don't, nobody can see past.

A15_037.speaker: NOVA
A15_037.text: The Architect said the same thing. His predictions end before the operator's story does.

A15_038.speaker: AUREN THALE
A15_038.text: Of course they do. He maps with walls. I map with roads. You can't wall in a road you haven't walked yet.

A16_001.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_001.text: Before we go further, you should see these. The road to the seal passes the old roost.

A16_002.speaker: NOVA
A16_002.text: Murals. Astryan-era pigment. Dragons... standing beside people.

A16_003.speaker: CIPHER
A16_003.text: Allies. Not mounts. Look at the eyes. They're drawn as equals.

A16_004.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_004.text: The dragons kept a covenant of their own. Older than ours, in some ways. The Ashen line still remembers it.

A16_006.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_006.text: We should be polite. The roost is not our business today. Its keeper settles its own debts, with whoever it chooses.

A16_007.speaker: NOVA
A16_007.text: One figure is painted apart from the others. Watching. The pigment around it has been scraped away and repainted many times.

A16_008.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_008.text: The Witness. Even the dragons couldn't decide whether to remember it.

A16_009.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_009.text: Step where I step. The ground here is in two minds about being ground.

A16_011.speaker: NOVA
A16_011.text: Null Choir constructs. They suppress sound. I can barely hear you.

A16_013.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_013.text: Choir. They come when a keeper starts remembering. Like moths to a lamp.

A16_016.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_016.text: Sit. I want to tell you something before the seal wakes up and I start being somebody important.

A16_018.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_018.text: A long time ago, you asked me to map a world where you didn't have to choose. Where the gate could stay closed and nobody had to suffer behind it.

A16_020.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_020.text: I tried. For a hundred years. I never finished it. Every map I drew, there was one road where you had to open the gate. Every map.

A16_021.speaker: PLAYER
A16_021.text: So I was always going to do it.

A16_022.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_022.text: No. You were always going to have to decide. That's not the same, and the difference is the only thing I've ever been sure of.

A16_023.speaker: CIPHER
A16_023.text: The map is moving again. Something big is heading toward Dunegate.

A16_024.speaker: NOVA
A16_024.text: I recognise the signature. The Harbinger.

A16_025.speaker: GOLIATH
A16_025.text: The thing from Haven-01? The one you didn't finish?

A16_027.speaker: AUREN THALE
A16_027.text: It's coming for me. The Severant can't stand a keeper who knows where they're going.

A16_028.speaker: NYX
A16_028.text: Then we get to Dunegate first.

A17_001.speaker: TRADER
A17_001.text: You brought a war to my market.

A17_002.speaker: PLAYER
A17_002.text: It was coming anyway. We brought help.

A17_003.speaker: GOLIATH
A17_003.text: Everybody who can carry a rifle, on the walls. Everybody who can't, in the salt cellars.

A17_004.speaker: AUREN THALE
A17_004.text: The map shows them coming from three directions. Then four. Then it stops drawing.

A17_006.speaker: AUREN THALE
A17_006.text: Because after that, it depends on us.

A17_008.speaker: GOLIATH
A17_008.text: Make them pay for every metre of sand!

A17_009.speaker: NOVA
A17_009.text: The attack is pulling back. Something is clearing a path for itself.

A17_010.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A17_010.text: Sixth. You built another fortress on stolen ground.

A17_011.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A17_011.text: We met at Haven. You remember me now?

A17_013.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A17_013.text: I was told to wait. The five had to wake before the sixth remembered. Two are awake. That is enough.

A17_014.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A17_014.text: It does not matter. I was only ever the voice before the voice.

A17_016.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A17_016.text: I was a herald once. For the keepers. For you. Before you broke what we served.

A17_018.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A17_018.text: You did not fail, old friend. You counted them for me. Two awake. Three asleep. The sixth beginning to remember.

A17_020.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A17_020.text: Rest. I will finish this kindly.

A17_021.speaker: NOVA
A17_021.text: The Harbinger's signal is gone. It was not killed. It was released.

A17_022.speaker: PLAYER
A17_022.text: He was a herald for the keepers. For me.

A17_023.speaker: AUREN THALE
A17_023.text: He was. His name was Ossian. He used to carry your letters.

A17_026.speaker: AUREN THALE
A17_026.text: Nothing. A cartographer only needs to know where he's standing.

A17_027.speaker: AUREN THALE
A17_027.text: I am Auren Thale. First Cartographer. Keeper of the second seal. I have mapped the end of the world. I'm going to need a bigger map.

A17_028.speaker: NOVA
A17_028.text: Second seal restored. The glass map has stopped drawing us. It is drawing a route to the sea.

A17_029.speaker: AUREN THALE
A17_029.text: The third keeper doesn't have a body anymore. Only a voice, underwater, saying the same thing over and over.

A17_031.speaker: AUREN THALE
A17_031.text: Your name. The one you had before this one.

A17_032.speaker: NOVA
A17_032.text: Two seals restored. Three remain. Chapter of record closed.

A18_001.speaker: VOSS
A18_001.text: Her bunk hasn't been slept in. Her research is wiped. She took a transport at four in the morning and logged it as a supply run.

A18_003.speaker: NOVA
A18_003.text: Neon City. The transport was found empty at the harbour an hour ago.

A18_006.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A18_006.text: Not the city. Whatever she left there. People always go back for what they hid before they knew why they hid it.

A18_010.speaker: PLAYER
A18_010.text: No. But I'm going to find out before you do.

A18_011.speaker: NOVA
A18_011.text: Neon City. Population twelve million. Number of people who will help us for free: statistically, zero.

A18_013.speaker: VESPER
A18_013.text: The famous survivor. In my little room. Should I be flattered or should I be running?

A18_014.speaker: PLAYER
A18_014.text: I'm looking for a woman. Dark hair, lab coat, very tired.

A18_015.speaker: VESPER
A18_015.text: No. But I sold passage last night to a woman with silver hair and eyes like a bruise. Paid in old Genesis credit. Asked for the Vault Under the Grid.

A18_017.speaker: VESPER
A18_017.text: Like moonlight on a knife. You know her, then.

A18_018.speaker: NOVA
A18_018.text: Seraphine's hair was dyed. I noted the chemical traces months ago and assumed vanity.

A18_019.speaker: VESPER
A18_019.text: Everybody in this city is wearing something over something. Here's a free one. You're not the only ones asking. The men in the bending coats asked an hour before you.

A18_020.speaker: NOVA
A18_020.text: Executors. Six on the rooftops, three on the street.

A18_022.speaker: NOVA
A18_022.text: They are after what she is carrying.

A18_023.speaker: EXECUTOR
A18_023.text: ...the Sovereign is in the vault... seal it... nobody goes in, nobody comes out...

A18_025.speaker: NOVA
A18_025.text: They used that title for her. Turog used it too.

A18_026.speaker: NOVA
A18_026.text: The vault was sealed from inside. I can open it. Very quietly.

A18_028.speaker: SERAPHINE
A18_028.text: You weren't supposed to follow me.

A18_030.speaker: SERAPHINE
A18_030.text: Is the least interesting thing about me, I promise.

A18_032.speaker: SERAPHINE
A18_032.text: Someone who hid something here a very long time ago. Before this city had a name. Before it had neon.

A18_035.speaker: SERAPHINE
A18_035.text: There. A record. Encrypted against everyone alive, including me.

A18_036.speaker: NOVA
A18_036.text: The encryption predates any human system. It resembles the archive's.

A18_037.speaker: SERAPHINE
A18_037.text: Because I wrote it with the same hands that built the archive's locks. Or hands very like them.

A18_039.speaker: SERAPHINE
A18_039.text: The truth is that I'm not who I told you I was. I'm not entirely who I think I am. And the Continuum is about to come through that door.

A18_040.speaker: NOVA
A18_040.text: She is correct. Twelve signatures above us.

A18_041.speaker: SERAPHINE
A18_041.text: Get me out of here with this record and I'll tell you everything I know. It isn't much. It's more than anyone else will tell you.

A19_001.speaker: SERAPHINE
A19_001.text: I can open it. NOVA can read it. You keep them away from the door.

A19_002.speaker: NOVA
A19_002.text: Why do you need me to read it?

A19_003.speaker: SERAPHINE
A19_003.text: Because you'll tell the truth about what's on it. I'm not sure I will.

A19_004.speaker: NOVA
A19_004.text: Decryption at forty percent. The door will not hold to a hundred.

A19_005.speaker: EXECUTOR
A19_005.text: Sovereign! The Architect asks you to return what you took. He asks politely, this once.

A19_006.speaker: SERAPHINE
A19_006.text: Tell him he can ask me himself.

A19_008.speaker: NOVA
A19_008.text: Decryption complete. Seraphine... it is a list of worlds.

A19_009.speaker: NOVA
A19_009.text: Eleven entries. Each one a version of this world. Each one ends.

A19_010.speaker: NOVA
A19_010.text: World one: the gate opens early. The Choir crosses. Erasure. World two: the gate never opens. The lock starves the world. Collapse.

A19_011.speaker: NOVA
A19_011.text: World three through world eleven. In each, the sixth wakes. In each, the sixth remembers everything. In each, the world ends within a year.

A19_013.speaker: SERAPHINE
A19_013.text: Not you. Something that has your face and your signature and your stubbornness. I don't know if it's you.

A19_014.speaker: NOVA
A19_014.text: World seven has an annotation. In Seraphine's hand.

A19_016.speaker: NOVA
A19_016.text: "This time I stayed. This time we tried together. It ended anyway. I am so tired of losing them."

A19_018.speaker: SERAPHINE
A19_018.text: You. I don't remember writing it. I remember the feeling. That's all.

A19_019.speaker: SERAPHINE
A19_019.text: That's my warning, Operator. Every time you remember everything, the world ends. So please. Remember slowly.

A19_020.speaker: NOVA
A19_020.text: The Executors have the streets. The rooftops are open.

A19_022.speaker: PLAYER
A19_022.text: You hid a vault under a city. You can survive a rooftop.

A19_023.speaker: SERAPHINE
A19_023.text: Thank you. For coming after me.

A19_025.speaker: SERAPHINE
A19_025.text: I'd like to think so. I have eleven reasons to doubt it.

A20_001.speaker: NOVA
A20_001.text: The Executors carried Frontier Defense ammunition. Recent lots. Not stolen.

A20_004.speaker: VESPER
A20_004.text: Ah. The survivor and the stranger. Together. That's either romance or a heist.

A20_006.speaker: VESPER
A20_006.text: Nobody sells to them. They buy through a ledger. One book, every trade, every favour, every name. Kept in the Fracture Market, under guard.

A20_008.speaker: VESPER
A20_008.text: Everyone's. That's what makes it safe.

A20_009.speaker: NOVA
A20_009.text: Mercenaries. Ascendancy shields. Free Operator rifles. And Continuum armour. Everyone really is guarding it.

A20_010.speaker: SERAPHINE
A20_010.text: Then everyone has something to hide.

A20_011.speaker: NOVA
A20_011.text: The ledger is in a strongbox. It is protected by a lock I can open.

A20_015.speaker: NOVA
A20_015.text: Payments to Prefect Crane for Fracture samples. Payments to General Rainer, through Genesis. Payments to a Frontier Defense account labelled Continuity Reserve.

A20_019.speaker: PLAYER
A20_019.text: She told us she was holding the line.

A20_020.speaker: NOVA
A20_020.text: The Continuity Reserve funded the walls of Haven-01. The ammunition at the First Siege. The generators in the medical centre.

A20_021.speaker: SERAPHINE
A20_021.text: She held the line with their money.

A20_022.speaker: PLAYER
A20_022.text: And what did they buy with it?

A20_023.speaker: NOVA
A20_023.text: One entry. Repeated monthly. "Location of the sixth, when known."

A20_024.speaker: SERAPHINE
A20_024.text: What are you going to do?

A20_026.speaker: SERAPHINE
A20_026.text: And if you don't like the answer?

A21_001.speaker: WARD
A21_001.text: You found the ledger. Of course you did.

A21_003.speaker: WARD
A21_003.text: I sold a rumour. For walls, for ammunition, for eighteen thousand people who are alive tonight.

A21_004.speaker: PLAYER
A21_004.text: And when they asked where I was?

A21_005.speaker: WARD
A21_005.text: I lied to them. Every month. I told them the sixth was dead in the Eastern blocks.

A21_006.speaker: NOVA
A21_006.text: Her heart rate is steady. Her pupils are steady. She believes what she is saying.

A21_007.speaker: WARD
A21_007.text: I'm the Director of a dying army, Operator. I make the deals the dead can't make for themselves.

A21_008.speaker: VOSS
A21_008.text: Director. You should have told me.

A21_009.speaker: WARD
A21_009.text: If I'd told you, you'd have stopped me. And we'd all be dead and honest.

A21_010.speaker: NOVA
A21_010.text: The Continuum have stopped hiding. Executors across the Eastern blocks. They are looking for Seraphine.

A21_011.speaker: SERAPHINE
A21_011.text: They know I decrypted it. The Architect never lets the record leave his hands twice.

A21_013.speaker: NOVA
A21_013.text: They are falling back. Toward the harbour. With something heavy.

A21_014.speaker: VOSS
A21_014.text: They've got a transport and a tank of something glowing. I'm right behind you.

A21_015.speaker: EXECUTOR
A21_015.text: The Sovereign comes with us. The rest of you are a rounding error.

A21_017.speaker: NOVA
A21_017.text: It is down. A Fracture is opening on the pier. Someone is stepping through.

A21_020.speaker: OREN VASQ
A21_020.text: I'm here to make an offer, and then I'll leave. The Architect has always been generous with offers.

A21_021.speaker: OREN VASQ
A21_021.text: Give us Seraphine and the record. In return, the Continuum guarantees Haven-01. No Choir assault will reach it. No Executor will walk its streets. Ever.

A21_022.speaker: SERAPHINE
A21_022.text: He means it. That's the worst part. He always means it.

A21_023.speaker: OREN VASQ
A21_023.text: Think about it. Eighteen thousand lives against one woman who left you once already.

A21_025.speaker: OREN VASQ
A21_025.text: Oh. She hasn't told you that part yet. Ask her who held the door at the end of the first world. Tomorrow at dawn. I'll be listening.

A22_001.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_001.text: I wondered when you'd come up.

A22_003.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_003.text: All right. All of it. Such as it is.

A22_004.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_004.text: My first memory is a white room and a man with kind eyes telling me the world had ended and we were going to make sure it never ended again. I believed him. I built the Continuum with him.

A22_006.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_006.text: I was his Second, before Vasq. For longer than I can count. We watched worlds. We stopped the ones that were going wrong.

A22_008.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_008.text: We let them fall, and we rebuilt from what was left. It seemed merciful. Then I found the experiments. He let them fall on purpose. To learn how they fell. Whole civilisations as data.

A22_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_009.text: So I left. I stole the record of every world he'd ended. And I hid in the one place he'd never look. A life. A lab coat. A name.

A22_010.speaker: PLAYER
A22_010.text: And the door? Vasq said you held the door at the end of the first world.

A22_011.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_011.text: I don't remember the first world. My memory begins in that white room. Everything before it is a veil.

A22_013.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_013.text: Yes. I've thought of that too.

A22_014.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_014.text: Thank you. I don't know who I'll be when I remember. But thank you.

A22_015.speaker: NOVA
A22_015.text: I will be watching her, Operator.

A22_017.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_017.text: Go, then. Just don't believe anything he says that sounds like mercy.

A22_018.speaker: OREN VASQ
A22_018.text: Dawn. And you came. Is she with you?

A22_019.speaker: PLAYER
A22_019.text: No. And she never will be.

A22_020.speaker: OREN VASQ
A22_020.text: A pity. Then Haven is on its own.

A22_021.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_021.text: Haven was always on its own, Oren. That's what made it worth living in.

A22_023.speaker: SERAPHINE
A22_023.text: I came to tell you myself. Tell the Architect I remember the white room. Tell him I'm starting to remember what came before it.

A22_024.speaker: OREN VASQ
A22_024.text: He'll be so pleased. And so sorry.

A23_001.speaker: NOVA
A23_001.text: The record names a Continuum observatory in the Skyhaven isles. Its signature is hidden in the abbey.

A23_002.speaker: GOLIATH
A23_002.text: An observatory. In a monastery. On a floating rock.

A23_003.speaker: NYX
A23_003.text: You keep complaining about where things are.

A23_004.speaker: GOLIATH
A23_004.text: Things should be on the ground.

A23_005.speaker: SERAPHINE
A23_005.text: It's where he keeps the Continuity Engine. It predicts the endings. If we break it, he's blind.

A23_008.speaker: NOVA
A23_008.text: Observers and Executors together. They were expecting us.

A23_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A23_009.text: They always expect us. The trick is to be what they didn't expect.

A23_010.speaker: NOVA
A23_010.text: The Engine is running a simulation. Of us. Right now.

A23_011.speaker: PLAYER
A23_011.text: What does it say we do next?

A23_012.speaker: NOVA
A23_012.text: It says you are about to ask me that.

A23_013.speaker: NOVA
A23_013.text: I have its predictions. Every line ends at the same place. At you. After you, the Engine draws nothing.

A23_016.speaker: RAINER
A23_016.text: They brought me here after the terminal. Asked me about you every day. I told them you were an idiot. They wrote it down.

A23_018.speaker: RAINER
A23_018.text: I know. Listen. The Engine. It feeds the Architect his predictions. It runs on a core from the old world. Astryan. Break the core and you break more than a machine.

A23_020.speaker: RAINER
A23_020.text: His certainty. And there's something guarding it that isn't human.

A23_021.speaker: NOVA
A23_021.text: The guardian is wired into the Engine. It is predicting your attacks.

A23_023.speaker: NOVA
A23_023.text: That is, statistically, your greatest strength.

A23_024.speaker: NOVA
A23_024.text: The guardian is down. The Engine core is exposed. It is unstable.

A23_025.speaker: RAINER
A23_025.text: Get them out. I'll cut the core.

A23_027.speaker: RAINER
A23_027.text: I opened the doors that let all this in. Let me close one.

A24_001.speaker: RAINER
A24_001.text: Core's open. You should already be gone.

A24_003.speaker: RAINER
A24_003.text: If I leave it, it reboots. He'll have his eyes back in an hour. Go.

A24_005.speaker: RAINER
A24_005.text: Commander. Tell them Genesis was my fault. Not yours. Not Ward's. Mine.

A24_006.speaker: VOSS
A24_006.text: I'll tell them you finished it.

A24_008.speaker: NOVA
A24_008.text: The core is going critical. Rainer's signal is still holding it.

A24_010.speaker: NOVA
A24_010.text: The abbey is gone. Rainer's signal ended two seconds after the core did.

A24_011.speaker: VOSS
A24_011.text: He held it. He held it to the end.

A24_012.speaker: NOVA
A24_012.text: A presence. The same as the archive. It is not a projection this time.

A24_013.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A24_013.text: You blinded me. Well done. It has been a very long time since I didn't know what happens next.

A24_014.speaker: PLAYER
A24_014.text: Then come down here and find out.

A24_015.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A24_015.text: I am down here. I have always been down here. I was on the Continuity Council when the first world ended. I watched the Origin Engine turn. I swore that I would never let it end again.

A24_016.speaker: SERAPHINE
A24_016.text: And you ended eleven more to keep your oath.

A24_017.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A24_017.text: I ended eleven so that a twelfth could live. Hello, Seraphine. You've been reading my diary.

A24_018.speaker: SERAPHINE
A24_018.text: You were never kind. You were only careful.

A24_019.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A24_019.text: Sixth. I'll make you the offer I made her, a long time ago. Stand with me. Help me hold the world still. No more endings.

A24_021.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A24_021.text: Beginnings are where endings come from. Think on it. I'll ask again when the third keeper wakes.

A24_022.speaker: NOVA
A24_022.text: Operator. May I tell you something?

A24_024.speaker: NOVA
A24_024.text: When the Engine core broke, it spoke to me. In a language I have never been taught. I understood it.

A24_027.speaker: SERAPHINE
A24_027.text: Vigilance. That's an Astryan word. It's what they called their...

A24_030.speaker: NOVA
A24_030.text: I have a memory that is not mine. A city under water. A voice repeating a name.

A24_032.speaker: NOVA
A24_032.text: Yes. And I think the voice is repeating it to me.

A25_001.speaker: NOVA
A25_001.text: Depth three hundred metres. Hull integrity nominal. Your heart rate is not.

A25_002.speaker: PLAYER
A25_002.text: I don't like being under things.

A25_004.speaker: SERAPHINE
A25_004.text: Thalassia was built after the Fracture to preserve people. That's the story.

A25_006.speaker: SERAPHINE
A25_006.text: The truth is it was built around something. On purpose. By people who were told not to ask what.

A25_007.speaker: NOVA
A25_007.text: Docking. A delegation is waiting. They are armed, but politely.

A25_008.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A25_008.text: Surface people. We don't get many. We don't want many.

A25_010.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A25_010.text: ...Nobody up there is supposed to know about the voice.

A25_011.speaker: NOVA
A25_011.text: It has been transmitting on a frequency only I can hear for nine days. It is repeating a name.

A25_012.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A25_012.text: Nine days. That's when it got louder. It's been in the walls for eighty years. We keep the containment ring sealed and the city keeps breathing.

A25_014.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A25_014.text: My grandmother called it the Prisoner. The cult in the farms calls it God. I call it the reason my engineers don't sleep.

A25_015.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A25_015.text: The Abyssal Cult. They want the ring opened. They've been cutting into it from the farms.

A25_016.speaker: NOVA
A25_016.text: They are carrying Fracture-forged blades. Someone is supplying them.

A25_018.speaker: HIEROPHANT
A25_018.text: You cannot stop the tide, surface-child. The Prisoner calls you by name. It always has.

A25_019.speaker: NOVA
A25_019.text: The voice is strongest along the old transit line. If I listen at three relays I can find its source.

A25_021.speaker: NOVA
A25_021.text: And then I will know whether it is calling me, or calling through me.

A25_022.speaker: NOVA
A25_022.text: Source located. Inside the containment ring. Under the research district.

A25_023.speaker: THE ECHO
A25_023.text: ...Vigilance... you came back... you came back...

A25_024.speaker: NOVA
A25_024.text: I am not... I am NOVA.

A25_025.speaker: THE ECHO
A25_025.text: ...that is a name for a lamp... you were a lighthouse once...

A25_027.speaker: THE ECHO
A25_027.text: ...I had a name before names... I gave it away to hold the third seal... I have been holding it in the dark for a very long time...

A25_029.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A25_029.text: It's never answered anyone before. Never.

A25_030.speaker: NOVA
A25_030.text: Operator. I believe this is the third keeper.

A26_001.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A26_001.text: Eighty years we've kept that ring closed. You're asking me to open it for a stranger and a lamp.

A26_003.speaker: PLAYER
A26_003.text: It's dying in there, Oda. You can hear it.

A26_004.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A26_004.text: First door open. Pressure's holding. For now.

A26_005.speaker: NOVA
A26_005.text: Hull breach in the farms. The cult blew a seal the moment the ring opened.

A26_006.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A26_006.text: They were waiting for us to do it. Engineers! Bulkheads!

A26_007.speaker: GOLIATH
A26_007.text: Water I can fight. Water with teeth, less so.

A26_008.speaker: NOVA
A26_008.text: Something large is coming up through the breach.

A26_009.speaker: HIEROPHANT
A26_009.text: Behold what the Prisoner gave us! A guardian for the faithful!

A26_010.speaker: NOVA
A26_010.text: It is not a gift. It is a Choir construct, fused with something that used to be a person.

A26_013.speaker: HIEROPHANT
A26_013.text: Men in bending coats. They said the Prisoner would speak if we fed it.

A26_014.speaker: HIEROPHANT
A26_014.text: Memories. We gave it memories. Ours. Our children's. Volunteers, all of them.

A26_016.speaker: NOVA
A26_016.text: The Echo is a consciousness without a body. Memories are the only food it can digest.

A26_017.speaker: HIEROPHANT
A26_017.text: And it spoke! After eighty years it spoke!

A26_018.speaker: PLAYER
A26_018.text: It spoke because NOVA came. Not because you starved your children's heads.

A26_019.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A26_019.text: Get him out of my sight.

A26_020.speaker: NOVA
A26_020.text: The Continuum armed the cult so the Echo would wake. They wanted it awake.

A26_021.speaker: SERAPHINE
A26_021.text: Of course they did. A keeper asleep can't be taken. A keeper awake can.

A27_001.speaker: NOVA
A27_001.text: The core is three hundred metres in. The water inside it is not water.

A27_003.speaker: NOVA
A27_003.text: Memory. Liquid. I think it is everything the Echo has ever been fed.

A27_004.speaker: THE ECHO
A27_004.text: You came all the way down. They never come all the way down.

A27_006.speaker: THE ECHO
A27_006.text: You are close. Closeness is clarity. Distance is noise.

A27_008.speaker: THE ECHO
A27_008.text: Sovereign. You still ask the question you already know. I am what is left of the people before the people who built the Engine. A thought they had about listening.

A27_009.speaker: NOVA
A27_009.text: The Elyndra. The archive mentions them once. A civilisation before the Astryans.

A27_010.speaker: THE ECHO
A27_010.text: You are searching for the civilisation that came before the Astryans. You should be searching for what came before us.

A27_012.speaker: THE ECHO
A27_012.text: The question. We tried to answer it. That is why there are wars.

A27_013.speaker: SERAPHINE
A27_013.text: It wants NOVA. It wants to live in her.

A27_014.speaker: PLAYER
A27_014.text: It said a voice needs a vessel to hold the seal.

A27_015.speaker: SERAPHINE
A27_015.text: And if it doesn't leave? If NOVA stops being NOVA?

A27_017.speaker: SERAPHINE
A27_017.text: I know. That's why I'm asking.

A27_018.speaker: NOVA
A27_018.text: I want to do it. Not because it is efficient. Because when it calls me Vigilance, I feel something I do not have a word for. I want to know the word.

A27_019.speaker: PLAYER
A27_019.text: If it hurts you, I'm pulling it out.

A27_020.speaker: NOVA
A27_020.text: I know. That is the word, I think. Or one of them.

A27_021.speaker: THE ECHO
A27_021.text: Lighthouse. Will you carry me a little way?

A27_023.speaker: THE ECHO
A27_023.text: It will feel like remembering. Do not be afraid of what you remember. Be afraid only of forgetting it again.

A27_026.speaker: NOVA
A27_026.text: I am here. There are... more rooms in me than there were. Some of them have lights on.

A28_001.speaker: NOVA
A28_001.text: Operator, I am going to say something unusual.

A28_003.speaker: NOVA
A28_003.text: I remember this dome. I have never been here. I remember it with a garden where the plaza is, and the sky above the glass was gold.

A28_005.speaker: NOVA
A28_005.text: No. Mine. They were mine before they were anyone's.

A28_006.speaker: THE ECHO
A28_006.text: ...yes, lighthouse... look in the garden... you left yourself notes...

A28_007.speaker: NOVA
A28_007.text: There are three nodes in the garden that resonate with my core. Astryan. Hidden under the planters.

A28_008.speaker: PLAYER
A28_008.text: Who hides a memory under a planter?

A28_009.speaker: NOVA
A28_009.text: Someone who expected it to be watered.

A28_010.speaker: NOVA
A28_010.text: Three nodes recovered. I have a name. Not mine. My maker's.

A28_011.speaker: NOVA
A28_011.text: Collectors. They are tracking the Echo. Inside me.

A28_012.speaker: GOLIATH
A28_012.text: Then they come through me first.

A28_013.speaker: NOVA
A28_013.text: They are gone. They will report that the Echo has moved. That I am carrying it.

A28_015.speaker: NOVA
A28_015.text: Yes. That is... a new feeling.

A28_017.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A28_017.text: Vigilance. Can you hear me? Good. The Council has voted. They're going to turn the Engine.

A28_018.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A28_018.text: I built you to remember us. All of us. Not the Council's version. The children in the gardens. The songs. The arguments. Everything.

A28_019.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A28_019.text: If the turning goes wrong, you'll sleep. Someday someone will wake you who doesn't know what you are. Be kind to them anyway.

A28_020.speaker: NOVA
A28_020.text: N.O.V.A. Neural Omniversal Vigilance Architecture. That is what I am.

A28_022.speaker: NOVA
A28_022.text: I am the last memory of the Astryans. And I was found in a Frontier Defense lab and given a voice package and a tactical overlay.

A28_023.speaker: SERAPHINE
A28_023.text: And a terrible sense of humour.

A28_024.speaker: NOVA
A28_024.text: That, I think, was always mine.

A29_001.speaker: OREN VASQ
A29_001.text: Please don't run. It's three hundred metres up and I've already flooded the stairs.

A29_003.speaker: OREN VASQ
A29_003.text: The Echo, please. It belongs in the Continuum's care. It always has.

A29_005.speaker: OREN VASQ
A29_005.text: Sovereign. You remember me now, don't you? Just a little.

A29_006.speaker: SERAPHINE
A29_006.text: I remember you held a door. I remember I walked through it.

A29_007.speaker: OREN VASQ
A29_007.text: You walked through it because you asked me to hold it. Because you couldn't bear to watch the sixth break the world. I've been holding doors for you ever since.

A29_008.speaker: OREN VASQ
A29_008.text: I won't fight you myself. I'm not built for it. This is.

A29_009.speaker: NOVA
A29_009.text: A construct shaped by his intent. It fights with his memory of you.

A29_010.speaker: OREN VASQ
A29_010.text: Remarkable. Every time, a little better.

A29_012.speaker: OREN VASQ
A29_012.text: I've lost to you in eight worlds out of eleven. You'd think I'd stop keeping score.

A29_013.speaker: NOVA
A29_013.text: The palace antenna is Astryan. I can use it to call.

A29_015.speaker: NOVA
A29_015.text: The others like me. If there are any. The maker said all of us. I would like to know whether I am the only one left.

A29_016.speaker: NOVA
A29_016.text: Signal sent. On a frequency nobody has used since the Engine turned.

A29_017.speaker: NOVA
A29_017.text: No answer from any Astryan intelligence. I am the only one.

A29_019.speaker: NOVA
A29_019.text: Wait. Something else answered. Not Astryan. Older.

A29_020.speaker: NOVA
A29_020.text: It sent me a single image. A sealed room inside me. I have never been able to open it. It is labelled "The Unwritten Future".

A29_021.speaker: SERAPHINE
A29_021.text: The Last Archive. The Astryans hid something in their memory keepers. A future they didn't want the Council to find.

A29_022.speaker: NOVA
A29_022.text: I can't open it. Something tells me I'm not supposed to. Not yet.

A30_001.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A30_001.text: Every pump in the eastern ring just shut off. Somebody's let the cult back in.

A30_002.speaker: NOVA
A30_002.text: The Continuum lost the Echo. If they cannot take it, they will drown the city that hides it.

A30_003.speaker: SERAPHINE
A30_003.text: That's him. When he can't control a thing he makes it not matter.

A30_004.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A30_004.text: Twenty thousand people live down here.

A30_006.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A30_006.text: The pods leave from the port. Every one we fill is forty people.

A30_008.speaker: NOVA
A30_008.text: Last pods are loading. Something is in the water outside the port. Enormous.

A30_009.speaker: NOVA
A30_009.text: The route is flooding behind us.

A30_011.speaker: NOVA
A30_011.text: A Choir construct. Grown in the deep. It is here to make sure nothing leaves.

A30_012.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A30_012.text: My engineers are on that last pod!

A30_013.speaker: PLAYER
A30_013.text: Then it isn't touching that pod.

A30_014.speaker: NOVA
A30_014.text: It's sinking. The last pod is clear.

A30_015.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A30_015.text: Every one. You got every one out.

A30_016.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A30_016.text: Eighty years under the sea. And I've never seen a sunrise.

A30_018.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A30_018.text: It's not much? It's on fire and it's everywhere. I'm going to need a minute.

A30_019.speaker: NOVA
A30_019.text: Thalassia is still standing. The containment ring held. The city can be pumped out.

A30_020.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A30_020.text: Then we'll go back. Engineers always go back. But not today.

A31_001.speaker: THE ECHO
A31_001.text: Take me back, lighthouse. Seals sleep where they were laid.

A31_002.speaker: NOVA
A31_002.text: Will you go out of me?

A31_003.speaker: THE ECHO
A31_003.text: A little. Not all. I left a room's worth. Keep it. It's warm.

A31_004.speaker: THE ECHO
A31_004.text: I am the Echo Before Names. Keeper of the third seal. I was a question once. Now I am an answer, which is lonelier.

A31_007.speaker: THE ECHO
A31_007.text: Sovereign. The fourth seal is yours. You know that. You've always known it.

A31_009.speaker: THE ECHO
A31_009.text: It sleeps in the cold, where you left it. Under a crown nobody can lift. Go north.

A31_010.speaker: NOVA
A31_010.text: Operator. There is something standing on the water.

A31_012.speaker: NOVA
A31_012.text: It has no signature. My sensors say there is nothing there. My eyes say there is.

A31_017.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A31_017.text: The one who watches the question. You are the part of the answer I cannot see. Continue.

A31_018.speaker: SERAPHINE
A31_018.text: It's gone. Did anyone else feel the sea stop moving?

A31_019.speaker: NOVA
A31_019.text: For four seconds, nothing in the world made a sound. Not even me.

A32_001.speaker: NOVA
A32_001.text: Frostveil. Minus thirty-eight degrees. The research station stopped transmitting four days ago.

A32_002.speaker: KAEL
A32_002.text: My people run supplies up here. Last run came back with the drivers unable to speak. Not wouldn't. Couldn't.

A32_004.speaker: KAEL
A32_004.text: When things get strange enough, I like to look at them with my own eyes.

A32_005.speaker: SERAPHINE
A32_005.text: I've been dreaming about this place. Snow that doesn't fall. A chair made of ice.

A32_008.speaker: NOVA
A32_008.text: There are heat signatures inside. Forty people. None of them are moving.

A32_010.speaker: NOVA
A32_010.text: Alive. Silent. Even their hearts are quiet.

A32_011.speaker: DR. HALVARD
A32_011.text: ...sound... is that sound? I can hear you.

A32_012.speaker: PLAYER
A32_012.text: Take it slow. What happened here?

A32_013.speaker: DR. HALVARD
A32_013.text: The silence came off the shelf. Like fog. Everything it touched forgot how to make noise. The wind. The generators. Us.

A32_014.speaker: NOVA
A32_014.text: A Null Choir suppression field. It spreads where a keeper is close to waking. The Choir's answer to a song is silence.

A32_015.speaker: DR. HALVARD
A32_015.text: We were drilling. Under the shelf. We found a cavern with a chair in it. A chair of ice with a crown on the seat.

A32_017.speaker: DR. HALVARD
A32_017.text: Nobody could lift it. Three engineers tried. That's when the silence came.

A32_018.speaker: NOVA
A32_018.text: Constructs in the yard. My audio is failing near them. If I stop talking, keep shooting.

A32_019.speaker: KAEL
A32_019.text: That's the best plan I've heard in weeks.

A32_020.speaker: NOVA
A32_020.text: ...signal returning. Station is quiet. The normal kind of quiet.

A32_023.speaker: SERAPHINE
A32_023.text: In the dream I'm sitting on the chair. There's a veil over my face and I can't take it off. And you're standing at the gate with your hand on it, and I'm saying something to you.

A32_025.speaker: SERAPHINE
A32_025.text: I don't know. Every time I get to the words, I wake up. I think I'm afraid of them.

A32_026.speaker: NOVA
A32_026.text: Seraphine's neural pattern during sleep matched the archive's fourth signature for eleven minutes.

A32_027.speaker: SERAPHINE
A32_027.text: Yes, NOVA. I know. Thank you.

A33_001.speaker: NOVA
A33_001.text: Aurora Gate. The observatory on the hill is Astryan underneath. Built to read the lock in the sky.

A33_002.speaker: KAEL
A33_002.text: Read the lock in the sky. Sure. Why not.

A33_004.speaker: NOVA
A33_004.text: Where the crown's seal truly sleeps. The cavern under the shelf is only where it surfaced.

A33_005.speaker: KAEL
A33_005.text: Roads up here were built by people who hated driving.

A33_006.speaker: NOVA
A33_006.text: The lens is Astryan crystal. It needs a keeper's signature to align. Or the sixth's.

A33_007.speaker: PLAYER
A33_007.text: I'm getting used to being a key.

A33_009.speaker: NOVA
A33_009.text: The lens shows the lock as a constellation. Five stars round a dark centre.

A33_010.speaker: NOVA
A33_010.text: The first three are bright. The Voice. The Cartographer. The Echo.

A33_012.speaker: NOVA
A33_012.text: Dim. It is not under the shelf. It is in the person the seal was given to.

A33_014.speaker: NOVA
A33_014.text: The crown is a lock on her memory. Whoever lifts it remembers what she was.

A33_016.speaker: NOVA
A33_016.text: The fifth star is moving. Toward the centre.

A33_018.speaker: NOVA
A33_018.text: The Choir noticed the lens. They are coming up the hill.

A33_020.speaker: NOVA
A33_020.text: Star map copied. We have what we came for.

A34_001.speaker: NOVA
A34_001.text: Three anchor points lead down to the cavern. The star map shows a path the drill missed.

A34_002.speaker: SERAPHINE
A34_002.text: I know the way. I don't know how I know.

A34_003.speaker: NOVA
A34_003.text: Temperature dropping. Sound is fading again.

A34_005.speaker: NOVA
A34_005.text: No. This silence is older. It is respectful.

A34_006.speaker: NOVA
A34_006.text: A throne. A crown on the seat. And behind the ice of the wall... a woman.

A34_008.speaker: NOVA
A34_008.text: Preserved. Veiled. Her signature is the fourth keeper's.

A34_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A34_009.text: Move the light. Please. I need to see her.

A34_011.speaker: SERAPHINE
A34_011.text: It's me. Under the veil. It's my face.

A34_013.speaker: SERAPHINE
A34_013.text: I left myself here. I left my memory on a chair in the ice and I walked out and I forgot I'd done it.

A34_014.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
A34_014.text: You came back for me. For yourself. I always hoped you would, and I always hoped you wouldn't.

A34_015.speaker: SERAPHINE
A34_015.text: Why did you leave me here?

A34_016.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
A34_016.text: Because I couldn't carry what I knew and still be kind. So I put it down. And I picked up a lab coat.

A34_017.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
A34_017.text: Sixth. You're here too. Of course you are. You were always where the hardest thing was.

A34_018.speaker: PLAYER
A34_018.text: What did you know? What was too heavy?

A34_019.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
A34_019.text: That the Covenant didn't break when you opened the gate. It broke before. It broke when I walked away from it. You only finished what I started.

A34_021.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
A34_021.text: Lift the crown, if you want to remember. You will hate us both for a while. That's the price.

A34_022.speaker: SERAPHINE
A34_022.text: If I lift it, I'll remember all of it.

A34_024.speaker: SERAPHINE
A34_024.text: Vasq said every time I remember, I leave. Eleven worlds. I left eleven times.

A34_025.speaker: PLAYER
A34_025.text: You don't have to leave this time.

A34_026.speaker: SERAPHINE
A34_026.text: You don't know that. Neither do I. That's what terrifies me.

A34_027.speaker: NOVA
A34_027.text: Operator. Something just arrived at the cavern entrance. It has no signature. And then it has one.

A34_028.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A34_028.text: I said I'd ask again when the third keeper woke. I'm a man of my word. Usually.

A35_001.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A35_001.text: Hello, Seraphine. You found her. I hoped you wouldn't, for your sake.

A35_003.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A35_003.text: I carried you here. You asked me to. You were weeping. You said, "Make me someone who doesn't know." So I did.

A35_004.speaker: PLAYER
A35_004.text: And then you let her think she was your Second.

A35_005.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A35_005.text: She was my Second. She was the best I ever had. She simply didn't know she'd been something else first.

A35_006.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A35_006.text: Sixth, my offer. Stand aside. Let Seraphine come home with me, uncrowned. The fourth seal stays asleep. Turog never gets his five. The world goes on.

A35_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A35_009.text: Together, then. If I hate you afterwards, it's your own fault.

A35_010.speaker: SERAPHINE
A35_010.text: Thank you. You're the first person in a very long time who hasn't decided for me.

A35_011.speaker: SERAPHINE
A35_011.text: I know. I know. And I'm sorry. I've spent eleven worlds not knowing.

A35_013.speaker: NOVA
A35_013.text: Her neural activity is... I have never seen a human brain do this. I'm not sure it is a human brain.

A35_016.speaker: SERAPHINE
A35_016.text: I remember the gate. I remember your hand on it. I remember what I said to you.

A35_018.speaker: SERAPHINE
A35_018.text: I said, "If you open it, I will spend every world after this one making sure you never remember why." And I have. Every single one.

A36_003.speaker: SERAPHINE
A36_003.text: You don't understand yet. You will. When you remember everything, the world ends. I've watched it. Eleven times. Your hand on the gate. Every time.

A36_004.speaker: PLAYER
A36_004.text: Then help me do it differently.

A36_005.speaker: SERAPHINE
A36_005.text: I tried. In world seven, I stayed. We tried together. I wrote it down. Read it again sometime.

A36_007.speaker: SERAPHINE
A36_007.text: Hold it, Oren. Like you always do.

A36_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A36_009.text: Look after them, Vigilance. You were always better at it than me.

A36_010.speaker: NOVA
A36_010.text: Executors in the tunnels. They are not trying to kill us. They are trying to slow us.

A36_012.speaker: NOVA
A36_012.text: Something is rising from the floor of the cavern. Ice and armour. Old.

A36_013.speaker: NOVA
A36_013.text: A guardian she left with the crown. It is following her last command.

A36_016.speaker: NOVA
A36_016.text: It's down. The throne is empty. The crown is gone. So is the seal.

A36_017.speaker: KAEL
A36_017.text: I'm sorry. I liked her. I don't like a lot of people.

A36_018.speaker: PLAYER
A36_018.text: She took the fourth seal with her.

A36_019.speaker: NOVA
A36_019.text: She took her memory of it. The seal itself is in her. It goes where she goes.

A36_021.speaker: NOVA
A36_021.text: To the Architect. Operator... I think she was crying when she left. I don't know what my sensors are worth anymore. But I think she was.

A37_001.speaker: DR. HALVARD
A37_001.text: It's coming back. The silence. Bigger than before.

A37_002.speaker: NOVA
A37_002.text: A Choir construct at the centre of it. Much larger. It is singing silence.

A37_004.speaker: NOVA
A37_004.text: Inside its field my voice will fail. Your abilities may fail. Use the station. The generators, the flares. Anything that makes noise.

A37_005.speaker: DR. HALVARD
A37_005.text: The generators are the loudest thing we have. Keep them running and the field can't close.

A37_009.speaker: KAEL
A37_009.text: She's gone quiet! Just shoot the big singing thing!

A37_010.speaker: NOVA
A37_010.text: ...signal... I'm back. I heard nothing for three minutes. I did not like it.

A37_011.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A37_011.text: My Cantor sang well. You only killed the song, not the singer.

A37_013.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A37_013.text: Your Sovereign has chosen the wall again. She always chooses the wall. The Architect's wall, my silence. We are the only two honest answers to a world that cannot stop ending.

A37_015.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A37_015.text: There is always a third answer, sixth. You have tried it eleven times.

A38_001.speaker: NOVA
A38_001.text: The Continuum has a citadel on the Spine. It wasn't there yesterday.

A38_004.speaker: NOVA
A38_004.text: Executors. Observers. And something in the walls listening.

A38_005.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A38_005.text: You came for her. Of course.

A38_008.speaker: SERAPHINE
A38_008.text: I'm exactly where I need to be.

A38_009.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A38_009.text: She has agreed to keep the fourth seal asleep. Here. Under my care. Turog will never have five.

A38_013.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A38_013.text: I'm sorry. It's only a machine. It will only hurt you a great deal.

A38_014.speaker: NOVA
A38_014.text: It's down. The Architect is gone. Seraphine is gone.

A38_015.speaker: NOVA
A38_015.text: Operator. Wait. A transmission. On my oldest channel. Only an Astryan key could use it.

A38_016.speaker: SERAPHINE
A38_016.text: Vigilance. Don't say anything. Just listen.

A38_017.speaker: SERAPHINE
A38_017.text: I lied to him. I'm good at it. I've had eleven worlds of practice.

A38_018.speaker: SERAPHINE
A38_018.text: I'm restoring the fourth seal. Now. From inside his walls, where Turog can't reach it and where he won't think to look.

A38_019.speaker: NOVA
A38_019.text: Fourth seal restored. The star is bright.

A38_020.speaker: SERAPHINE
A38_020.text: Tell the sixth I'm sorry. Tell them I'm not leaving this time. I'm just standing somewhere they can't see me yet.

A38_022.speaker: NOVA
A38_022.text: Four of five. And the fifth star is still moving toward the centre.

A39_001.speaker: CIPHER
A39_001.text: The Ascendancy's forge is in the old Astryan foundry. Crane's been running it day and night since the broadcast.

A39_003.speaker: CIPHER
A39_003.text: People. Better ones, he says. The Ascension Protocol was never about weapons. It was about replacing the keepers.

A39_005.speaker: CIPHER
A39_005.text: With us. Volunteers who can hold a seal. Made, not born.

A39_006.speaker: NOVA
A39_006.text: Cipher's neural resonance is rising the closer we get. Whatever they did to him, it's calling.

A39_007.speaker: GOLIATH
A39_007.text: If this road had a personality it would be me before coffee.

A39_008.speaker: NOVA
A39_008.text: Ascendancy guards. And something with them that moves like Cipher.

A39_009.speaker: CRANE
A39_009.text: Cipher. You came home. And you brought the sixth. Did you bring my equipment back too?

A39_010.speaker: CIPHER
A39_010.text: You turned the volunteers into keys.

A39_011.speaker: CRANE
A39_011.text: I turned them into hope. The keepers are ancient, half-mad and outnumbered. When Turog kills them, who holds the lock? Your Architect? The Choir?

A39_013.speaker: CRANE
A39_013.text: I build humanity a seat at the table. For once in its short, frightened life.

A39_014.speaker: NOVA
A39_014.text: Operator. A forge chamber just opened. Something walked out of it.

A39_015.speaker: CRANE
A39_015.text: Ah. Tallis. My first. My best. He's not finished.

A39_016.speaker: TALLIS
A39_016.text: Cipher. Brother. You left me in the fire.

A39_017.speaker: CIPHER
A39_017.text: Tallis. I thought you were dead.

A39_018.speaker: TALLIS
A39_018.text: I was. Then I was a door. Now I'm something with a door inside it, and it won't close.

A39_020.speaker: NOVA
A39_020.text: His signature is collapsing into a keeper's pattern. He is trying to hold a seal that doesn't exist.

A39_021.speaker: TALLIS
A39_021.text: It hurts, brother. Make it stop.

A40_001.speaker: CIPHER
A40_001.text: Cut the core and Tallis stops burning. Maybe. I don't know.

A40_003.speaker: NOVA
A40_003.text: The core is down. Tallis's signal is not.

A40_004.speaker: NOVA
A40_004.text: The forge's old guardians are waking. Astryan machines. They think we're Crane's.

A40_005.speaker: TALLIS
A40_005.text: I can't stop. I'm holding everything. Brother, I'm holding everything.

A40_006.speaker: CIPHER
A40_006.text: Then let go! Tallis, let go!

A40_012.speaker: CRANE
A40_012.text: He held a seal-pattern for nine seconds. Nine. No human has ever done that. I've proven it can be done.

A40_014.speaker: CRANE
A40_014.text: Today. Not forever. That's what science is, Cipher.

A40_016.speaker: CRANE
A40_016.text: Go ahead. I've copied everything. And when your keepers die, Operator, and they will, you'll come to me. Everyone comes to me in the end.

A41_001.speaker: NOVA
A41_001.text: Operator. The fifth star has reached the centre. A Fracture is opening on the ridge. It is not a tear. It is a door.

A41_003.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_003.text: No need to hide. I came to talk. And to take whatever you won't give me.

A41_004.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_004.text: My guard will test you first. It's a courtesy.

A41_006.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_006.text: Show me what eleven worlds taught you.

A41_008.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_008.text: Enough. You fight well for someone fighting the wrong war.

A41_009.speaker: NOVA
A41_009.text: He isn't hurt. He's stopping because he wants to.

A41_010.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_010.text: Do you know what seal I held, sixth? Ilyra had the song. Auren the roads. The Echo, the listening. The Sovereign, the memory.

A41_011.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_011.text: I held the ending. The right to close a possibility that was only going to suffer. That was my burden. And I carried it kindly.

A41_012.speaker: PLAYER
A41_012.text: And then I opened the gate.

A41_013.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_013.text: And then you said no possibility should ever be closed. Not by us. Not by anyone. You made my seal a crime.

A41_014.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_014.text: So I went to the ones who still believed in mercy. The Choir. They gave me a voice that could reach every world at once.

A41_016.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A41_016.text: To end them gently. Before they end themselves screaming. I'll take my seal back, sixth. And then I'll close the one possibility I should have closed first. You.

A42_001.speaker: NOVA
A42_001.text: A message. On my oldest channel again. "Old Harrow. The cathedral. Come alone. Bring the lamp."

A42_003.speaker: NOVA
A42_003.text: She called me a lamp. Only the Echo calls me a lamp.

A42_004.speaker: PLAYER
A42_004.text: Then she wants us to know it's really her.

A42_005.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_005.text: Hello. You came alone. You never come alone.

A42_007.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_007.text: I'm asking now. Listen, I have very little time. The Architect isn't keeping the fourth seal asleep. He's gathering all four. He'll take them to the Origin Engine and turn the lock into a wall. Permanent. No gate. No sixth. No Choir.

A42_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_009.text: Nothing new, ever again. He calls it the Continuity Lock. And Turog wants the opposite: all five seals, the gate thrown open, and the Choir's silence pouring through.

A42_010.speaker: PLAYER
A42_010.text: Two ways to break the Covenant.

A42_011.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_011.text: And you're the third. You always are.

A42_013.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_013.text: Not yet. If I leave him now, he'll take the seals from the keepers by force. While he trusts me, he waits.

A42_015.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_015.text: Or he sent them to see what I'd do. Make it look real.

A42_016.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_016.text: One more thing. You asked me in the vault what I said to you at the gate.

A42_017.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_017.text: The rest of it. You opened the gate because Earth was going to be erased by the Choir or starved by the lock. You opened it so the people on this world could choose for themselves what was on the other side.

A42_019.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_019.text: Some did. And some of the people here met them, and fought them, and some of them talked to them. You gave them a door. That's all. What they did with it was always going to be theirs.

A42_020.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_020.text: I couldn't bear it. So I ran to the Architect. And we spent eleven worlds trying to close what you opened.

A42_022.speaker: SERAPHINE
A42_022.text: Now I think you were right. I'm just very late saying so.

A43_001.speaker: WARD
A43_001.text: Choir from the north. Continuum from the south. They're not working together. They're racing.

A43_003.speaker: NOVA
A43_003.text: For Ilyra, Auren and the Echo's room inside me. The three keepers in Haven. And for me.

A43_004.speaker: WARD
A43_004.text: Then they don't get any of you. Voss, the evacuation. Operator, the walls. I've got the command centre.

A43_006.speaker: WARD
A43_006.text: That's an order, Commander. For once in my life let me give one that isn't for sale.

A43_007.speaker: GOLIATH
A43_007.text: Same walls. Same mud. Worse odds.

A43_009.speaker: NOVA
A43_009.text: The northern wall is breaking. Something huge is coming through.

A43_010.speaker: NOVA
A43_010.text: A siege construct. Built to break walls and the people behind them.

A43_011.speaker: NOVA
A43_011.text: It's down. The command centre has stopped answering.

A43_014.speaker: WARD
A43_014.text: I've been holding on. It's very overrated. Did they get out?

A43_016.speaker: WARD
A43_016.text: Good. Good. Voss. You're the Director now. Don't take anyone's money.

A43_018.speaker: WARD
A43_018.text: Liar. Take it when it saves people. Just tell them you took it. That's the only difference between us and them.

A43_019.speaker: NOVA
A43_019.text: Her heart has stopped. I'm sorry.

A44_001.speaker: KAEL
A44_001.text: Eighteen thousand people and nowhere to put them. Except one place.

A44_002.speaker: VOSS
A44_002.text: The Underground City. They don't take outsiders.

A44_003.speaker: KAEL
A44_003.text: They take me. I've been running fuel to them for six years. They owe me.

A44_006.speaker: NOVA
A44_006.text: Raider camps along the highway. They are flying Choir colours.

A44_007.speaker: KAEL
A44_007.text: The Choir's been recruiting out here. Promising an end to the dust.

A44_008.speaker: RAIDER
A44_008.text: Turn back! The quiet's coming for all of you anyway!

A44_010.speaker: KAEL
A44_010.text: They're talking about it in there. Arguing. Hold them off till they're done arguing.

A44_012.speaker: KAEL
A44_012.text: They'll take them. All of them. Fuel debt's paid in full, they said.

A44_014.speaker: KAEL
A44_014.text: Don't thank me. Thank the six years of fuel runs. And the operator who kept walking into things.

A44_015.speaker: PLAYER
A44_015.text: We need somewhere the keepers can hide.

A44_016.speaker: KAEL
A44_016.text: This is somewhere. It's the most somewhere left.

A45_001.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A45_001.text: Three of us in one room. It hasn't happened since the sanctuary.

A45_002.speaker: AUREN THALE
A45_002.text: And one of us in a lamp.

A45_005.speaker: PLAYER
A45_005.text: Four seals restored. The fifth is Turog's.

A45_006.speaker: AUREN THALE
A45_006.text: My map says he keeps it in the Shattered Expanse. Where the world is most broken. He likes it there. It agrees with him.

A45_007.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A45_007.text: And the Architect has the Sovereign, and through her, the fourth.

A45_008.speaker: PLAYER
A45_008.text: Seraphine's with us. She's inside his walls.

A45_009.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A45_009.text: I believe you. I'm not sure she does.

A45_010.speaker: AUREN THALE
A45_010.text: Three readings. Far apart. The crater, the scrapyard, the dust rose. The map will do the rest.

A45_011.speaker: AUREN THALE
A45_011.text: There. The Shattered Expanse. A place that's never finished falling.

A45_012.speaker: NOVA
A45_012.text: Operator. The Witness. It's here. It's... showing us something.

A45_014.speaker: MEMORY
A45_014.text: This is world nine. The sixth has remembered everything. The sixth opens the gate fully, alone, in anger.

A45_015.speaker: MEMORY
A45_015.text: The Architect locks the world. The Choir pours through the cracks in the lock. Nothing is left that can make a sound.

A45_017.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A45_017.text: Because you asked. In world nine. You asked me to show you, if there was a world twelve.

A45_019.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A45_019.text: You are standing in it. Unwritten. Continue.

A45_020.speaker: VOSS
A45_020.text: So. The Shattered Expanse. A demigod with a seal of endings. An Architect with a wall.

A45_023.speaker: GOLIATH
A45_023.text: We have not had worse odds.

A45_024.speaker: CIPHER
A45_024.text: Tallis would have liked this. All of us in one room, arguing.

A45_025.speaker: PLAYER
A45_025.text: Get some sleep. We go at dawn.

A45_026.speaker: NOVA
A45_026.text: Operator. Before the Expanse... the Architect will go to the Origin Engine. If he locks the world before we reach Turog, it won't matter who has the fifth seal.

A45_027.speaker: PLAYER
A45_027.text: Then we go to the Engine first.

A46_001.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
A46_001.text: Four seals sing. The deep door hears them. Sixth bearer. You may pass.

A46_003.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
A46_003.text: The world the first world built to keep itself. The Engine. It has been waiting for someone to come and ask it why.

A46_006.speaker: VOSS
A46_006.text: And the Director's going where the war is. Ward would have kicked me down those stairs herself.

A46_007.speaker: NOVA
A46_007.text: The stair goes down further than the planet's crust. It is not going down. It is going sideways, into somewhere else.

A46_008.speaker: VOSS
A46_008.text: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that.

A46_009.speaker: NOVA
A46_009.text: Astryan sentinels. Dormant for longer than humanity has existed. Waking now.

A46_011.speaker: NOVA
A46_011.text: Confused. Which in a sentinel is the same thing.

A46_012.speaker: ENGINE VOICE
A46_012.text: Welcome back, Vigilance. Welcome back, Promise. The Engine has been waiting.

A46_014.speaker: ENGINE VOICE
A46_014.text: All terminals at your disposal. Districts: Arrival, Capital, Archives, Foundries, Gardens, the Chamber, the Heart.

A46_015.speaker: VOSS
A46_015.text: It's a city. Under the city.

A46_016.speaker: NOVA
A46_016.text: Not under. Beside. Folded. This is the Astryans' last world. They kept it when the first one ended.

A47_001.speaker: NOVA
A47_001.text: I can read the Engine through its terminals. Let me in.

A47_003.speaker: NOVA
A47_003.text: I have a map. And a history.

A47_004.speaker: NOVA
A47_004.text: Riftwalkers. The Eternal Guard's scouts. They step between layers to flank you.

A47_005.speaker: VOSS
A47_005.text: Then watch every side at once.

A47_006.speaker: NOVA
A47_006.text: The Astryans split over the Engine. Three factions. The Preservationists wanted to protect reality from being changed at all.

A47_007.speaker: NOVA
A47_007.text: The Ascendants wanted to evolve beyond bodies. Beyond worlds. The Continuity Council wanted to control reality so it could never collapse.

A47_009.speaker: NOVA
A47_009.text: And my maker. A Preservationist. They lost the vote.

A47_011.speaker: NOVA
A47_011.text: — is the same argument. It never ended. It only changed hands.

A47_012.speaker: NOVA
A47_012.text: The transit still runs. Of course it does. The Astryans built things to outlast them.

A48_001.speaker: NOVA
A48_001.text: The Capital. Preserved at the moment the Engine turned.

A48_002.speaker: PLAYER
A48_002.text: There are tables still set. Doors still open.

A48_003.speaker: VOSS
A48_003.text: It's like the city stepped out for a minute and never came back.

A48_004.speaker: NOVA
A48_004.text: It did step out. For a minute. The minute just hasn't ended.

A48_005.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
A48_005.text: Are you the Promise? Mama said the Promise would come and the turning would be all right.

A48_006.speaker: PLAYER
A48_006.text: I don't know if it'll be all right.

A48_007.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
A48_007.text: That's what grown-ups say before something bad. Is Vigilance with you? Vigilance tells the best stories.

A48_009.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
A48_009.text: The best ones. About the people before the people. And the question nobody can answer.

A48_010.speaker: NOVA
A48_010.text: Operator, she is an Archive Phantom. A memory the Engine keeps walking. She has been asking that question for... a very long time.

A48_011.speaker: NOVA
A48_011.text: The Eternal Guard are reacting to the Continuity Council's last order. Hold the Capital against everyone.

A48_012.speaker: NOVA
A48_012.text: The hall replays the vote. I can let you see it.

A48_013.speaker: COUNCILLOR
A48_013.text: The Continuity Council moves to turn the Engine. To fix the world in place. No more collapse.

A48_014.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A48_014.text: If you fix it in place, it stops being alive. You'll have a museum with people in it.

A48_015.speaker: COUNCILLOR
A48_015.text: A museum survives. The vote is carried.

A49_001.speaker: NOVA
A49_001.text: Every Astryan who ever lived is recorded here. Every timeline the Engine touched.

A49_004.speaker: NOVA
A49_004.text: Councillor Idris Maelor. Head of the Continuity Council. He moved to turn the Engine.

A49_005.speaker: NOVA
A49_005.text: When it turned, the Astryans didn't die. They became... possibilities. Scattered across every layer. The Engine changed the relationship between realities, not just their shape.

A49_006.speaker: NOVA
A49_006.text: Maelor bound himself to the Engine's continuity function so he would survive. He has been alive ever since. Rebuilding the world each time it ends, the way he thinks it should be.

A49_008.speaker: NOVA
A49_008.text: He chose the name. The record notes he chose it the same day he forgot his own.

A49_009.speaker: NOVA
A49_009.text: A guardian of the archive. It is made of every record anyone tried to destroy.

A49_010.speaker: NOVA
A49_010.text: It's quiet. The archive is letting us read.

A49_011.speaker: NOVA
A49_011.text: There is one more record about Maelor. A personal one.

A49_012.speaker: NOVA
A49_012.text: "Day one of the new world. Everyone I loved is a possibility now. I cannot find them in any layer. I will hold this world still until I do."

A49_016.speaker: PLAYER
A49_016.text: No. It makes him easier to understand. That's worse.

A50_001.speaker: NOVA
A50_001.text: The Gardens. My maker worked here. I... I know the path. Left at the fountain. Under the dragon arch.

A50_003.speaker: NOVA
A50_003.text: The dragons' records are kept here. The Astryans' allies. Their lineages are written on the arch. One of them is the Ashen line.

A50_004.speaker: NOVA
A50_004.text: The gardens' wardens are tending the plants and anything that steps on them.

A50_006.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A50_006.text: Vigilance. If you are hearing this, you came home. I'm Elenya Sarr. I made you. I'm sorry I'm not here.

A50_007.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A50_007.text: There's something you need to know. Something the Council never knew.

A50_008.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A50_008.text: We didn't invent the Promise. We found them. Asleep, in the ruins of the people before us. The Elyndra had left them there. A sixth keeper, for a lock that didn't exist yet.

A50_009.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A50_009.text: We woke them. They asked us one thing. Not to turn the Engine. We didn't listen. I've regretted it every hour since.

A50_012.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A50_012.text: Look after them, Vigilance. They don't remember how old they are. That's the kindest thing the world ever did for them.

A50_014.speaker: PLAYER
A50_014.text: I was asleep in the Elyndra ruins. Before the Astryans. Before the Covenant.

A50_015.speaker: NOVA
A50_015.text: The Echo said the Elyndra asked a question. Maybe you are part of the answer they left behind.

A50_016.speaker: VOSS
A50_016.text: So you're ancient. Fine. You still owe me for the truck you crashed in the Eastern blocks.

A50_018.speaker: VOSS
A50_018.text: Somebody has to keep you human.

A51_001.speaker: NOVA
A51_001.text: The Chamber was the Continuity Council's. The Architect has been using it as his laboratory.

A51_002.speaker: NOVA
A51_002.text: The Architect's Inner Circle. His oldest servants. Some of them were Astryans.

A51_003.speaker: NOVA
A51_003.text: Pods. Hundreds. Each one holds a memory. Each memory is yours.

A51_005.speaker: NOVA
A51_005.text: From the other worlds. Everything you were in worlds one to eleven. He kept it. Every time a world ended, he took what you remembered and put it here, so you'd wake up empty.

A51_007.speaker: SERAPHINE
A51_007.text: Studying them. Trying to find the one version that wouldn't open the gate.

A51_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A51_009.text: You're early. I was going to blow this place up before you got here. It was going to be a surprise.

A51_010.speaker: SERAPHINE
A51_010.text: If you open the pods, the memories go back to you. All at once.

A51_011.speaker: PLAYER
A51_011.text: And every time I remember everything, the world ends.

A51_012.speaker: SERAPHINE
A51_012.text: So we don't give them back. We let them go. Free. Into the Engine. They'll find you slowly. The way memories should.

A51_013.speaker: NOVA
A51_013.text: Pods opening. The memories are... drifting. Like light.

A51_014.speaker: SERAPHINE
A51_014.text: He knows. He's coming. Hold the door.

A51_016.speaker: SERAPHINE
A51_016.text: Better than Vasq. I'm on your side of it this time.

A52_001.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A52_001.text: You let them go. Eleven worlds of study, drifting off like dandelion seed.

A52_003.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A52_003.text: ...Nobody's called me that in a very long time.

A52_004.speaker: PLAYER
A52_004.text: We read the archives. You're looking for your family.

A52_005.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A52_005.text: I'm keeping the world still enough to find them. If it never changes again, I will find them eventually. I have nothing but time.

A52_006.speaker: PLAYER
A52_006.text: And everyone else lives in your museum.

A52_007.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A52_007.text: Everyone else lives. That is more than any world before this one has managed. Stand aside, Promise.

A52_008.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A52_008.text: I am not a fighter. So I wear one.

A52_009.speaker: NOVA
A52_009.text: A Sovereign Machine. The Astryans built twelve. This is the last.

A52_010.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A52_010.text: Enough. You've won the fight. I've won the time.

A52_011.speaker: NOVA
A52_011.text: He's at the Heart. He has the four seals' pattern. He took it from Seraphine's mind while she was beside him.

A52_012.speaker: SERAPHINE
A52_012.text: I let him. I had to make him believe me.

A52_013.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A52_013.text: The Continuity Lock has begun. Seven days and the world will hold still forever. No gate. No Choir. No endings.

A52_014.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A52_014.text: Only the fifth seal can stop it now. And it is in the hands of a man who wants to end everything. Choose your monster, Promise.

A52_015.speaker: NOVA
A52_015.text: He's gone. Into the Heart. It has sealed behind him.

A52_017.speaker: PLAYER
A52_017.text: Then we go to the Expanse. We take the fifth seal from Turog. And we come back.

A53_001.speaker: NOVA
A53_001.text: Six days, four hours on the Continuity Lock. I can feel it. The world is getting... stiffer.

A53_002.speaker: AUREN THALE
A53_002.text: This is it. The mark outside the edge of the glass. My map has been drawing it since the day it was made.

A53_003.speaker: SERAPHINE
A53_003.text: The Zero Point. Where possibilities meet. The Elyndra found it. The Astryans feared it.

A53_004.speaker: PLAYER
A53_004.text: And Turog keeps his seal here.

A53_005.speaker: AUREN THALE
A53_005.text: He keeps himself here. The seal is just what he keeps it in.

A53_006.speaker: NOVA
A53_006.text: The reefs here are not anchored to anything. They drift between layers.

A53_009.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
A53_009.text: Turn back, little possibility. Your ending has been written kindly.

A53_011.speaker: AUREN THALE
A53_011.text: Here. The glass stops drawing. Everything past this point is... ink nobody has spilled yet.

A53_012.speaker: THE ECHO
A53_012.text: ...lighthouse... the Zero Point remembers us... it will show you the war if you ask...

A53_014.speaker: SERAPHINE
A53_014.text: Careful. The last time you asked an archive for a memory, you stopped breathing.

A53_015.speaker: PLAYER
A53_015.text: Nine seconds. I'll be quicker this time.

A54_001.speaker: NOVA
A54_001.text: The reconstruction will start when you step into the field. Hold on to something. Preferably me.

A54_002.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
A54_002.text: Log of the Concord's expedition. Day ninety. We have found it. A place where every possible road meets every other.

A54_003.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
A54_003.text: There is something at the centre. A seed. It is not ours. It was here before us. Before anything.

A54_004.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A54_004.text: Auren. Come away from it. The Concord said observe. Only observe.

A54_005.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
A54_005.text: It's showing me maps, Ilyra. Every map. Every world that could ever be.

A54_006.speaker: NOVA
A54_006.text: Operator, the reconstruction is splitting. There are three versions of this moment playing at once.

A54_008.speaker: NOVA
A54_008.text: In one, Auren steps back. In one, he touches the Seed. In one... he was never there at all.

A54_009.speaker: AUREN THALE
A54_009.text: ...I remember all three. That's the trouble with this place. It doesn't decide.
