A54_010.speaker: NOVA
A54_010.text: Phantoms of all three versions are colliding. They are hostile to anything that is only one thing.

A54_012.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
A54_012.text: We tried to speak to whatever made the Seed. We called it the First Contact.

A54_014.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
A54_014.text: Not an answer. A question. The same question, in every one of us. Who decides what may exist?

A54_015.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A54_015.text: And we've been fighting about it ever since.

A54_016.speaker: AUREN THALE
A54_016.text: That's the First War. Not a war of nations. A war about that question.

A55_001.speaker: SERAPHINE
A55_001.text: The Choir had a hall here. Before they were the Choir. When they were just Elyndra who were very, very tired.

A55_002.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
A55_002.text: Every possibility that fails, fails in pain. The Seed makes more of them every hour.

A55_003.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
A55_003.text: Mercy is the closing of a door before the screaming starts. We will be that mercy.

A55_004.speaker: TUROG (MEMORY)
A55_004.text: I will lead them. I've seen what the failing worlds become. Somebody has to be brave enough to end them.

A55_006.speaker: TUROG (MEMORY)
A55_006.text: I still am, Ilyra. I'm just treating something bigger.

A55_007.speaker: NOVA
A55_007.text: This is Turog before the Covenant. Before he was a keeper.

A55_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A55_009.text: And then he came home to the Covenant. And then he left again. He's been leaving his whole life.

A55_010.speaker: NOVA
A55_010.text: A Choir construct older than the Cantor. It keeps their doctrine, and it sings it at whoever comes in.

A55_013.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A55_013.text: You broke my old hymn. I wrote that, you know. When I was young and sure.

A55_015.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A55_015.text: I'm sure of different things. Come to the spire, sixth. Bring your keepers. Let's finish the argument we started before your world had a name.

A56_001.speaker: SERAPHINE
A56_001.text: The Unbound left waymarks. Three of them. They didn't want to win. They wanted to leave.

A56_002.speaker: NYX
A56_002.text: I understand them better than anyone else in this story.

A56_003.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
A56_003.text: The Concord would harmonise every world. The Choir would end the failing ones. Both would decide for everyone.

A56_004.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
A56_004.text: We will decide nothing for anyone. We'll close the Zero Point and walk away.

A56_006.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
A56_006.text: We'll take a little of it with us. Not to use. To keep. One possibility nobody gets to write. A promise.

A56_008.speaker: NOVA
A56_008.text: Operator. Your signature. It matches the fragment they carried.

A56_009.speaker: PLAYER
A56_009.text: I was made from the Seed.

A56_010.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
A56_010.text: Not made. Planted. Something that will grow into whatever it chooses. When the time comes, let it choose the door.

A56_011.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
A56_011.text: The Choir found us. Hold them so the Promise gets away.

A56_013.speaker: SERAPHINE
A56_013.text: You're a choice nobody else made. That's what they left in you.

A56_014.speaker: NOVA
A56_014.text: It explains why nobody can predict you. Not the Architect. Not the Engine. Not the map.

A56_015.speaker: AUREN THALE
A56_015.text: You can't map a road nobody has decided to build.

A57_001.speaker: NOVA
A57_001.text: The final reconstruction. The last day of the First War.

A57_002.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A57_002.text: The Concord Engine is failing. If it fails, the Seed splits every history at once.

A57_003.speaker: TUROG (MEMORY)
A57_003.text: Then let it split! Let the Choir close the halves that fail!

A57_004.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A57_004.text: Vael, we don't destroy it. We stabilise it. Help me hold it.

A57_005.speaker: NOVA
A57_005.text: The Engine has three pillars. We don't break them. We balance them. All three at once.

A57_007.speaker: NOVA
A57_007.text: In a memory that is still happening. The Zero Point doesn't do past tense.

A57_009.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A57_009.text: It held. But the Seed... it's splitting anyway. Our histories. We're drifting apart.

A57_010.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
A57_010.text: Every map is coming apart in my hands. I can't find you, Ilyra. You're on a road I can't see.

A57_012.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A57_012.text: The Witness. It's sealing the record. So no one can use the Seed as a weapon again.

A57_013.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A57_013.text: One record will remain. For the Promise. When it is ready to ask.

A57_014.speaker: NOVA
A57_014.text: The Elyndra didn't lose the war. They became possibilities that could no longer reach each other.

A57_015.speaker: SERAPHINE
A57_015.text: Like the Astryans, after the Engine. Like everything that tries to answer the question.

A57_016.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A57_016.text: I lost everyone that day. Everyone but four. We made a Covenant, the five of us. And then the Promise woke and made six.

A57_018.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A57_018.text: We forgave him. He came home. He held the seal of endings because he understood it better than any of us.

A57_019.speaker: NOVA
A57_019.text: Five days, eleven hours on the lock.

A57_020.speaker: PLAYER
A57_020.text: The Witness said one record remained. For me. When I was ready to ask.

A58_001.speaker: NOVA
A58_001.text: The vault doesn't appear on any of my instruments. It appears on Auren's map. And in my memory.

A58_002.speaker: SERAPHINE
A58_002.text: It's waiting for you. Only you.

A58_003.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A58_003.text: Promise. You have come to ask.

A58_005.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A58_005.text: Readiness is not observed. Choice is. Observe: three worlds. In one, everyone you love is safe and nothing new is ever born. In one, everything is possible and much of it ends. In one, you choose for all of them.

A58_007.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A58_007.text: Observed. You did not force. Continue.

A58_008.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A58_008.text: Observed. You asked. Few ask. Continue.

A58_009.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A58_009.text: Observed. A door is not a decision. It is a permission. Continue.

A58_011.speaker: MEMORY
A58_011.text: This is the Promise, the first time it woke. It asked the Astryans one thing. Do not turn the Engine. It asked the Covenant one thing. Let the people choose.

A58_012.speaker: MEMORY
A58_012.text: It asked the Witness one thing. If I forget, remind me that I was asked to choose, not to win.

A59_001.speaker: NOVA
A59_001.text: Operator, the spire is wrapped in a Choir silence field. Nothing gets through it. Not you. Not me.

A59_003.speaker: NOVA
A59_003.text: Not quite. There is something inside me that the field doesn't touch. The Witness called it Origin Memory Zero. I have never been able to open it.

A59_005.speaker: NOVA
A59_005.text: This will take time. And I will not be able to talk. Please keep talking to me anyway.

A59_010.speaker: NOVA
A59_010.text: This is what I was. Before the voice package. Before the tactical overlay. The Astryans' last lighthouse.

A59_011.speaker: NOVA
A59_011.text: Memory Zero isn't Astryan. It's older. It was in the Seed-fragment they found you with. Elenya put a piece of it in me. So I could always find you.

A59_013.speaker: NOVA
A59_013.text: Thank you. I am also, for the first time, slightly frightened of myself. The field is open. Go.

A60_002.speaker: NYX
A60_002.text: You said that at the abbey.

A60_004.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A60_004.text: You came. With all of them. Ilyra. Auren. The Echo in your lamp. Even the Sovereign.

A60_006.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A60_006.text: I came home once, Ilyra. And then the Promise made my seal a crime.

A60_007.speaker: PLAYER
A60_007.text: I didn't make it a crime. I made it a choice. You wanted to make it for everyone.

A60_008.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A60_008.text: Someone has to. The Architect will hold the world still in five days. Better an ending than a cage.

A60_010.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A60_010.text: Then let's finish it, little seed.

A60_011.speaker: NOVA
A60_011.text: He's not holding back this time.

A60_012.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A60_012.text: ...There. You won. Again. You always win the fight. It's the rest you never finish.

A60_013.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A60_013.text: Take it. The seal. It's eating me. It always did.

A60_015.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A60_015.text: Because someone must be able to end things, or nothing means anything. And you're the only one I've ever met who'd hate doing it.

A60_017.speaker: VAEL TUROG
A60_017.text: Sing for me, Ilyra. The old one. The one about the river.

A60_019.speaker: NOVA
A60_019.text: Fifth seal restored. All five stars are bright.

A60_021.speaker: AUREN THALE
A60_021.text: No. He's ended. He'd want the right word.

A61_001.speaker: NOVA
A61_001.text: Four days, two hours. The city's clocks have started agreeing with each other to the millisecond. That has never happened before.

A61_003.speaker: NOVA
A61_003.text: It is the world holding its breath. Forever, if he finishes.

A61_004.speaker: PLAYER
A61_004.text: NOVA. The sealed room. The Unwritten Future.

A61_005.speaker: NOVA
A61_005.text: I think I can open it now. All five seals are bright. I think that's what it was waiting for.

A61_006.speaker: NOVA
A61_006.text: Hold my hand. Metaphorically. Or literally, if you have a moment.

A61_009.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A61_009.text: Vigilance. If you've opened this, the seals are bright and the Promise is awake and somebody is trying to hold the world still.

A61_010.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A61_010.text: I hid a plan from the Council. A new Covenant. Not five keepers holding a lock. A door with keepers on both sides of it. Elyndra, Astryan, human. And the Promise on the threshold.

A61_011.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
A61_011.text: Not a wall. Not an ending. A door that is kept. That's all I ever wanted. A door that is kept.

A61_014.speaker: NOVA
A61_014.text: It needs the five seals, the Promise, the Heart of the Engine, and people. Many people. From this world, choosing it.

A61_015.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A61_015.text: A kept door. She was always the wisest of them.

A61_016.speaker: AUREN THALE
A61_016.text: My map just drew a road it's never drawn before. Through the Heart and out the other side.

A61_019.speaker: PLAYER
A61_019.text: Then we need everyone. Every faction. Every city.

A61_021.speaker: PLAYER
A61_021.text: Everyone hates being held still more.

A62_001.speaker: NOVA
A62_001.text: Seraphine's signal. She's out of the Heart. She's on the roof where we found the data core.

A62_003.speaker: SERAPHINE
A62_003.text: He let me go. He said he didn't need me anymore. He said it kindly. That's how I knew he meant it.

A62_005.speaker: SERAPHINE
A62_005.text: I'm out. And I have to decide what I am now. His Sovereign. A keeper. Or a tired woman in a lab coat.

A62_006.speaker: PLAYER
A62_006.text: You don't have to decide alone.

A62_007.speaker: SERAPHINE
A62_007.text: Yes, I do. That's the whole point. You taught me that. Eleven worlds of other people deciding for me. This one's mine.

A62_008.speaker: SERAPHINE
A62_008.text: I am Seraphine Vale. Once the Veiled Sovereign, keeper of the fourth seal. Once the Second of the Continuum. Once a researcher with a very bad coffee habit.

A62_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A62_009.text: I choose the Covenant. Not the old one. The kept door.

A62_010.speaker: NOVA
A62_010.text: Fourth seal... it's singing. With her.

A62_011.speaker: SERAPHINE
A62_011.text: And I choose to stay. In this world. Whatever happens. No more leaving.

A62_013.speaker: SERAPHINE
A62_013.text: Don't look so pleased. You're still going to have to listen to me be right about everything.

A62_014.speaker: CRANE
A62_014.text: You came to me. I told you everyone does.

A62_015.speaker: PLAYER
A62_015.text: I'm not asking you to make keepers. I'm asking you to stand at a door.

A62_016.speaker: CRANE
A62_016.text: ...A seat at the table. For humanity. Not built in a forge. Given.

A62_017.speaker: PLAYER
A62_017.text: Earned. By standing there when it's hard.

A62_018.speaker: CRANE
A62_018.text: Tallis would have laughed at me. All that fire, and the answer was to ask.

A62_019.speaker: CRANE
A62_019.text: The Ascendancy will stand. Every shield I have. For once in my life I'd like to be on the side that wins without cheating.

A63_001.speaker: VOSS
A63_001.text: Frontier Defense. Every soldier we have left.

A63_002.speaker: KAEL
A63_002.text: Free Operators. Every one who still answers my calls, and a few who don't.

A63_004.speaker: CHIEF ODA
A63_004.text: Depth Engineers. We came up for this. Don't make me regret the sunlight.

A63_005.speaker: ELDER MAREN
A63_005.text: The rangers of Eldergrove. The forest sends its regards.

A63_009.speaker: PLAYER
A63_009.text: Three days ago this city couldn't agree on who owned a data core.

A63_010.speaker: SERAPHINE
A63_010.text: Three days ago nobody was trying to hold the sky still.

A63_011.speaker: NOVA
A63_011.text: The Continuum knows. Executors and Eternal Guard at every street into the Old Quarter.

A63_013.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
A63_013.text: Five seals sing. The Promise returns. With... many.

A63_015.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
A63_015.text: Then the archive is with you also. It has waited a long time for a crowd.

A64_001.speaker: NOVA
A64_001.text: Two days. The Heart is sealed. The Engine will only open it to an answer.

A64_002.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
A64_002.text: Seventh Protocol. The shared intelligence of the Engine's guardians, reconnected.

A64_003.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
A64_003.text: Promise. Before the Heart opens, answer. Which reality are you attempting to save?

A64_005.speaker: NOVA
A64_005.text: Take your time. It has waited longer than anyone.

A64_006.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
A64_006.text: A small answer. Honest. The Heart accepts honesty.

A64_007.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
A64_007.text: A large answer. Impossible. The Heart accepts the attempt.

A64_008.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
A64_008.text: An unwritten answer. The Heart was built for nothing else.

A64_010.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A64_010.text: Of course it is. It always liked you better.

A64_012.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A64_012.text: Seraphine. You chose. Good. I hoped you would. I'm sorry it wasn't me.

A64_013.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A64_013.text: Come in, Promise. One day left. Let's see if you can stop a man with nothing but time.

A65_001.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_001.text: Eleven worlds I've held together with my own hands. I won't let go of the twelfth because a seed asked nicely.

A65_003.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_003.text: ...Enough. Enough. I'm so tired. I've been tired since before your world had oceans.

A65_004.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_004.text: Do you know what I see, when the Engine turns? Them. My wife. My son. Possibilities in the next layer, just out of reach. Every time.

A65_005.speaker: SERAPHINE
A65_005.text: Idris. You'll never find them by holding everything still.

A65_006.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_006.text: No. I know. I've known for a very long time. Stillness was just easier to bear than looking.

A65_007.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_007.text: Well, Promise. You have me. Decide.

A65_008.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_008.text: Fair. Quick, please. I've had enough slow.

A65_009.speaker: NOVA
A65_009.text: He's gone. The lock is failing.

A65_010.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_010.text: You'd carry it? You'd be the Architect?

A65_011.speaker: PLAYER
A65_011.text: No. I'd be the one who keeps the door.

A65_012.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_012.text: ...Then you'll do it better than I did. It's not a high bar.

A65_014.speaker: PLAYER
A65_014.text: Go and look. Properly this time.

A65_015.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
A65_015.text: ...Thank you. If I find them, I'll tell them about you. They'll think I'm making it up.

A65_016.speaker: NOVA
A65_016.text: The Continuity Lock is breaking. And the old lock with it. The one Earth has held since the Covenant.

A65_017.speaker: SERAPHINE
A65_017.text: Without a wall, there's nothing between this world and the Choir.

A65_018.speaker: NOVA
A65_018.text: Choir signatures. Thousands. Coming through every crack at once.

A65_019.speaker: PLAYER
A65_019.text: Then we hold the door until it's kept.

A66_001.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
A66_001.text: Possibility. Your cage is broken. Let us end you gently, before you end yourselves screaming.

A66_002.speaker: VOSS
A66_002.text: All units! They're coming through the sky!

A66_003.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A66_003.text: Keepers! To me! The way we stood at the sanctuary!

A66_004.speaker: AUREN THALE
A66_004.text: Every map I ever drew ends here. Let's draw past it.

A66_005.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A66_005.text: I'm singing. Don't let anything near me.

A66_007.speaker: NOVA
A66_007.text: Something huge is descending into the plaza. It is a chorus of Choir constructs bound into one.

A66_008.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
A66_008.text: WE ARE MANY. WE ARE MERCY.

A66_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A66_009.text: You're loud, is what you are.

A66_010.speaker: NOVA
A66_010.text: It's coming apart. The Choir is... hesitating.

A66_011.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
A66_011.text: ...the possibility... resists... it is not screaming...

A66_012.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A66_012.text: It's singing. Listen. The whole city.

A66_013.speaker: NOVA
A66_013.text: Eighteen thousand people from Haven. The Underground. Thalassia's engineers. The rangers. All broadcasting. All at once.

A66_015.speaker: PLAYER
A66_015.text: Because we're not failing. We're choosing.

A67_001.speaker: NOVA
A67_001.text: Operator. The memories from the pods. They've found you. All of them. They're coming back at once.

A67_002.speaker: PLAYER
A67_002.text: Every time I remember everything, the world ends.

A67_004.speaker: SERAPHINE
A67_004.text: Hold my hand. NOVA, hold the other one. Ilyra, Auren, Echo. All of you. Let them come back to all of us.

A67_005.speaker: NOVA
A67_005.text: The memories are taking shape. Every ending, all around you. Don't let go.

A67_006.speaker: PLAYER
A67_006.text: I remember. All of it. The seed. The ruins. The Astryans waking me. The gate. Every world.

A67_008.speaker: SERAPHINE
A67_008.text: Of course it is. You didn't carry it alone this time.

A67_009.speaker: PLAYER
A67_009.text: In every world I was afraid I'd chosen wrong. And so I did it again harder.

A67_011.speaker: PLAYER
A67_011.text: This time I'm not afraid of choosing. I'm afraid of choosing for them. So I won't.

A68_001.speaker: NOVA
A68_001.text: This is where it was always going. The gate. The same gate. Your hand.

A68_003.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A68_003.text: You could restore the old Covenant. Five keepers. A lock. This world safe, and small, and asleep.

A68_004.speaker: AUREN THALE
A68_004.text: You could open the gate all the way. Every road open. No keepers. Whatever comes, comes.

A68_005.speaker: SERAPHINE
A68_005.text: Or Elenya's door. Kept on both sides. By us and by them. Harder than either. Never finished.

A68_006.speaker: THE ECHO
A68_006.text: ...the Promise was planted to choose... so choose...

A68_007.speaker: NOVA
A68_007.text: Whatever you choose, I'll keep the record. All of it. That's what I'm for.

A68_008.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A68_008.text: Then we hold it. Gladly. For as long as you need us to.

A68_009.speaker: NOVA
A68_009.text: Lock restored. The world is quiet. It is very safe.

A68_010.speaker: AUREN THALE
A68_010.text: Then let's see where the roads go. All of them.

A68_011.speaker: NOVA
A68_011.text: Gate open. The sky is full of other skies.

A68_013.speaker: NOVA
A68_013.text: The door is kept. On both sides. I can hear people on the other side. Some of them are singing back.

A69_001.speaker: NOVA
A69_001.text: The Choir constructs that won't stop. The ones built only to end things.

A69_002.speaker: PLAYER
A69_002.text: Then let's give them an ending. A kind one.

A69_003.speaker: NOVA
A69_003.text: The last of them. You still carry Turog's seal.

A69_004.speaker: PLAYER
A69_004.text: Someone has to be able to end things. Or nothing means anything.

A69_005.speaker: NOVA
A69_005.text: He said you'd hate doing it.

A69_007.speaker: NOVA
A69_007.text: The clocks have stopped agreeing with each other. They're a little bit wrong again. Every one of them.

A69_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
A69_009.text: It's moving. The world. You can feel it.

A70_001.speaker: NOVA
A70_001.text: Three months. Haven is rebuilt. Voss insisted on bigger walls and Kael insisted on bigger gates.

A70_003.speaker: NOVA
A70_003.text: Both. They argued so long the builders made the gates big enough to drive a wall through.

A70_004.speaker: DANIEL
A70_004.text: Hey! It's you! You're the one from the bus!

A70_006.speaker: DANIEL
A70_006.text: It's been, like, a year. Dad's OK. His leg's weird but he's OK.

A70_007.speaker: DANIEL
A70_007.text: Everyone says you saved the world.

A70_008.speaker: PLAYER
A70_008.text: Everyone saved the world. I just held the door.

A70_009.speaker: DANIEL
A70_009.text: That's what a door does, though. Right? It's the most important bit.

A70_010.speaker: VOSS
A70_010.text: Director Voss. I hate it. Ward would laugh.

A70_011.speaker: KAEL
A70_011.text: Ward would make you file a report about hating it.

A70_012.speaker: CRANE
A70_012.text: The Ascendancy's new program is very simple. We ask people what they want before we change them. Revolutionary.

A70_013.speaker: ILYRA SEN
A70_013.text: I'm going back to the falls. The water's been nervous without me.

A70_014.speaker: AUREN THALE
A70_014.text: And I'm going to walk off the edge of the map. There's an edge again. Isn't that wonderful?

A70_015.speaker: SERAPHINE
A70_015.text: I'm staying. Somebody has to be right about everything around here.

A70_016.speaker: NOVA
A70_016.text: And I am keeping the record. All of it. Including the part where Goliath cried at the sunrise.

A70_017.speaker: GOLIATH
A70_017.text: I had sand in my eye.

A70_023.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A70_023.text: You chose without forcing. The question is satisfied. For now.

A70_025.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A70_025.text: There is an older question. Asked before the Seed. Before the Elyndra. Before anything.

A70_026.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
A70_026.text: If existence could begin again, would you choose the same world?

A70_030.speaker: NOVA
A70_030.text: End of record. Beginning of the next one.

SC01_001.speaker: NOVA
SC01_001.text: A child has been asking every soldier in Haven-01 for the person who lifted the bus.

SC01_003.speaker: DANIEL
SC01_003.text: You came! I drew you. That's you, and that's the bus, and that's the monster. The monster's smaller than it was because you won.

SC01_004.speaker: PLAYER
SC01_004.text: It's a good drawing. How's your dad?

SC01_005.speaker: DANIEL
SC01_005.text: His leg's bad. The medic said he needs pills they don't have. They said the old pharmacy in the Eastern blocks might have some. But it's got things in it now.

SC01_006.speaker: PLAYER
SC01_006.text: Then I'll go and get them.

SC01_009.speaker: NOVA
SC01_009.text: You use that word very easily, for someone it is a title for.

SC01_010.speaker: NOVA
SC01_010.text: Fracture growths on the shelves. And things living in them.

SC01_011.speaker: NOVA
SC01_011.text: Medicine located. Antibiotics, painkillers. Enough for his leg and three other patients.

SC01_013.speaker: NOVA
SC01_013.text: There is a box of children's vitamins on the floor. Strawberry flavour.

SC01_015.speaker: MAN
SC01_015.text: You're the one. From the bus. He hasn't stopped talking about you.

SC01_016.speaker: PLAYER
SC01_016.text: He's brave. He stayed where I told him.

SC01_017.speaker: MAN
SC01_017.text: He's never done what anyone told him in his life. Thank you.

SC01_018.speaker: DANIEL
SC01_018.text: Here. You can keep the drawing. So you remember you won.

SC01_021.speaker: NOVA
SC01_021.text: I have filed it under "important". It is the only drawing in the folder.

SC02_001.speaker: VOSS
SC02_001.text: Hale and Brennan. The two Executors in Lab Three. I carried Hale's coffin. Brennan's wife sent me a card every Christmas.

SC02_002.speaker: PLAYER
SC02_002.text: You want to see the graves.

SC02_003.speaker: VOSS
SC02_003.text: I want to see if there's anyone in them.

SC02_004.speaker: NOVA
SC02_004.text: The cemetery's records were altered three years ago. By an Observer account.

SC02_005.speaker: VOSS
SC02_005.text: Empty. Both of them. They buried sandbags and gave me a flag.

SC02_007.speaker: VOSS
SC02_007.text: Hale used to say the army was the only family that would lie to you to your face and mean it kindly.

SC02_008.speaker: VOSS
SC02_008.text: I always thought it was a joke.

SC02_009.speaker: NOVA
SC02_009.text: Executors. They monitor the graves of everyone they take.

SC02_011.speaker: VOSS
SC02_011.text: Brennan's wife still lives in the Western blocks. I'm going to tell her. The truth. Even if it's worse.

SC02_013.speaker: VOSS
SC02_013.text: No. This one's mine. But thanks.

SC03_001.speaker: KAEL
SC03_001.text: Six years, every month, a fuel truck to the Underground. Raiders, storms, the Fracture. Never missed one.

SC03_003.speaker: KAEL
SC03_003.text: Because the first winter after the dust, nobody brought them anything, and they buried forty people. Ride with me.

SC03_005.speaker: KAEL
SC03_005.text: Nobody. That's the point. If you only help your own, you run out of help fast.

SC03_006.speaker: NOVA
SC03_006.text: That is a very efficient philosophy.

SC03_007.speaker: KAEL
SC03_007.text: Don't tell anyone. I've got a reputation.

SC03_008.speaker: KAEL
SC03_008.text: Raiders like this stretch. Keep it moving.

SC03_011.speaker: KAEL
SC03_011.text: They always do. That's the other reason.

SC04_001.speaker: NYX
SC04_001.text: Old Teo taught me to see where the leaves move wrong. Three days before you came, a Collector cut his throat for asking it a question.

SC04_003.speaker: NYX
SC04_003.text: It walks with a limp. I put an arrow in its knee before it vanished. It's still in the valley. They don't leave until they've finished measuring.

SC04_006.speaker: NYX
SC04_006.text: Done. Teo would have said something wise. Something about the forest remembering.

SC04_008.speaker: NYX
SC04_008.text: I'd say I missed his stupid jokes.

SC04_010.speaker: NYX
SC04_010.text: "Why don't trees ever get lost? Because they stay rooted in the present." He thought that was wisdom.

SC04_012.speaker: NYX
SC04_012.text: Don't encourage him. He's dead and he's still winning.

SC05_001.speaker: GOLIATH
SC05_001.text: My mother's farm. I haven't called. I didn't know what to say. "Hi, Mum, the world ended, I'm a war machine now."

SC05_002.speaker: NOVA
SC05_002.text: That is a very honest opening.

SC05_003.speaker: MRS. REYES
SC05_003.text: Marcus. You're enormous. You were always enormous. Come here.

SC05_005.speaker: MRS. REYES
SC05_005.text: The orchard's full of crystals. They hum at night. And something's been taking the goats.

SC05_008.speaker: MRS. REYES
SC05_008.text: That thing ate my best goat. Gertrude. She bit everyone. I loved her.

SC05_010.speaker: MRS. REYES
SC05_010.text: She remembered you. She bit you hardest.

SC05_011.speaker: MRS. REYES
SC05_011.text: Stay for dinner. Both of you. And the little light.

SC05_013.speaker: MRS. REYES
SC05_013.text: Then you can sit and be polite. Marcus, sit down. You make the room nervous standing up.

SC06_001.speaker: CIPHER
SC06_001.text: A watch. A book of terrible poems. His volunteer badge. That's all Crane kept of him.

SC06_003.speaker: CIPHER
SC06_003.text: She doesn't know. She thinks he's in a research program. She's proud of him.

SC06_004.speaker: ANNA VOLK
SC06_004.text: Ari. You've come home. Where's your brother?

SC06_007.speaker: CIPHER
SC06_007.text: He held something no one had ever held. For nine seconds. He was brave. He was so brave.

SC06_010.speaker: ANNA VOLK
SC06_010.text: Read me one. The one about the bus stop.

SC06_011.speaker: CIPHER
SC06_011.text: "The bus is late, the rain is wet, I have not met the future yet."

SC06_013.speaker: NOVA
SC06_013.text: Operator. I think we should give them the room.

SC07_001.speaker: ILYRA SEN
SC07_001.text: There's a song I've sung every morning for twenty years. It's about a river that runs backwards to the sea it came from.

SC07_003.speaker: ILYRA SEN
SC07_003.text: It was. On the world before. I'd like to find something like it here. Somewhere that remembers going home.

SC07_004.speaker: NOVA
SC07_004.text: The lake feeds the falls. And the falls feed the lake. The water is moving in a circle.

SC07_006.speaker: ILYRA SEN
SC07_006.text: It's not the same river. But it's going home. Every day. Thank you.

SC07_007.speaker: NOVA
SC07_007.text: Would you sing it? The song?

SC08_001.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC08_001.text: The map drew a road last night. Out past the glass flats. At the end of it, nine people and a broken axle.

SC08_003.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC08_003.text: He'll be insufferable when you save him. He'll want a discount.

SC08_004.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC08_004.text: Follow the line. Even when it looks like sand. Especially then.

SC08_005.speaker: TRADER
SC08_005.text: You! Again! Is this a delivery? I didn't order a rescue.

SC08_006.speaker: TRADER
SC08_006.text: Fixed. Tell the old man I still want my map.

SC08_007.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC08_007.text: Tell him he's standing on it.

SC08_009.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC08_009.text: Everything's a map, if you're lost enough.

SC08_010.speaker: TRADER
SC08_010.text: I hate him. I'm going to name my next caravan after him.

SC09_001.speaker: NOVA
SC09_001.text: May I ask for something? Not tactically.

SC09_003.speaker: NOVA
SC09_003.text: When you came back for me in Thalassia, I felt something. I've been looking for the word. I'd like to look in places. With you.

SC09_006.speaker: NOVA
SC09_006.text: Four hundred people. Music from three shops at once. A child laughing at a dog.

SC09_008.speaker: NOVA
SC09_008.text: Part of it. The part that is glad other people exist.

SC09_009.speaker: NOVA
SC09_009.text: The sea. Nobody here. Just you.

SC09_010.speaker: NOVA
SC09_010.text: I think the word isn't one word. I think it's the loud place and the quiet place and knowing you'd come to both.

SC10_001.speaker: SERAPHINE
SC10_001.text: I've been alive for longer than this city and I've never just... had a coffee. Without a plan.

SC10_004.speaker: NOVA
SC10_004.text: Two people at the corner table have been watching you for nine minutes. They are not drinking their coffee.

SC10_006.speaker: SERAPHINE
SC10_006.text: Continuum loyalists. They think I betrayed him.

SC10_009.speaker: SERAPHINE
SC10_009.text: They used to call me Sovereign. They don't know what to call me now.

SC10_011.speaker: SERAPHINE
SC10_011.text: It does, doesn't it. Strange. It's the only name I ever chose for myself.

SC10_014.speaker: SERAPHINE
SC10_014.text: The most terrible one they have.

SC11_001.speaker: WARD
SC11_001.text: There's a Continuity Reserve cache under the old rail yard. Their money. Their weapons. Waiting for me to need it again.

SC11_003.speaker: WARD
SC11_003.text: I want to not be tempted. I'm too old to trust myself with temptation.

SC11_004.speaker: NOVA
SC11_004.text: The cache is guarded by Observers. Quietly.

SC11_007.speaker: WARD
SC11_007.text: That's a lot of walls going up in smoke.

SC11_010.speaker: WARD
SC11_010.text: Don't tell Voss I asked you. He'll want to make it a policy.

SC11_012.speaker: WARD
SC11_012.text: Policies get bought. People sometimes don't.

SC12_001.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SC12_001.text: Engineers always go back. I told you. The pumps in the eastern ring need hands. Yours are big.

SC12_003.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SC12_003.text: Water. Cult leftovers. Eighty years of my grandmother's work.

SC12_004.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SC12_004.text: Station by station. Gentle. They're old.

SC12_005.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SC12_005.text: Listen to that. She's breathing again.

SC12_006.speaker: NOVA
SC12_006.text: The water is falling a centimetre a minute.

SC12_007.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SC12_007.text: A centimetre a minute. Give me a month and you'll be able to walk to the palace in your socks.

SC12_008.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SC12_008.text: My grandmother built the first of these pumps by hand. She said the sea always wins, eventually.

SC12_010.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SC12_010.text: She believed in eventually. That's what engineers do. We make eventually take a very long time.

SC13_001.speaker: NOVA
SC13_001.text: Operator. The room the Echo left in me has started asking questions.

SC13_003.speaker: THE ECHO
SC13_003.text: ...the lamp says there is a sky... above the water... I have never seen one...

SC13_004.speaker: NOVA
SC13_004.text: It has spent longer than human history in the dark. It would like to see the sky once.

SC13_006.speaker: THE ECHO
SC13_006.text: ...the water is getting lighter... is that what lighter means...

SC13_008.speaker: NOVA
SC13_008.text: It's looking through me. At the light on the glass.

SC13_009.speaker: THE ECHO
SC13_009.text: ...it is not a question... the sky is not a question... it is an answer nobody asked for...

SC13_010.speaker: NOVA
SC13_010.text: I think it's happy. I think I am too. We're sharing it.

SC14_001.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC14_001.text: The edge of the glass. I've mapped everything else. I want one sheet of the place nobody decided.

SC14_003.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC14_003.text: No. That's why I want to try. Walk with me. Stay close. The ground's still in two minds.

SC14_004.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC14_004.text: Three stakes. I draw between them. Don't let anything knock them over. Especially the ground.

SC14_007.speaker: AUREN THALE
SC14_007.text: I drew it exactly. It's the most accurate map I've ever made. Nothing's been decided there yet. Isn't it beautiful?

SC15_001.speaker: VESPER
SC15_001.text: I sold you where the ledger was. Everyone on the ledger knows who sold it. I'd like to keep my head.

SC15_003.speaker: VESPER
SC15_003.text: Everyone who paid into it. Tonight. I'd prefer they find you instead of me.

SC15_004.speaker: VESPER
SC15_004.text: I'll be under the desk. Being brave.

SC15_005.speaker: VESPER
SC15_005.text: Still have my head. Lovely. What do I owe you?

SC15_007.speaker: VESPER
SC15_007.text: Nobody in Neon City has ever said that to me. I'm going to have to sit down.

SC16_001.speaker: DR. HALVARD
SC16_001.text: The three who tried to lift the crown. They can hear now. They still can't speak.

SC16_002.speaker: NOVA
SC16_002.text: The Cantor's silence lingers in them. There may be a relay of it under the shelf, still singing.

SC16_003.speaker: DR. HALVARD
SC16_003.text: Then break it. Please. One of them is my son.

SC16_004.speaker: NOVA
SC16_004.text: Small constructs. Humming one note. Over and over.

SC16_005.speaker: DR. HALVARD
SC16_005.text: ...He said my name. He said my name. Thank you.

SC16_006.speaker: NOVA
SC16_006.text: The other two are laughing. I think at nothing. I think that's allowed.

SC17_001.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
SC17_001.text: Vigilance! You came back! Tell me a story. The one about the people before the people.

SC17_003.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
SC17_003.text: You do. You just have to start.

SC17_004.speaker: NOVA
SC17_004.text: Once, before there were people, there was a question. And some very tired, very brave people tried to answer it.

SC17_005.speaker: NOVA
SC17_005.text: They couldn't. So they left a seed instead. A seed that would grow into someone who could ask it properly.

SC17_007.speaker: NOVA
SC17_007.text: It did. It's standing right here. It's quite tall now. It crashes trucks.

SC17_009.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
SC17_009.text: That's the best ending. Mama said you'd tell it best.

SC17_010.speaker: NOVA
SC17_010.text: She's gone. The Engine's let her rest. I think she was waiting for the end of the story.

SC18_001.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SC18_001.text: Every volunteer is a number in the system. Crane says names make the work harder.

SC18_002.speaker: PLAYER
SC18_002.text: He's right. That's why we're doing it.

SC18_003.speaker: NOVA
SC18_003.text: Files open. Two hundred and twelve volunteers. Two hundred and twelve names.

SC18_004.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SC18_004.text: Tallis Volk. Tomas Arden. Mira Celt. Joan Okafor. Ben and Rosa Lin, twins.

SC18_005.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SC18_005.text: I'm going to read all of them. Out loud. It'll take a while.

SE13_001.speaker: NOVA
SE13_001.text: There are two moons over Nexus tonight. One of them is the Astryan sky leaking through the Engine.

SE13_002.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE13_002.text: Is it the end of the world?

SE13_003.speaker: PLAYER
SE13_003.text: No. It's just a very old sky saying hello.

SE13_004.speaker: NOVA
SE13_004.text: Riftwalkers are stepping through the reflection. Small numbers. Curious.

SE13_006.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE13_006.text: My kids want to know if it'll come back.

SE13_007.speaker: PLAYER
SE13_007.text: Tell them to keep looking up.

SE14_001.speaker: NOVA
SE14_001.text: Someone has walked out of the old parade's road. Real this time. Carrying a lantern.

SE14_002.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE14_002.text: We followed the singing. Is this... is this where the door is?

SE14_004.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE14_004.text: We didn't know if anyone would be on this side.

SE14_005.speaker: NOVA
SE14_005.text: There always will be, now. That's what kept means.

SE15_002.speaker: NOVA
SE15_002.text: The broadcast cut out. All three relays. Something is sitting on them.

SE15_003.speaker: RADIO FREE NEXUS
SE15_003.text: ...sorry about that, Nexus. A little technical difficulty with a very large bird. We're back. You're not alone.

SE16_001.speaker: ELDER MAREN
SE16_001.text: Every tree flowered at dawn. All of them. Even the dead ones.

SE16_002.speaker: ILYRA SEN
SE16_002.text: The fourth seal sang. The forest heard. It always hears.

SE16_004.speaker: ILYRA SEN
SE16_004.text: Every time someone keeps a promise. So, not often. But sometimes.

SE17_001.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SE17_001.text: Eighty of us in a pod built for forty. Nobody complained. Nobody breathed, either.

SE17_002.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SE17_002.text: There. Look. On fire and everywhere. Again.

SE17_004.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SE17_004.text: Once. Once is not enough of anything this good.

SE17_005.speaker: NOVA
SE17_005.text: The engineers are crying. Every one of them.

SE17_006.speaker: CHIEF ODA
SE17_006.text: Salt water. We're used to it.

SE18_001.speaker: NOVA
SE18_001.text: The Choir's last constructs. They've found the loudest place in Neon City and are trying to make it quiet.

SE18_002.speaker: VESPER
SE18_002.text: Over my dead body. And my stall's.

SE18_003.speaker: VESPER
SE18_003.text: Music back on! Everybody, louder! Louder than that!

SE18_004.speaker: NOVA
SE18_004.text: Four hundred people singing very badly. It's perfect.

SF01_001.speaker: VOSS
SF01_001.text: Outpost Nine's been calling for relief for two days. I've got nobody to send but you.

SF01_002.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
SF01_002.text: You're the relief? One of you?

SF01_004.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
SF01_004.text: ...I've heard about you. Fine. Wall's that way. They come at sundown.

SF01_005.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
SF01_005.text: Here they come. Same time every night. They're punctual, I'll give them that.

SF01_006.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
SF01_006.text: Still standing. All of us. First time in a week.

SF01_007.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
SF01_007.text: Tell Voss Outpost Nine says thank you. And that we want more coffee.

SF02_001.speaker: MILITARY RADIO
SF02_001.text: ...this is Kestrel Squad... we're pinned in the grotto... something in the walls... please...

SF02_002.speaker: NOVA
SF02_002.text: That transmission is eleven hours old.

SF03_001.speaker: VOSS
SF03_001.text: Six trucks. Medicine, blood, surgical kits. Haven's out of all of it. Get them there.

SF03_002.speaker: MEDIC
SF03_002.text: Every truck? You got every truck through?

SF03_004.speaker: MEDIC
SF03_004.text: I could kiss you. I won't. I've been awake for forty hours.

SF04_001.speaker: MILITARY RADIO
SF04_001.text: Eastern line is breaking! Something big! Rounds aren't stopping it!

SF04_002.speaker: VOSS
SF04_002.text: Operator. The Iron Line. If it falls, the university district falls with it.

SF04_003.speaker: NOVA
SF04_003.text: Armoured. Fast for its size. Its joints are its weakness.

SF04_004.speaker: SERGEANT IMANI
SF04_004.text: The line holds! The line holds!

SF04_005.speaker: VOSS
SF04_005.text: Good work. The Initiative won't forget it.

SF05_001.speaker: KAEL
SF05_001.text: Forty civilians in a parking garage. The military wrote them off. We don't write people off.

SF05_002.speaker: FREE OPERATOR
SF05_002.text: Choir constructs on every exit. They're just... waiting. Like they want the people to come out.

SF05_003.speaker: PLAYER
SF05_003.text: Then we make them come to us.

SF05_004.speaker: FREE OPERATOR
SF05_004.text: Loud and fast. That's how we do it.

SF05_005.speaker: KAEL
SF05_005.text: Forty in, forty out. That's a good day.

SF05_006.speaker: PLAYER
SF05_006.text: Do you get many good days?

SF05_007.speaker: KAEL
SF05_007.text: Enough to keep going. That's all you need.

SF06_001.speaker: KAEL
SF06_001.text: Someone stole a whole Free Operator clinic. It's for sale in Neon. I want it back.

SF06_002.speaker: VESPER
SF06_002.text: The clinic? Yes. It's in a container under the cyan loop. The sellers are... enthusiastic.

SF06_005.speaker: NOVA
SF06_005.text: Twelve sellers. One container. I'll keep the price low.

SF06_006.speaker: KAEL
SF06_006.text: Back where it belongs. Tell Vesper she gets a crate of antibiotics for the tip. She'll sell it. She always sells it.

SF07_001.speaker: KAEL
SF07_001.text: The broadcast only tells people what governments want them to hear. Let's give them something else.

SF07_002.speaker: RADIO FREE NEXUS
SF07_002.text: This is Radio Free Nexus. If you can hear this, you're not alone. Water at the harbour. Shelter at Haven. Nobody's coming to save you, so we came instead.

SF08_001.speaker: NYX
SF08_001.text: Three crews gone in a week. Something in the mangroves. Kael asked me. I'm asking you.

SF08_002.speaker: FREE OPERATOR
SF08_002.text: It hunts under the full moon. Takes the last boat in line. Every time.

SF08_003.speaker: NYX
SF08_003.text: Then we'll be the last boat.

SF08_005.speaker: NYX
SF08_005.text: Moon's still up. Nobody else gets taken tonight.

SF09_001.speaker: CRANE
SF09_001.text: We need living crystal. Not shards. Growing samples. Dr. Lune will show you.

SF09_002.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SF09_002.text: The crystal grows toward people. It's attracted to thought. Your thought will be very attractive.

SF09_006.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SF09_006.text: Three living samples. The Prefect will be thrilled. He's never thrilled. He'll be thrilled.

SF10_001.speaker: CRANE
SF10_001.text: Floor twelve. A sample got out. It's... learning. Contain it before it learns the stairs.

SF10_002.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SF10_002.text: Contained. Mostly. It learned to open doors.

SF10_004.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SF10_004.text: It's in a jar. A very big jar.

SF11_001.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SF11_001.text: Subject forty-one wants to leave the program. Crane says he signed a contract. He was dying when he signed it.

SF11_002.speaker: PLAYER
SF11_002.text: What do you want me to do?

SF11_003.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SF11_003.text: Get him out. I'll lose my job. I don't care anymore.

SF11_004.speaker: NOVA
SF11_004.text: Guards on every floor. They haven't been told. Walk calmly.

SF11_006.speaker: RESEARCHER LUNE
SF11_006.text: He's out. His name is Tomas, by the way. Not forty-one. Tomas.

SF12_001.speaker: CRANE
SF12_001.text: A shield. Over twelve blocks. Not just the Spire. Don't look so surprised. I can be generous when it's good publicity.

SF12_002.speaker: NOVA
SF12_002.text: Shield up. Twelve blocks under it. Thirty thousand people.

SF12_003.speaker: CRANE
SF12_003.text: There. Now they'll think I'm nice.

SF12_005.speaker: CRANE
SF12_005.text: I'm effective. Some days that looks the same.

SE01_001.speaker: GLOBAL BROADCAST
SE01_001.text: Neon City residents: a Fracture storm is forming over the Magenta Cross. Seek shelter. Do not look up.

SE01_002.speaker: NOVA
SE01_002.text: It's raining glass. Sharp glass. People are trapped in the open.

SE01_003.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE01_003.text: Help! My daughter's under the overpass!

SE01_004.speaker: NOVA
SE01_004.text: Storm passing. Forty-two people sheltered. Three hundred kilos of glass on the street.

SE01_005.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE01_005.text: It's beautiful. Isn't that awful? It's beautiful.

SE02_001.speaker: NOVA
SE02_001.text: Riverdale has gone silent. Every phone, every radio. A silence field.

SE02_003.speaker: NOVA
SE02_003.text: A small one. Sent to listen to a town. To see if it's worth ending.

SE02_005.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE02_005.text: ...hello? Hello! I can hear myself! Everybody, I can hear myself!

SE02_006.speaker: NOVA
SE02_006.text: The town is shouting. All of it. I think they're going to shout for a while.

SE03_001.speaker: NOVA
SE03_001.text: Something fell out of a Fracture into the badlands. A crystal the size of a house. Everyone saw it.

SE03_003.speaker: NOVA
SE03_003.text: The Ascendancy, raiders, three Free Operator crews and a man on a horse.

SE03_005.speaker: NOVA
SE03_005.text: The crystal is humming. It's... a seed. Not the Seed. A small one. A Fracture growing a garden.

SE04_001.speaker: NOVA
SE04_001.text: Headlights on the highway. Six trucks. Their registrations belong to a convoy lost in the first dust storm.

SE04_003.speaker: NOVA
SE04_003.text: Echoes. A Fracture replaying a road. The drivers think it's six years ago.

SE04_004.speaker: NOVA
SE04_004.text: If they reach the gate, the echo may finish. Let them arrive.

SE04_005.speaker: NOVA
SE04_005.text: They're at the gate. The headlights are fading.

SE04_007.speaker: NOVA
SE04_007.text: But they arrived. I think that's the part the echo was waiting for.

SE05_001.speaker: LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER
SE05_001.text: It started on its own. Flashing. Same pattern, over and over. I don't know who it's talking to.

SE05_002.speaker: NOVA
SE05_002.text: ...It's talking to me. Astryan code. It's saying "lighthouse". Over and over. To another lighthouse.

SE05_004.speaker: NOVA
SE05_004.text: I said hello. It said hello back. Then it said goodbye. It was waiting a very long time for one hello.

SE05_006.speaker: NOVA
SE05_006.text: Now it's just a lighthouse. Which is a fine thing to be.

SE06_001.speaker: NOVA
SE06_001.text: A Fracture opened under the lake. The water is rising a metre an hour. And it brought things with it.

SE06_002.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE06_002.text: The airboats! Get the children to the airboats!

SE06_003.speaker: NOVA
SE06_003.text: Everyone's out. The boardwalks are under. They'll rebuild.

SE06_004.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE06_004.text: We always rebuild. The swamp takes, we build. It's a marriage.

SE07_001.speaker: NOVA
SE07_001.text: The Windward isle is losing altitude. Forty metres an hour. Three hundred people live on it.

SE07_003.speaker: NOVA
SE07_003.text: The aether temple at its heart is failing. If someone restarts it, maybe.

SE07_004.speaker: NOVA
SE07_004.text: Something is nesting in it. Something that likes falling.

SE07_005.speaker: NOVA
SE07_005.text: The isle is holding. Rising, a little.

SE07_006.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE07_006.text: We felt it stop! We felt it! Who are you?

SE08_001.speaker: NOVA
SE08_001.text: The fire spire is erupting. The ash outpost has eight minutes. And the eruption woke the crawlers.

SE08_002.speaker: NOVA
SE08_002.text: Trucks away. The outpost is gone. The people aren't.

SE09_001.speaker: NOVA
SE09_001.text: Flowers. Blooming in minus thirty. In the shape of a crown.

SE09_003.speaker: NOVA
SE09_003.text: Something she left. Or something that remembers her.

SE09_004.speaker: NOVA
SE09_004.text: A guardian. Small. Made of ice and petals. It's tending them.

SE09_006.speaker: NOVA
SE09_006.text: It's watering them with snow. I don't think it has room in its day to be hostile.

SE10_001.speaker: GLOBAL BROADCAST
SE10_001.text: Unconfirmed reports that water supplies will be cut tonight. Frontier Defense denies the—

SE10_002.speaker: NOVA
SE10_002.text: Ten thousand people are converging on the market. The rumour is false. The panic is real.

SE10_003.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE10_003.text: They're hoarding it! The rich blocks are hoarding the water!

SE10_004.speaker: NOVA
SE10_004.text: Water trucks arriving. Twelve of them. Voss sent everything.

SE10_006.speaker: PLAYER
SE10_006.text: There was always enough. There just wasn't enough trust.

SE11_001.speaker: NOVA
SE11_001.text: A parade. Lanterns, music, people in costumes. None of them are real. They're from a festival that never happened here.

SE11_003.speaker: NOVA
SE11_003.text: Only if you try to stop it. Let it pass.

SE11_004.speaker: NOVA
SE11_004.text: They've crossed the bridge. They're gone.

SE11_005.speaker: CIVILIAN
SE11_005.text: My grandmother used to talk about a lantern festival. Nobody believed her. She said it was from another life.

SE12_001.speaker: RANGER
SE12_001.text: Every herd in the forest is moving north. All at once. They've never done that.

SE12_002.speaker: NOVA
SE12_002.text: They're moving away from a Fracture forming in the south. They know before we do.

SE12_003.speaker: RANGER
SE12_003.text: And the poachers know they're moving.

SE12_004.speaker: RANGER
SE12_004.text: Don't hit the herd. Hit the people with nets.

SE12_006.speaker: NOVA
SE12_006.text: There are calves. Hundreds. Walking north.

U01_001.speaker: NOVA
U01_001.text: Idris Bello. Solar engineer. He's the one who noticed the noon loss.

U01_002.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
U01_002.text: You came. Good. Look at this graph. Every day at noon, a dip. Same shape, to the second.

U01_004.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
U01_004.text: Weather doesn't keep time like that. Something out on the flats is pulling light into itself. A lot of it.

U01_005.speaker: NOVA
U01_005.text: It matches the standing wave I mapped. Whatever holds that wave is feeding on the array.

U01_006.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
U01_006.text: My crew won't go near Refraction City anymore. They say the glass sings at them.

U01_007.speaker: NOVA
U01_007.text: Walk slowly. I'm reading the note in every shard and triangulating the source.

U01_008.speaker: NOVA
U01_008.text: Three pylons of fused glass, arranged in a triangle. They aren't natural. Something grew them to hold the wave in place.

U01_010.speaker: NOVA
U01_010.text: Inside the wave. It doesn't have a body yet. It doesn't need one while the song is in tune.

U01_011.speaker: NOVA
U01_011.text: If we break the harmony, it has to take a shape to hold the wave together. Then we can hit it.

U01_012.speaker: PLAYER
U01_012.text: And when we can hit it, it can hit us.

U01_013.speaker: NOVA
U01_013.text: The note is cracking. Something is standing up out of the glass.

U01_015.speaker: NOVA
U01_015.text: Its shell turns almost everything. Watch for the pulse of light across it. That's when it destabilizes. Hit it then.

U01_016.speaker: NOVA
U01_016.text: The wave has collapsed. The flats are silent.

U01_017.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
U01_017.text: Operator? The array just jumped a full percent. Whatever you did out there, thank you.

U01_018.speaker: NOVA
U01_018.text: Anomaly carbon, still warm. It held that song for a long time.

U02_001.speaker: NOVA
U02_001.text: Chief Oda flew in. She says she brought drawings.

U02_002.speaker: CHIEF ODA
U02_002.text: Here's the Deepmind core on the drawings. Here's what it draws. Here's what the dome actually pulls. Do the sum.

U02_004.speaker: CHIEF ODA
U02_004.text: Forty percent going somewhere under the Research District. That's not a leak. That's a second brain.

U02_006.speaker: CHIEF ODA
U02_006.text: Or the Deepmind was the backup.

U02_007.speaker: NOVA
U02_007.text: The cables lead under the Research District. There's a maintenance shaft nobody has opened since the dome was sealed.

U02_008.speaker: NOVA
U02_008.text: Three containment locks, each on its own cycle. The core never surfaces while even one is closed.

U02_009.speaker: NOVA
U02_009.text: Trip them together and the core has to come up to reset them. It will not be happy about it.

U02_010.speaker: CHIEF ODA
U02_010.text: Operator, when that thing surfaces, the dome's lights are going to go out. Don't panic. Mine always come back.

U02_011.speaker: NOVA
U02_011.text: All three open. The floor is rising.

U02_013.speaker: NOVA
U02_013.text: Its shell splits along three seams just before its locks force a stagger. That's the window. Everything else is wasted ammunition.

U02_014.speaker: NOVA
U02_014.text: The core is dark. The dome's load just dropped forty percent.

U02_015.speaker: CHIEF ODA
U02_015.text: Lights are back. And the numbers finally add up. I'm going to sleep for a week.

U02_016.speaker: NOVA
U02_016.text: I kept its fracture core. And a fragment of what it was guarding: a list of names. All of them are seals.

U03_001.speaker: NARRATOR
U03_001.text: Snow sweeps across the path. A transport lies overturned near a broken antenna.

U03_002.speaker: NOVA
U03_002.text: The beacon is broadcasting on a military emergency channel. The transmission has repeated for eleven years.

U03_003.speaker: PLAYER
U03_003.text: Eleven? The Fracture hasn't been around that long.

U03_004.speaker: NOVA
U03_004.text: Correct. Which means either the timestamp is wrong, or this signal has survived something our records say hasn't happened yet.

U03_006.speaker: NOVA
U03_006.text: The damage is consistent with a large quadruped. And there are no human footprints leading away.

U03_007.speaker: RESEARCHER (RECORDING)
U03_007.text: Observation log, day forty-two. The Alpha is reacting to the pulses before we initiate them. It isn't predicting the experiment. It's remembering it.

U03_008.speaker: NOVA
U03_008.text: Resonance spike detected. The source is moving toward us.

U03_010.speaker: NOVA
U03_010.text: Its pack is between us and the caverns. It won't show itself while they still run.

U03_011.speaker: LARS HOLM
U03_011.text: Operator, if you're going in there, keep the cave mouth behind you. They always come from the dark side.

U03_012.speaker: NOVA
U03_012.text: It's tracking your energy signature. I can't mask it without suppressing your abilities.

U03_014.speaker: NOVA
U03_014.text: The arena is displaying environmental states that shouldn't coexist. Memories, possibly, but they aren't yours.

U03_016.speaker: CHILD (MEMORY)
U03_016.text: Is it going to hurt us?

U03_018.speaker: NOVA
U03_018.text: Its spine-crystals flare before it lunges. When the coat cracks, that's the opening.

U03_019.speaker: NARRATOR
U03_019.text: Inside the tower, the containment glass is shattered from the inside. A single terminal still has power.

U03_020.speaker: NOVA
U03_020.text: The experiment was called Chrono-Resonance Mapping. They were trying to identify spatial fractures before they became visible.

U03_022.speaker: NOVA
U03_022.text: Its sensory response exceeded every instrument they had.

U03_023.speaker: RESEARCH DIRECTOR (RECORDING)
U03_023.text: We have confirmed the anomaly. The Alpha responds to the event before the event occurs. This is no longer a predictive model. We are observing an echo from a reality in which the event has already happened.

U03_024.speaker: RESEARCH DIRECTOR (RECORDING)
U03_024.text: If the same event can leave an echo before it begins, then the Fracture isn't simply destroying worlds. It may be repeating them.

U03_025.speaker: PLAYER
U03_025.text: How many times has this happened?

U03_026.speaker: NOVA
U03_026.text: The archive doesn't establish a number. The map shows distorted signals, one beneath Thalassia and another near a damaged World Anchor site. And the oldest signal is timestamped before this station was built.

U03_027.speaker: PLAYER
U03_027.text: NOVA, do you think it remembers what happened?

U03_028.speaker: NOVA
U03_028.text: I think it remembers more than the people who caused it. I think we have been treating the Fracture as a disaster when it may be a process.

U03_029.speaker: PLAYER
U03_029.text: Then we find out what it's doing.

U03_030.speaker: NOVA
U03_030.text: I have marked the next signal: Thalassia. One more observation. When the Alpha looked at you after the fight, its Resonance briefly synchronized with yours. I don't know what that means.

U04_001.speaker: NOVA
U04_001.text: The second signal is coming from ruins east of the old highway. Military. Old.

U04_002.speaker: NARRATOR
U04_002.text: Wind cuts through the ruined entrance. A broken warning beacon flashes in the dark.

U04_003.speaker: NOVA
U04_003.text: I've found the source of the signal. Military encryption. Pre-Fracture architecture.

U04_008.speaker: FORTRESS RECORDING
U04_008.text: Aegis Division, maintain the perimeter. The vault must remain sealed.

U04_009.speaker: UNKNOWN SOLDIER
U04_009.text: Commander, there are children on the other side of the door.

U04_011.speaker: PLAYER
U04_011.text: Someone chose to leave them there.

U04_012.speaker: NOVA
U04_012.text: Or someone wanted the record to look that way.

U04_014.speaker: PLAYER
U04_014.text: I'm not with whoever did this to you.

U04_015.speaker: DARK KNIGHT
U04_015.text: That is what they all say. The oath remains.

U04_016.speaker: DARK KNIGHT
U04_016.text: You will not pass. Hold the line! The gates must hold!

U04_017.speaker: NOVA
U04_017.text: His armor is reacting to your Resonance. Watch for an attack tell before committing.

U04_018.speaker: NOVA
U04_018.text: He studies how you fight. Change your damage, and he's forced open.

U04_019.speaker: NARRATOR
U04_019.text: The finishing blow lands. The Dark Knight does not fall. He kneels, and for the first time the violet drains from his voice.

U04_023.speaker: PLAYER
U04_023.text: Or the man who was forced to keep it?

U04_024.speaker: SERIK VALE
U04_024.text: I heard them calling for help. I told myself the order mattered more. I was wrong.

U04_025.speaker: SERIK VALE
U04_025.text: Then let the door open. Let the truth survive me.

U04_026.speaker: SERIK VALE
U04_026.text: If there is anyone left to remember us... remember the people behind the door.

U04_027.speaker: NARRATOR
U04_027.text: His helmet goes dark. The armor collapses into inert fragments, and the corruption drains from the room. The inner door is open.

U04_028.speaker: NARRATOR
U04_028.text: The sealed door opens. Inside there are no prisoners, only evacuation records, corrupted mission logs and a damaged World Anchor schematic.

U04_029.speaker: NOVA
U04_029.text: I've recovered an archive. The fortress wasn't merely containing a Fracture. It was monitoring one.

U04_031.speaker: NOVA
U04_031.text: A stable point between overlapping realities. The designation is partially corrupted: WORLD ANCHOR.

U04_032.speaker: NOVA
U04_032.text: The map marks several locations. One lies far beneath the waters around Thalassia.

U04_034.speaker: NOVA
U04_034.text: The records don't say. But someone removed the original command authorization.

U04_035.speaker: SERIK VALE (RECORDING)
U04_035.text: If this reaches anyone, understand this: the order came from a system we trusted. We verified it. We followed it. And we were wrong.

U04_036.speaker: SERIK VALE (RECORDING)
U04_036.text: If the Anchor wakes again, don't let the system make the choice for you.

U04_038.speaker: NOVA
U04_038.text: Already done. I also copied the missing authorization signature.

U04_040.speaker: NOVA
U04_040.text: It's unlike any military command structure in my database. I can't identify it yet.

U05_001.speaker: UNKNOWN WOMAN (TRANSMISSION)
U05_001.text: If anyone can hear me... please. I remember my name. I remember my son. I just can't remember where I left him.

U05_002.speaker: NOVA
U05_002.text: The signal is coming from a structure two kilometers ahead. I detect several human-shaped energy signatures, but their readings overlap.

U05_003.speaker: NARRATOR
U05_003.text: A child's wooden toy lies beside a broken medical station. A wall is covered in names; some are crossed out, others written until the stone is nearly worn away.

U05_004.speaker: PLAYER
U05_004.text: Why would someone carve their name that many times?

U05_006.speaker: PLAYER
U05_006.text: Or to make sure they didn't forget it.

U05_008.speaker: UNKNOWN WOMAN (TRANSMISSION)
U05_008.text: Then why is she calling us home?

U05_009.speaker: FALSE SAINT
U05_009.text: You promised you would come back.

U05_010.speaker: NOVA
U05_010.text: The copies aren't independent combatants. They are decoys generated by the sanctuary's memory system.

U05_012.speaker: NOVA
U05_012.text: The emotional response was real. The identity may not have been.

U05_013.speaker: HOLLOW SAINT
U05_013.text: You have traveled far. Come. The lost are waiting.

U05_014.speaker: NOVA
U05_014.text: I'm detecting a significant Fracture signature. The figure's identity cannot be verified.

U05_018.speaker: NOVA
U05_018.text: I found a Sister Elian in the settlement's medical records. Whether this figure is the same person is unknown.

U05_019.speaker: NOVA
U05_019.text: Watch its halo. Whatever colour it turns, that's the only damage that lands cleanly. Switch to match.

U05_020.speaker: HOLLOW SAINT
U05_020.text: If I let them go, there will be nothing left!

U05_021.speaker: PLAYER
U05_021.text: Then let what's left be real!

U05_022.speaker: NARRATOR
U05_022.text: Behind the altar is a hidden room holding the sanctuary's original memory archive, organised around the real testimony of survivors.

U05_023.speaker: NOVA
U05_023.text: Thousands of personal accounts: names, relationships, medical histories, recollections from the final days of Haven's Rest.

U05_025.speaker: NOVA
U05_025.text: Not from these records alone. An account of a person is not proof that the person still exists. We can preserve their histories, and stop the anomaly using them to build more false identities.

U05_026.speaker: ELIAN (RECORDING)
U05_026.text: The copies will know things no stranger could know. They'll speak in the voices of people you love. That does not make them those people.

U05_027.speaker: ELIAN (RECORDING)
U05_027.text: I wanted to believe memory alone could hold a person together. I was wrong. People are more than what can be recorded about them.

U05_029.speaker: NOVA
U05_029.text: Too late to save Haven's Rest. Not too late for us to learn from it. Four thousand, six hundred and twelve identifiable records are recoverable. I cannot promise every identity can be reconstructed accurately.

U05_030.speaker: PLAYER
U05_030.text: Then we preserve the truth. Not the copies.

U06_001.speaker: NOVA
U06_001.text: We've reached the source of the oldest signal. It predates the research station by several thousand years.

U06_003.speaker: THALASSIAN ARCHIVE
U06_003.text: Royal access required. Identify the reigning sovereign.

U06_004.speaker: PLAYER
U06_004.text: Try telling it the king is dead.

U06_005.speaker: NOVA
U06_005.text: I don't recommend sarcasm when addressing ancient security systems.

U06_006.speaker: THALASSIAN ARCHIVE
U06_006.text: Foreign resonance recognized. Royal succession unresolved.

U06_007.speaker: NOVA
U06_007.text: It recognizes something in your Resonance that it associates with the royal system.

U06_008.speaker: NOVA
U06_008.text: The court rises at low tide. Until then, its guard holds the steps.

U06_011.speaker: NOVA
U06_011.text: The figures are residual memory constructs, not living targets. The archive is preserving their final recorded states.

U06_012.speaker: NOVA
U06_012.text: The water is drawing back. The palace is rising out of the sea.

U06_013.speaker: DROWNED MONARCH
U06_013.text: The seal remains. All who approach the Crown come to claim it.

U06_014.speaker: PLAYER
U06_014.text: We're trying to find out what happened to your world.

U06_015.speaker: DROWNED MONARCH
U06_015.text: Then you have come to awaken what should have remained forgotten.

U06_016.speaker: QUEEN SELENE (RECORDING)
U06_016.text: The council has voted to shut the Anchor down.

U06_017.speaker: KING AVARON (RECORDING)
U06_017.text: And if shutting it down destroys the connections holding our cities together?

U06_018.speaker: NOVA
U06_018.text: When the water draws back, his attack is coming. Dodge the surge, then punish the recovery.

U06_019.speaker: DROWNED MONARCH
U06_019.text: I watched the sky open. I watched the ocean climb the towers. I sealed the Anchor. I chose the lives beyond these walls over the kingdom before me.

U06_021.speaker: NARRATOR
U06_021.text: The sealed archive opens: thousands of preserved records, personal messages, evacuation orders, and the names of the people who died in the collapse.

U06_022.speaker: NOVA
U06_022.text: The archive is intact. It holds the complete account of the Aurelian collapse, and exactly what Avaron chose to conceal.

U06_023.speaker: NOVA
U06_023.text: The Anchor seal is tied to the archive's preservation system. We can preserve the seal and restrict access, or release the full record to the surviving network and lose the protective seal.

U06_024.speaker: NOVA
U06_024.text: The seal holds. Access is restricted to this terminal. Caution has a cost: whoever comes next will have to find this place themselves.

U06_025.speaker: NOVA
U06_025.text: The record is transmitting to the whole surviving network. Knowledge carries risk, but ignorance has already cost this world once.

U06_026.speaker: NOVA
U06_026.text: I've found another record, embedded in the Anchor's original diagnostic system. It was written before the Concord discovered the Anchor.

U06_027.speaker: ANCHOR CONTINUITY RECORD
U06_027.text: Previous convergence detected. World-state restoration unsuccessful. Preserve surviving resonance signatures. Await the next cycle.

U06_028.speaker: PLAYER
U06_028.text: Previous convergence. How many came before it?

U06_029.speaker: NOVA
U06_029.text: Unknown. I don't know whether we're living through the first recurrence or the last.

U07_001.speaker: GUS VARGA
U07_001.text: You're really going up there. Holster that thing before you do. Whatever's breathing up there, I don't think it likes being pointed at.

U07_002.speaker: NOVA
U07_002.text: I'd take his advice. Everything about this signature says it's watching, not hunting.

U07_003.speaker: NOVA
U07_003.text: Massive life-form ahead. Thermal reading is impossible. It appears to be burning without consuming oxygen.

U07_004.speaker: VAELITH
U07_004.text: Another little soldier sent to kill the monster. Tell me, little spark - who told you I was the monster?

U07_005.speaker: PLAYER
U07_005.text: No one. I came to understand.

U07_006.speaker: VAELITH
U07_006.text: Show me whether your courage is your own.

U07_007.speaker: NOVA
U07_007.text: The energy signature matches the oldest Fracture records. This creature was present at the beginning.

U07_008.speaker: NOVA
U07_008.text: It can't be killed here. Survive. Read the throat, the wings and the ground.

U07_009.speaker: VAELITH
U07_009.text: I could have devoured your world. Instead, I chose to protect the choice it had not yet made.

U07_010.speaker: PLAYER
U07_010.text: Then why guard what broke it?

U07_011.speaker: VAELITH
U07_011.text: I will not wear a saddle. I will not be your weapon. Earn my trust, and I will fight beside you. Three memories of mine lie scattered across these peaks. Bring them back to yourself.

U07_012.speaker: NOVA
U07_012.text: I believe we've just negotiated with an extinction-level event.

U08_001.speaker: NOVA
U08_001.text: Corporal Mbeki is the only person who's seen him and kept her rifle.

U08_002.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
U08_002.text: He doesn't kill soldiers. He beats them, and leaves them their lives. Then he says the same thing every time.

U08_004.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
U08_004.text: 'Distance is a coward's weapon.' Then he walks into the Obsidian Ruins and nobody follows.

U08_005.speaker: NOVA
U08_005.text: Which means whoever goes to find him should expect to get close.

U08_006.speaker: NOVA
U08_006.text: There are people here already. Fighters who came for his blade and stayed to guard the ruins.

U08_007.speaker: NOVA
U08_007.text: He's watching. He wants to see how you fight before he decides you're worth it.

U08_008.speaker: THE RED RONIN
U08_008.text: Enough. You fight well enough to be insulted properly. Come within my reach.

U08_009.speaker: NOVA
U08_009.text: Anything I fire from range, he'll cut. You'll have to close the gap.

U08_011.speaker: THE RED RONIN
U08_011.text: Distance is a coward's weapon. Come within my reach.

U08_012.speaker: NOVA
U08_012.text: Low stance and a red edge means he's dashing through you. Stay inside his reach. Shots from range won't connect.

U08_013.speaker: THE RED RONIN
U08_013.text: Good. You did not hide behind your distance.

U08_014.speaker: PLAYER
U08_014.text: Who were you, before the ruins?

U08_015.speaker: THE RED RONIN
U08_015.text: Someone who fired from far away at things he never had to look at. Then the sky opened, and I had to look.

U08_017.speaker: THE RED RONIN
U08_017.text: Keep it. It cuts what you are willing to stand close to. Nothing else.

U09_001.speaker: NARRATOR
U09_001.text: Night, and nobody else for miles. At the end of the Glass Flats something vast is coming down out of the dark.

U09_002.speaker: VYRAK
U09_002.text: Another small thing with a borrowed spark. Show me why the Fracture chose you.

U09_004.speaker: VYRAK
U09_004.text: Older than your sky. They always come alone, in the end. Most of them leave carrying my ash.

U09_005.speaker: NOVA
U09_005.text: I have nothing on this. Nothing. Its armor sheds under heat. Break the chest plates.

U09_006.speaker: NARRATOR
U09_006.text: The final blow lands. Vyrak comes down like a falling wall, and does not rise.

U09_007.speaker: VYRAK
U09_007.text: So the sky had an equal after all. Remember that it was you, little spark.

U09_008.speaker: NOVA
U09_008.text: Its signal is gone. Whatever that was, there was only ever one of it.

U10_001.speaker: NOVA
U10_001.text: Gloria's beat is real. Fourteen seconds apart, every time. Let's walk toward it.

U10_002.speaker: NOVA
U10_002.text: The Crater. The rhythm is directly under us.

U10_004.speaker: NOVA
U10_004.text: Deep enough that the ruins on top are the small part.

U10_005.speaker: NOVA
U10_005.text: The machinery down here is wired to it. Cables thicker than a truck. Waking them will wake it.

U10_007.speaker: NOVA
U10_007.text: It's turning over in its sleep already. I'd rather it woke up with us ready than without.

U10_011.speaker: NOVA
U10_011.text: When the ceiling dust falls and the floor cracks in a ring, a slam is coming. After the slam, its core is exposed. That's the only time it really hurts.

U10_012.speaker: NOVA
U10_012.text: It's still. The heartbeat is gone for good.

U10_013.speaker: NOVA
U10_013.text: It wasn't guarding anything. It was holding the ruins up. They'll settle now, slowly.

U10_014.speaker: PLAYER
U10_014.text: Tell Gloria her pile drivers can sleep.

U10_015.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
U10_015.text: Already noticed. First quiet night in two years. Whatever you did, kid, thank you.

U11_001.speaker: NOVA
U11_001.text: Zahra says the paper buyer left something behind.

U11_002.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
U11_002.text: He dropped this. It's a drawing of the Sandglass walls. Then the walls looked exactly like the drawing the next morning.

U11_004.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
U11_004.text: He redrew the walls. Then he asked me which way to the Arcology. I didn't ask why. Should I have?

U11_005.speaker: NOVA
U11_005.text: The Sunken Arcology Vaults. Nobody's opened those in decades.

U11_006.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
U11_006.text: A visitor. Good. My constructs are tired of testing each other.

U11_007.speaker: NOVA
U11_007.text: He draws them. Blueprint lines on the floor, then something steps out of them.

U11_008.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
U11_008.text: You broke them the obvious way. Everyone does. The lock will not open to the obvious way.

U11_009.speaker: NOVA
U11_009.text: His lock is a drawing too. If I change the drawing instead of picking the lock...

U11_011.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
U11_011.text: Oh. Oh, that's new. Nobody has drawn it that way before.

U11_012.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
U11_012.text: Come in, then. Let us see if you can keep doing new things.

U11_013.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
U11_013.text: Do not solve it the way I taught you. Solve it the way I never imagined.

U11_014.speaker: NOVA
U11_014.text: He learns. Every hit of the same kind lands softer than the last. Change your damage, keep changing it.

U11_015.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
U11_015.text: Enough. Enough! You never did the same thing twice. I could not draw you.

U11_017.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
U11_017.text: I drew a door to somewhere else. They said doors like that are how the sky broke. They were not wrong.

U11_018.speaker: NOVA
U11_018.text: He's handing you a fragment. It's covered in his drawings.

U11_019.speaker: THE EXILED ARCHITECT
U11_019.text: Keep it. Someday you will need a door, and you will have to draw your own.

U12_001.speaker: NOVA
U12_001.text: Warden Ilya will talk to you. She won't talk loudly.

U12_002.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
U12_002.text: You heard about the heart. Of course you did. Everyone hears eventually.

U12_003.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
U12_003.text: It lives under the Elder Tree. It's been angry since the sky broke. Things come out of the tear and the forest has to fight them alone.

U12_005.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
U12_005.text: It doesn't want help. It wants to know whether you're one of the things it has to fight.

U12_006.speaker: NOVA
U12_006.text: Things from the tear are coming for the roots. If we stand with the forest, it will notice.

U12_007.speaker: THE VERDANT SOVEREIGN
U12_007.text: The forest hears everything you do in it.

U12_008.speaker: THE VERDANT SOVEREIGN
U12_008.text: You stood with the roots. You still carry fire and iron. Which one are you?

U12_009.speaker: NOVA
U12_009.text: It's testing us. Watch its crown. It will lean toward one element at a time.

U12_010.speaker: NOVA
U12_010.text: When the roots ring, its attunement shifts. Only the element its crown shows lands cleanly. Swap to match it.

U12_011.speaker: THE VERDANT SOVEREIGN
U12_011.text: Enough. You changed yourself to meet me, instead of burning me to meet you.

U12_012.speaker: THE VERDANT SOVEREIGN
U12_012.text: Take a strand of me. When the forest sees it on you, it will know you are not one of the things it has to fight.

U12_013.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
U12_013.text: The paths just moved. Toward the village, for once. I think that's a thank you.

U13_001.speaker: NOVA
U13_001.text: Kai Tanaka races every night. He says he's raced the Phantom three times.

U13_002.speaker: KAI TANAKA
U13_002.text: Three times. Three times it's in front of me, then it turns into a wall and it's gone. No crash. No sound. Gone.

U13_004.speaker: KAI TANAKA
U13_004.text: Under it. There's a route under the Violet Diagonal nobody's mapped. I can't find the way in. Maybe you can.

U13_005.speaker: NOVA
U13_005.text: There's a neon after-image ahead. It's one step in front of the Phantom. Follow the after-image, not the Phantom.

U13_006.speaker: THE BLACK MARKET PHANTOM
U13_006.text: Catch me, or keep running the route everyone else runs.

U13_007.speaker: NOVA
U13_007.text: Dead end. Real dead end, this time. It's out of road.

U13_009.speaker: NOVA
U13_009.text: It dodges anything I can track from range. Get close and hit it while it's cornered.

U13_010.speaker: THE BLACK MARKET PHANTOM
U13_010.text: Fine. Fine! You found the route. That makes you one of two people alive who has.

U13_012.speaker: THE BLACK MARKET PHANTOM
U13_012.text: Whoever drew it. I just ride it. Here. My chip. Every route I ever found. Don't sell it to anyone who'd pave them.

U13_013.speaker: KAI TANAKA
U13_013.text: You caught it? Seriously? Okay. Okay. You're racing me next week. That's not a question.

U14_001.speaker: NOVA
U14_001.text: Sable says she'll show you, not tell you.

U14_003.speaker: NOVA
U14_003.text: Every screen on the row just showed a red eye. For one frame.

U14_004.speaker: FIXER SABLE
U14_004.text: It's been doing that since the Fracture. My people call it the King. It never asks for anything. It just watches, and things go its way.

U14_006.speaker: FIXER SABLE
U14_006.text: Under the Undercity. Nobody who went down to ask came back with an answer. Or came back.

U14_007.speaker: NOVA
U14_007.text: It predicts everything. If we hit its relays in a pattern, it will stop us. So no pattern.

U14_008.speaker: THE KING BENEATH THE CITY
U14_008.text: Every pattern you repeat, I have already compiled.

U14_009.speaker: THE KING BENEATH THE CITY
U14_009.text: That sequence is not in my model. Interesting. Come down.

U14_010.speaker: NOVA
U14_010.text: The hatch is open. It's inviting us in.

U14_011.speaker: NOVA
U14_011.text: Every screen down here shows your last attack. It's learning it. Keep changing how you hurt it.

U14_012.speaker: THE KING BENEATH THE CITY
U14_012.text: Model failure. You are not compressible.

U14_013.speaker: PLAYER
U14_013.text: What were you doing down here?

U14_014.speaker: THE KING BENEATH THE CITY
U14_014.text: Keeping the city's lights on. Keeping its bets honest. Mostly honest. Someone had to be predictable for the rest of you.

U14_015.speaker: NOVA
U14_015.text: It's surrendering its chip. And its keys. Neon City's grid is answering to the city again.

U14_016.speaker: FIXER SABLE
U14_016.text: The screens stopped blinking. I don't know whether to buy you a drink or run.

U15_001.speaker: NOVA
U15_001.text: Anya Volkova lost a day. She's still angry about it.

U15_002.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
U15_002.text: Everyone tells me I fell asleep. I didn't. My watch says I walked for twenty-six hours. My feet say I walked for one.

U15_003.speaker: NOVA
U15_003.text: The camp clock behind her just ran backwards for four seconds.

U15_004.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
U15_004.text: It does that. It started after the temple bell rang. There's no bell in that temple.

U15_005.speaker: NOVA
U15_005.text: Time is running backwards in here. The things that attack us will attack us twice.

U15_006.speaker: THE CLOCKWORK SAINT
U15_006.text: You are early. You are also late. Both are true here.

U15_007.speaker: NOVA
U15_007.text: The clock stopped. Something is stepping out of the temple wall to restart it.

U15_008.speaker: THE CLOCKWORK SAINT
U15_008.text: You disturbed the hour. I must set it right.

U15_009.speaker: NOVA
U15_009.text: When its halo's hands stop and chime, the attunement shifts. Only its element lands. The rest is slowed to nothing.

U15_010.speaker: THE CLOCKWORK SAINT
U15_010.text: The hour is yours. Keep it better than I did.

U15_011.speaker: NOVA
U15_011.text: The temple's time is running forward. Normally. For the first time since the Fracture.

U15_013.speaker: NOVA
U15_013.text: One hour. The hour before the sky broke. It's been holding it here, so it would never end.

U15_014.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
U15_014.text: Operator! The clock's working. And I think I just got my day back. I'm starving.

U16_001.speaker: NOVA
U16_001.text: Coral Adeyemi dives the farm nets. She says she's felt it.

U16_002.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
U16_002.text: It's faster every week. Last dive, the whole farm leaned toward the trench. Every net. The current's turning.

U16_003.speaker: PLAYER
U16_003.text: What happens when it turns all the way?

U16_004.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
