U16_004.text: My grandmother said: the deep comes up to breathe. I always thought that was a story.

U16_005.speaker: NOVA
U16_005.text: If the farms are anchored when the current reverses, they'll be dragged into the trench. Release them. And then it surfaces.

U16_007.speaker: NOVA
U16_007.text: Into us. I'd rather that than into the farmers.

U16_008.speaker: NOVA
U16_008.text: Anchors free. The current just reversed.

U16_009.speaker: NOVA
U16_009.text: Rings of light, coming up from below. A lot of them.

U16_010.speaker: NOVA
U16_010.text: When the rings ripple down its body, it charges. After the charge, the gill line glows. That's the window.

U16_011.speaker: NOVA
U16_011.text: It's sinking. Not dying. Going back down.

U16_012.speaker: NOVA
U16_012.text: The current is calm. The heartbeat is slow again.

U16_013.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
U16_013.text: The nets are standing straight. First time in a month. I'll tell my grandmother she was right.

U16_014.speaker: NOVA
U16_014.text: It left a core behind in the farm nets. I think it shed it. Like a scale.

U17_001.speaker: NYX
U17_001.text: You're going in. Fine. Listen. She doesn't fire twice from the same place. When the fog parts in a line, move.

U17_003.speaker: NYX
U17_003.text: You don't. You let her find you. Walk into the Maze like you don't know she's there.

U17_004.speaker: NOVA
U17_004.text: I'm reading something in the fog already. It's been with us since the dock.

U17_005.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
U17_005.text: Run, and I will only enjoy it longer.

U17_006.speaker: NOVA
U17_006.text: Her hounds are driving us toward the clearing. Hold here. Make her come to us.

U17_007.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
U17_007.text: You did not run. Then I will finish this myself.

U17_008.speaker: NOVA
U17_008.text: At range she fades into the fog. My scans pass right through her. You'll have to get close.

U17_009.speaker: NOVA
U17_009.text: When her bowstring hums and the fog parts in a line, she's about to loose. Move off the line, then close in.

U17_010.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
U17_010.text: A prey that comes closer. I have not seen one in a long time.

U17_011.speaker: PLAYER
U17_011.text: How long have you been hunting here?

U17_012.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
U17_012.text: Since before the trees. I hunted what came through the fog so the village would not have to. Then the village was gone, and I kept hunting.

U17_013.speaker: THE ETERNAL HUNTRESS
U17_013.text: Take my catalyst. Rest, if you can. I will not.

U17_014.speaker: NYX
U17_014.text: No bowstring tonight. First time in a week. You owe me nothing, but I'll buy you a drink anyway.

U18_001.speaker: NOVA
U18_001.text: Marshal Draev came out from the Reach for this. He doesn't look happy.

U18_002.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
U18_002.text: You want the gate opened. Every operator wants the gate opened. None of them have come back to complain about it.

U18_004.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
U18_004.text: The Behemoth. A siege engine. The war it was built for ended before I was born, and nobody told it. It shells anything that moves near that complex.

U18_005.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
U18_005.text: If you're going, go. Wait for its cannons to run hot. The vents open. That's the only time it bleeds.

U18_006.speaker: NOVA
U18_006.text: Tread marks wider than the road. It's been patrolling.

U18_007.speaker: NOVA
U18_007.text: The gate. Welded shut, then welded again, then welded a third time.

U18_008.speaker: NOVA
U18_008.text: When this gate opens, it will treat us as the enemy it was built to stop. There's no talking to it.

U18_012.speaker: NOVA
U18_012.text: When the vents on its back glow white and steam, the volley is ending and the cannons are hot. That's the opening.

U18_016.speaker: NOVA
U18_016.text: It shut itself off. It accepted the order.

U18_017.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
U18_017.text: Operator, my lookouts say the complex went quiet. You did it. Bring back some of that alloy, would you. We've earned it.

P_rosa_fracture_1.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_fracture_1.text: The morning it happened I was steaming milk. The jug just… kept steaming, no heat under it. I still have the jug.

P_rosa_fracture_2.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_fracture_2.text: Everyone's got a Fracture story. Mine is boring and I'd like to keep it that way.

P_rosa_place_1.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_place_1.text: Best corner in Nexus. Sun till two, shade after, and the monorail doesn't rattle the cups any more.

P_rosa_place_2.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_place_2.text: This café was my mum's. Half the regulars knew her. They still order like she's here.

P_rosa_you_wary.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_you_wary.text: You're new. New people get one free coffee and one chance.

P_rosa_you_acquaintance.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_you_acquaintance.text: You tip. You say thanks. That's already better than most of the avenue.

P_rosa_you_friend.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_you_friend.text: Honestly? You're the reason I don't flinch at the door any more.

P_rosa_you_close.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_you_close.text: If the sky cracks again I'm hiding behind you. Don't argue.

P_rosa_news_start.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_start.text: Trains are back. Prices aren't. Everyone pretends that's normal.

P_rosa_news_allied.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_allied.text: The response team walks the avenue now. Rourke's people. They tip badly.

P_rosa_news_masks.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_masks.text: There were masks in the plaza yesterday. Nobody knows whose. I closed early.

P_rosa_news_unbound.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_unbound.text: Somebody told me the voice in your ear has a history. I said who doesn't.

P_rosa_news_kept.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_kept.text: It's quiet. Properly quiet. I keep waiting for the catch.

P_marcus_fracture_1.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_fracture_1.text: Fracture static chews through ignition coils. I've replaced more coils this year than in the ten before it.

P_marcus_fracture_2.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_fracture_2.text: Day it hit, every car on the avenue started at once. Nobody in them. I don't talk about it much.

P_marcus_place_1.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_place_1.text: Garage was my dad's. Roof leaks in the same spot it leaked in '09.

P_marcus_place_2.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_place_2.text: You want a car fixed, this is the place. You want it pretty, go to Neon.

P_marcus_you_acquaintance.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_you_acquaintance.text: You bring me work and you don't haggle. Fine by me.

P_marcus_you_friend.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_you_friend.text: You drive like someone who's paid for their own repairs. Good.

P_marcus_you_close.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_you_close.text: Keys are on the hook. You know which ones. Don't make me regret it.

P_marcus_news_start.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_start.text: Vanguard trucks through here twice a day now. They don't stop for the lights.

P_marcus_news_allied.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_allied.text: The checkpoint at the bastion's got a new captain. She actually reads the forms.

P_marcus_news_masks.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_masks.text: Somebody torched a Syndicate car outside the Galleria. Nice car, too.

P_marcus_news_unbound.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_unbound.text: They say the calibration lab opened up again. Lights on all night.

P_marcus_news_kept.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_kept.text: First week in a year nobody's brought me a purple-scratched bonnet.

P_dana_fracture_1.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_fracture_1.text: I was on traffic duty. The lights went purple. All of them. Then the people started running and I did my job.

P_dana_fracture_2.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_fracture_2.text: The Fracture didn't break the law. It just made everyone forget there was one for a week.

P_dana_place_1.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_place_1.text: Nexus Avenue, from the plaza to the bastion. My beat. I know every door and who shouldn't be behind it.

P_dana_place_2.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_place_2.text: People think the avenue's dangerous. It's the alleys off it. Stay where the lights are.

P_dana_you_wary.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_you_wary.text: I'm watching you. That's not a threat; it's the job.

P_dana_you_acquaintance.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_you_acquaintance.text: You've kept it holstered. Keep doing that and we're fine.

P_dana_you_friend.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_you_friend.text: You're the only armed civilian on this street I'm glad to see.

P_dana_you_close.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_you_close.text: If I'm ever in trouble out there, I'm calling you before I call dispatch. Don't tell Luis.

P_dana_news_start.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_start.text: Looters at the mall last night. We got most of them. Most.

P_dana_news_allied.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_allied.text: The response team's taken the bastion checkpoint. Less for us, more for them. Suits me.

P_dana_news_masks.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_masks.text: Masks in the plaza. Orders are to observe. I observed. I didn't like it.

P_dana_news_unbound.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_unbound.text: The bastion's lab is lit up and the drones are restless. Keep off the wall after dark.

P_dana_news_kept.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_kept.text: A quiet shift. A whole quiet shift. I don't know what to do with my hands.

P_luis_fracture_1.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_fracture_1.text: Twenty years on this beat. The Fracture was the first day I thought about retiring. Second day too.

P_luis_fracture_2.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_fracture_2.text: Everybody saw something different. I saw my own car drive off without me.

P_luis_place_1.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_place_1.text: The avenue. Used to be the nicest street in the city. Still is, which tells you about the city.

P_luis_place_2.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_place_2.text: That bench is mine between two and three. Don't test it.

P_luis_you_acquaintance.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_you_acquaintance.text: You again. At least you're not trouble. Yet.

P_luis_you_friend.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_you_friend.text: You're all right. I don't say that about many.

P_luis_you_close.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_you_close.text: You know what, kid? You're the reason I haven't retired. Don't let it go to your head.

P_luis_news_start.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_start.text: Rift Gate's had readings all week. Command says stay clear. Command's not out here.

P_luis_news_allied.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_allied.text: The new captain at the bastion wants reports in writing. In writing. I'd forgotten how to spell.

P_luis_news_masks.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_masks.text: Three factions in one plaza and nobody died. First time I've seen that. Somebody held the line.

P_luis_news_unbound.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_unbound.text: There's a story going round about the voice in your ear. I've heard worse about people with faces.

P_luis_news_kept.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_kept.text: Quiet. Real quiet. I'm going to sit on my bench and enjoy it before something notices.

P_priya_fracture_1.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_fracture_1.text: I was mid-delivery. Package floated off the bike. Floated! I chased it two blocks. Got it back. Got a tip.

P_priya_fracture_2.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_fracture_2.text: Twelve drops a day before. Twenty now. The Fracture was great for business, which is a terrible thing to say.

P_priya_place_1.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_place_1.text: This avenue's my highway. I know every pothole by name. That one's Gerald.

P_priya_place_2.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_place_2.text: Shortcut through the Galleria, out the loading dock, down the monorail steps. Don't tell the concierge.

P_priya_you_wary.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_you_wary.text: Do you need something or are you just standing in my lane?

P_priya_you_acquaintance.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_you_acquaintance.text: Oh hey! You're the one who—yeah. Hi.

P_priya_you_friend.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_you_friend.text: You're like a shortcut with legs. Great to see you.

P_priya_you_close.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_you_close.text: Best person on this street, hands down. Don't make me race you for it.

P_priya_news_start.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_start.text: Skyways lift's down again. I'm doing the stairs. All of them.

P_priya_news_allied.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_allied.text: The bastion's taking deliveries now — rations, parts. They sign for things. Weird.

P_priya_news_masks.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_masks.text: Masks, plaza, big crowd. I went round. Got the drop done. Priorities.

P_priya_news_unbound.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_unbound.text: Delivered a crate to the calibration lab. It hummed. I didn't ask.

P_priya_news_kept.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_kept.text: The city's running again. My legs would like a word with the city.

P_theo_fracture_1.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_fracture_1.text: The grill didn't go out. Purple light everywhere, the ground shaking, and my skewers kept cooking. I took it as a sign.

P_theo_fracture_2.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_fracture_2.text: Thirty years on this corner. The Fracture's just the latest thing that tried to move me.

P_theo_place_1.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_place_1.text: This corner's seen a riot, two floods, a film crew and the Fracture. It's a good corner.

P_theo_place_2.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_place_2.text: Sit on the kerb, eat, watch the avenue. Best show in Nexus and it's free with a skewer.

P_theo_you_acquaintance.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_you_acquaintance.text: Back for more. The glaze gets everyone.

P_theo_you_friend.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_you_friend.text: You eat like someone who's been places. Tell me about them sometime.

P_theo_you_close.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_you_close.text: Family rate for you. Don't tell the regulars. Don't tell my wife.

P_theo_news_start.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_start.text: The response team came by. Ate six skewers. Paid for four. Said it was a tax.

P_theo_news_allied.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_allied.text: Rourke's people walk the avenue now. The sergeant likes the hot glaze. The captain doesn't eat.

P_theo_news_masks.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_masks.text: Masks in the plaza yesterday. I sold out. People eat when they're nervous.

P_theo_news_unbound.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_unbound.text: They say the old lab under the bastion's awake. My grandfather worked there. He never said what it was.

P_theo_news_kept.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_kept.text: Quiet week. Ran out of skewers anyway. People eat when they're happy too, it turns out.

P_jade_fracture_1.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_fracture_1.text: I was in the stock room. Every hoodie on the rail turned inside out. All of them. I've still got the photo.

P_jade_fracture_2.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_fracture_2.text: The Fracture's the reason streetwear got practical. Pockets for a flashlight, that kind of thing.

P_jade_place_1.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_place_1.text: Nova Threads, Galleria, ground floor. Best lighting in the city — don't tell anyone I said that.

P_jade_place_2.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_place_2.text: The dressing room's bigger than my flat. I've napped in it. Don't tell Nina.

P_jade_you_wary.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_you_wary.text: Um. Are you… looking for something?

P_jade_you_acquaintance.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_you_acquaintance.text: Oh hi! The hoodie fit, right? I knew it.

P_jade_you_friend.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_you_friend.text: You're my favourite customer and you don't even buy much.

P_jade_you_close.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_you_close.text: New drop's in the back. I saved you the violet one. Don't make it weird.

P_jade_news_start.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_start.text: The Galleria's open but the fountain's roped off. Nina won't say why.

P_jade_news_allied.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_allied.text: The response team bought twelve black hoodies. For undercover, they said. In black.

P_jade_news_masks.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_masks.text: Masks in the plaza — some of them were ours! The blank ones. I sold them for a costume party. Oops.

P_jade_news_unbound.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_unbound.text: Everyone's talking about the voice in your head. I think it's cool. I'd want one.

P_jade_news_kept.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_kept.text: Sales are up, the sky's not purple, and I got a raise. Weird year.

P_samuel_fracture_1.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_fracture_1.text: I taught physics for forty years. The Fracture broke everything I taught. I found that oddly freeing.

P_samuel_fracture_2.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_fracture_2.text: On the day, I stood in the park and watched the sky come apart and thought: well. That's a lesson plan.

P_samuel_place_1.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_place_1.text: This used to be a park. Before that, a school yard. I taught in that building. It's a bank now.

P_samuel_place_2.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_place_2.text: I sit here because the pigeons are the only ones who still listen to a lecture.

P_samuel_you_acquaintance.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_you_acquaintance.text: You listen. That's rarer than you'd think.

P_samuel_you_friend.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_you_friend.text: I'd have liked you in my class. You ask the right questions and ignore the wrong answers.

P_samuel_you_close.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_you_close.text: If I'd had one student like you a year, I'd have taught for sixty.

P_samuel_news_start.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_start.text: The university's reopened half its labs. The other half are sealed. Physics is in the sealed half.

P_samuel_news_allied.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_allied.text: A captain came by and asked me about the old calibration program. I told her what I knew. She wrote it down.

P_samuel_news_masks.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_masks.text: A crowd in masks is a crowd that has stopped being individuals. Someone kept them individuals yesterday. Good.

P_samuel_news_unbound.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_unbound.text: They say your companion has an origin. Everything does. The question is whether it told you.

P_samuel_news_kept.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_kept.text: The sky's whole. My students would say it was never broken. I know better, and so do you.

P_nina_fracture_1.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_fracture_1.text: The Galleria lost power for ninety seconds. The fountain did not. We do not discuss what the fountain did.

P_nina_fracture_2.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_fracture_2.text: I had guests in the Lumen Luxe lounge when it struck. Not one of them put down their drink. That is Nexus.

P_nina_place_1.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_place_1.text: The Galleria. Three floors, forty boutiques, one fountain. Everything you need and several things you don't.

P_nina_place_2.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_place_2.text: Lumen Luxe upstairs for the serious, Nova Threads down here for the practical. I can recommend both.

P_nina_you_wary.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_you_wary.text: May I help you find the exit?

P_nina_you_acquaintance.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_you_acquaintance.text: Ah. The operator. Welcome back; mind the floor, it's just been polished.

P_nina_you_friend.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_you_friend.text: You bring the right sort of attention to the place. Keep bringing it.

P_nina_you_close.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_you_close.text: The lounge upstairs is yours whenever you need it. I've told the staff.

P_nina_news_start.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_start.text: Vanguard officers shop here now. They do not browse. They point.

P_nina_news_allied.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_allied.text: A captain from the bastion toured the Galleria. She asked about the loading dock. I gave her the plan.

P_nina_news_masks.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_masks.text: We closed the doors during the plaza business. We do not close the doors. I have written a report.

P_nina_news_unbound.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_unbound.text: A rumour about your companion is doing the lounge. I have not confirmed it. I have not denied it either.

P_nina_news_kept.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_kept.text: Footfall is up thirty percent. The fountain is calm. I am cautiously, professionally pleased.

P_kofi_fracture_1.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_fracture_1.text: The Fracture made my job. Before, nobody wanted to be an Operator. After, everybody did. Most shouldn't.

P_kofi_fracture_2.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_fracture_2.text: I signed four hundred Operators the first month. Thirty are still working. That's the number that matters.

P_kofi_place_1.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_place_1.text: This office. One desk, one chair, one door. The door's the important part.

P_kofi_place_2.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_place_2.text: The Killbox terminal's across the street. Half the people who walk out of there come to me. Half of them I send back.

P_kofi_you_acquaintance.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_you_acquaintance.text: Your sheet's clean. Keep it that way and we'll talk about better contracts.

P_kofi_you_friend.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_you_friend.text: You're the kind I'd sign twice. Don't tell the others; it's bad for rates.

P_kofi_you_close.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_you_close.text: I don't say this. You're the best I've put a name to. Now go make me look right.

P_kofi_news_start.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_start.text: Contracts are up. Survivors are down. Do the arithmetic before you sign.

P_kofi_news_allied.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_allied.text: The bastion's recruiting too now. Their captain pays less and asks more. Some people prefer that.

P_kofi_news_masks.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_masks.text: Somebody's paying people to wear masks in the plaza. Not me. I'd want to see their sheet first.

P_kofi_news_unbound.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_unbound.text: They say your companion was built for someone else's purpose. Every tool was. What matters is who holds it.

P_kofi_news_kept.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_kept.text: Contracts are drying up. Good. That means the city doesn't need us as badly. I'll find something else to sell.

P_elena_fracture_1.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_fracture_1.text: We had sixty rift burns in the first hour. I'd never seen one. By the second hour I was teaching the others.

P_elena_fracture_2.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_fracture_2.text: I don't like talking about that day. I like talking about the people who walked out. Most did.

P_elena_place_1.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_place_1.text: The clinic's two doors down. Walk in, don't be brave about it. Brave people take longer to fix.

P_elena_place_2.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_place_2.text: I like this bench. It's far enough from the clinic that I can't hear the monitors.

P_elena_you_wary.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_you_wary.text: Are you hurt? No? Then… hi.

P_elena_you_acquaintance.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_you_acquaintance.text: You again. Still in one piece. Good.

P_elena_you_friend.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_you_friend.text: You come in early when it hurts. That's the only thing I ask anyone, and you're the only one who does it.

P_elena_you_close.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_you_close.text: If anything ever happens to you out there, come straight to me. Not the bastion. Me.

P_elena_news_start.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_start.text: The clinic's rationing bandages. Say nothing. Bring any you find.

P_elena_news_allied.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_allied.text: The response team sends their wounded to us now. Their captain visits every one. Every one.

P_elena_news_masks.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_masks.text: The plaza business. We had six brought in. Bruises, nothing worse. Somebody kept it to bruises.

P_elena_news_unbound.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_unbound.text: A patient told me the voice in your ear is older than the Fracture. I said then it's seen worse.

P_elena_news_kept.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_kept.text: No rift burns in nine days. I've started sleeping. It's strange.

P_ravi_fracture_1.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_fracture_1.text: The grid screamed. Every camera, every router, every smart lamp. I heard it through my implant. I still do, some nights.

P_ravi_fracture_2.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_fracture_2.text: The Fracture didn't just break the sky. It rewrote half the firmware in the city. Someone had to read it.

P_ravi_place_1.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_place_1.text: Don't look at the lamppost camera. Don't look at any of them. They look back.

P_ravi_place_2.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_place_2.text: This alley's got the only clean node on the avenue. I keep it clean. You're welcome.

P_ravi_you_wary.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_you_wary.text: P-please don't stand there, the camera—just move left.

P_ravi_you_acquaintance.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_you_acquaintance.text: Oh, it's you. Okay. Okay. You're fine.

P_ravi_you_friend.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_you_friend.text: I pulled your feed off the grid. Nobody sees you but me, and I don't look. Promise.

P_ravi_you_close.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_you_close.text: You're the only person I've told about the node. That's… that's the biggest thing I've got.

P_ravi_news_start.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_news_start.text: Vanguard's pushing new firmware to the street cameras. I'm blocking it. It's winning.

P_ravi_news_allied.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_news_allied.text: The bastion asked me — asked me — to audit their network. I said yes. I'm terrified.

P_ravi_news_masks.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_news_masks.text: The masks had transmitters. Cheap ones. Syndicate stock. Somebody was counting the crowd.

P_ravi_news_unbound.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_news_unbound.text: I saw the calibration lab's logs come online. NOVA's in them. Older than it says. I'm sorry.

P_ravi_news_kept.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_news_kept.text: The grid's quiet. No screaming. I took the implant out for a day. Put it back. Habit.

P_tony_fracture_1.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_fracture_1.text: Day the sky cracked, my warehouse doubled in value. Then halved. Then I stopped checking.

P_tony_fracture_2.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_fracture_2.text: The Fracture was bad for everybody. Slightly less bad for me. I'm not proud. I'm not sorry either.

P_tony_place_1.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_place_1.text: This corner. Mine since before you were born. The lamppost's mine. The pigeons rent.

P_tony_place_2.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_place_2.text: You want something imported, you ask me. You don't ask where from. That's the whole business.

P_tony_you_acquaintance.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_you_acquaintance.text: The operator. Yeah. You're all right. Keep it that way.

P_tony_you_friend.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_you_friend.text: I don't do favours. For you I do a discount, which is a favour with paperwork.

P_tony_you_close.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_you_close.text: Anybody gives you trouble on this avenue, you say my name. Then you don't say anything else.

P_tony_news_start.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_news_start.text: Vanguard's checking shipments at the harbor. Bad for business. Good for the people who know the back way.

P_tony_news_allied.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_news_allied.text: The new captain at the bastion's straight. Can't bribe her. I tried. Respect.

P_tony_news_masks.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_news_masks.text: Masks in the plaza. Not mine. I'd have charged more.

P_tony_news_unbound.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_news_unbound.text: Word is your voice-in-the-ear has a past. So does everybody worth talking to.

P_tony_news_kept.speaker: BIG TONY RUSSO
P_tony_news_kept.text: Business is down. The city's up. I can live with that. Slightly.

P_mei_fracture_1.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_fracture_1.text: The stadium lights went purple mid-match. The players kept playing. The crowd kept cheering. Nexus, honestly.

P_mei_fracture_2.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_fracture_2.text: The Fracture gave us the skate park. The crater, I mean. We paved it. It's beautiful.

P_mei_place_1.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_place_1.text: Sports District! Arena, skate park, courts. Wristband gets you everywhere. No glass past the turnstiles.

P_mei_place_2.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_place_2.text: The skate park's lights stay on till midnight. After midnight it's the kids' problem.

P_mei_you_wary.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_you_wary.text: Wristband? No? Then you're a visitor. Visitors stay on the path.

P_mei_you_acquaintance.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_you_acquaintance.text: Hey! The operator! Wristband's on me today.

P_mei_you_friend.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_you_friend.text: You're the only person who's ever returned a wristband. I framed it.

P_mei_you_close.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_you_close.text: You're family here. Arena, park, courts — walk in. I'll deal with the gate.

P_mei_news_start.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_news_start.text: The arena's booked for a Vanguard rally Saturday. The kids are not thrilled.

P_mei_news_allied.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_news_allied.text: The response team trains in the arena at dawn. The captain runs. Fast. I timed her.

P_mei_news_masks.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_news_masks.text: Half the masks in the plaza came from our costume night. I'm mortified. I'm also a bit proud.

P_mei_news_unbound.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_news_unbound.text: The kids are calling your companion 'the ghost'. Affectionately. Mostly.

P_mei_news_kept.speaker: MEI LIN
P_mei_news_kept.text: Championship weekend's back on. First one since the Fracture. Bring earplugs.

P_jonah_fracture_1.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_fracture_1.text: I was busking under the monorail. The strings went slack. Then they went tight. Then they played a chord I didn't know.

P_jonah_fracture_2.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_fracture_2.text: I wrote a song about it. Nobody likes it. I like it.

P_jonah_place_1.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_place_1.text: Under the monorail. The acoustics are stupid good. Trains come through and it's like a drum.

P_jonah_place_2.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_place_2.text: Coins in the case, requests in the air. Don't request the Fracture song. I'll play it anyway.

P_jonah_you_acquaintance.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_you_acquaintance.text: Oh — hey. You're the one who, um. Thanks for the coin.

P_jonah_you_friend.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_you_friend.text: I wrote a bit about you. It's not finished. It's… yeah.

P_jonah_you_close.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_you_close.text: That song's about you. The good one. Don't make me say it twice.

P_jonah_news_start.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_news_start.text: Vanguard moved me off the plaza. Said I was a 'gathering'. One guy. A gathering.

P_jonah_news_allied.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_news_allied.text: The captain from the bastion stopped and listened. Whole song. Didn't tip. Did nod.

P_jonah_news_masks.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_news_masks.text: The masks came through the plaza while I was playing. They stopped. Then someone made them move on. I kept playing.

P_jonah_news_unbound.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_news_unbound.text: They say the voice in your ear was built to find someone. I think it found the right one. That's in the song too.

P_jonah_news_kept.speaker: JONAH PRICE
P_jonah_news_kept.text: I played the plaza today. Nobody moved me on. Biggest crowd I've had.

P_vale_fracture_1.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_fracture_1.text: I was on the wall when the sky opened. I had thirty seconds to decide what my people were for. I decided civilians.

P_vale_fracture_2.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_fracture_2.text: The Fracture is not an event. It is a condition. We are living in it, and I intend to keep the district standing inside it.

P_vale_place_1.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_place_1.text: The bastion. The last wall in Nexus that means anything. Everything inside it is mine to keep.

P_vale_place_2.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_place_2.text: The checkpoint is not for show. Everything that crosses it is counted. Including you.

P_vale_you_wary.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_you_wary.text: People are calling you a hero. Others are calling you a threat. I have not decided which report to file.

P_vale_you_acquaintance.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_you_acquaintance.text: You held the district. That earned you the door. The rest you earn daily.

P_vale_you_friend.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_you_friend.text: You answer to your conscience before you answer to me. I have come to prefer it.

P_vale_you_close.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_you_close.text: They know what your choices did to their streets. So do I. I would not trade you for a company.

P_vale_news_start.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_news_start.text: Breaches nightly. The drones are learning the avenue. So are we.

P_vale_news_allied.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_news_allied.text: My team walks the avenue in the open now. Civilians first. Report anything that does not fit.

P_vale_news_masks.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_news_masks.text: Masks in the plaza. Paid for. I know by whom; I cannot yet prove it. Patience.

P_vale_news_unbound.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_news_unbound.text: The lab under the bastion is open. What it says about your companion I will hear from you, not from a rumour.

P_vale_news_kept.speaker: CAPTAIN ROURKE
P_vale_news_kept.text: The city stands. The factions hold. Do not mistake quiet for finished; keep the district.

P_voss_fracture_1.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_fracture_1.text: We shot at them for twenty minutes before anyone admitted nothing was working. That's the Fracture. A lesson you learn while firing.

P_voss_fracture_2.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_fracture_2.text: It didn't come from nowhere. Somebody promised somebody they could control it. I intend to find out who.

P_voss_place_1.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_place_1.text: The checkpoint holds because the people on it decide every morning that it will.

P_voss_place_2.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_place_2.text: Nexus is still standing. Barely. Barely is better than nothing.

P_voss_you_wary.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_you_wary.text: You're either incredibly lucky or something happened to you. I haven't decided which worries me more.

P_voss_you_acquaintance.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_you_acquaintance.text: You're not military. Out there, that distinction doesn't matter. You've proved it.

P_voss_you_friend.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_you_friend.text: You survived something that killed trained soldiers. Then you went back for the civilians. I noticed.

P_voss_you_close.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_you_close.text: Cole believed we could win this. Some days you're the reason I still believe him.

P_voss_news_start.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_news_start.text: Outposts are going quiet one by one. Keep your radio on.

P_voss_news_allied.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_news_allied.text: Haven-01 needs walls more than it needs speeches. I'm building walls.

P_voss_news_masks.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_news_masks.text: Faces in the crowd I don't trust. One of those things could be wearing any of them.

P_voss_news_unbound.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_news_unbound.text: NOVA has a directive nobody signed. Watch what she does, not what she says.

P_voss_news_kept.speaker: COMMANDER ELIAS VOSS
P_voss_news_kept.text: We held the line. Don't let anyone tell you it held itself.

P_seraphine_fracture_1.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_fracture_1.text: The event that destroyed this city wasn't the beginning. Something opened the door.

P_seraphine_fracture_2.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_fracture_2.text: We said we didn't understand them. That isn't the same as not knowing they were there.

P_seraphine_place_1.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_place_1.text: Readings everywhere in this district. The ground itself is listening.

P_seraphine_place_2.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_place_2.text: Every lab I trusted turned out to be hiding something. I check the walls now.

P_seraphine_you_wary.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_you_wary.text: You're the one who survived the first wave. Depends who's asking, you said. I'm asking.

P_seraphine_you_acquaintance.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_you_acquaintance.text: Your biometric signature opened a door I never could. I'd like to know why.

P_seraphine_you_friend.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_you_friend.text: You keep asking me the hard questions. Keep asking. Someone has to.

P_seraphine_you_close.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_you_close.text: Five signatures, and a sixth that matches you. Whatever you are, I'm with you.

P_seraphine_news_start.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_news_start.text: Complex 09 was sealed six months ago. Something has been running it since.

P_seraphine_news_allied.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_news_allied.text: The Ascendancy has been collecting samples since before the disaster. I want their records.

P_seraphine_news_masks.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_news_masks.text: Someone deliberately erased the archive's record. Erasing takes intent.

P_seraphine_news_unbound.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_news_unbound.text: NOVA said welcome back, Dr. Vale. I'd never been there. I still think about it.

P_seraphine_news_kept.speaker: DR. SERAPHINE VALE
P_seraphine_news_kept.text: Earth was a lock. We still don't know what it kept. I'm not done looking.

P_ward_fracture_1.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_fracture_1.text: The world ended yesterday. Today we decide what's worth keeping.

P_ward_fracture_2.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_fracture_2.text: Humanity has always fought itself. The Fractures simply gave us something bigger to fight over.

P_ward_place_1.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_place_1.text: Headquarters. Where the people who make decisions pretend they're not afraid.

P_ward_place_2.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_place_2.text: We protect settlements, secure resources and establish safe territories. In that order.

P_ward_you_wary.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_you_wary.text: So you're the one. Good. I prefer people who speak for themselves.

P_ward_you_acquaintance.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_you_acquaintance.text: We've reviewed your combat recordings. Without asking. Get used to it.

P_ward_you_friend.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_you_friend.text: You chose a side and kept your word. That's rarer than courage.

P_ward_you_close.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_you_close.text: When this is over they'll write that the Initiative held. I'll know who held it.

P_ward_news_start.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_news_start.text: Three installations lost in twenty minutes. Privacy regulations are having a difficult week.

P_ward_news_allied.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_news_allied.text: The Free Operators are useful. Until somebody decides they're criminals. Not my decision. Yet.

P_ward_news_masks.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_news_masks.text: Rainer opened a channel to them. I'm deciding what that makes him.

P_ward_news_unbound.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_news_unbound.text: There's a directive in NOVA nobody here authorised. I'd like to meet whoever did.

P_ward_news_kept.speaker: DIRECTOR HELENA WARD
P_ward_news_kept.text: Survival first. Then we argue. We're arguing again. That's progress.

P_kael_fracture_1.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_fracture_1.text: Everybody down there thinks they're saving the world. I think people need saving. The world can sort itself out.

P_kael_fracture_2.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_fracture_2.text: Things come through those openings. My people hunt them. Simple work, honest pay.

P_kael_place_1.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_place_1.text: Outside military control. That's the whole address.

P_kael_place_2.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_place_2.text: We rescue civilians, recover supplies and hunt anything that comes through. Nobody signs off on it.

P_kael_you_wary.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_you_wary.text: Depends who's asking. Hearing my name a lot is usually a bad sign.

P_kael_you_acquaintance.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_you_acquaintance.text: Tired of taking orders yet? The offer stands.

P_kael_you_friend.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_you_friend.text: You'd make a decent Free Operator. Don't tell Voss I said that.

P_kael_you_close.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_you_close.text: My people trust you. That's not a thing I hand out.

P_kael_news_start.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_news_start.text: Military's stretched thin. We're covering the gaps they won't admit to.

P_kael_news_allied.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_news_allied.text: Black-market parts are moving again. Don't ask where from.

P_kael_news_masks.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_news_masks.text: Somebody's selling Fracture samples out the back of the Ascendancy. Follow the money.

P_kael_news_unbound.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_news_unbound.text: Your NOVA's got secrets. So does everyone worth knowing.

P_kael_news_kept.speaker: KAEL DRAVEN
P_kael_news_kept.text: Still independent. Still here. Turns out that's enough.

P_rainer_fracture_1.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_fracture_1.text: We believed we could control the situation. I'll carry that.

P_rainer_fracture_2.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_fracture_2.text: Six months ago we received a transmission. We answered. That's all I'll say here.

P_rainer_place_2.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_place_2.text: Command is a room where every answer costs someone.

P_rainer_you_wary.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_you_wary.text: You have no idea what you're involved in.

P_rainer_you_acquaintance.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_you_acquaintance.text: You destroyed our only chance to capture one alive. Next time, think.

P_rainer_you_friend.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_you_friend.text: Perhaps you were the right person to put in harm's way. I hate that I needed one.

P_rainer_you_close.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_you_close.text: If the Covenant comes for you, I'll stand in front of it. I owe that much.

P_rainer_news_start.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_news_start.text: Lost contact with three installations. We will not lose a fourth.

P_rainer_news_allied.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_news_allied.text: The Ascension Protocol is sealed. It stays sealed.

P_rainer_news_masks.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_news_masks.text: There are people inside this organisation I no longer trust. I include myself.

P_rainer_news_unbound.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_news_unbound.text: Genesis was a mistake. A terrible one. I'm trying to close the door I opened.

P_rainer_news_kept.speaker: GENERAL MARCUS RAINER
P_rainer_news_kept.text: History will judge me. Let it judge the ones who lived.

P_cole_fracture_1.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_fracture_1.text: Forty minutes tracking something we couldn't name. Then we held anyway.

P_cole_fracture_2.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_fracture_2.text: You actually killed it. I wouldn't have tried that myself.

P_cole_place_1.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_place_1.text: Haven-01. Eighteen thousand people and a wall. I like the people more than the wall.

P_cole_place_2.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_place_2.text: Kids play by the shelters. That's what we're holding the line for.

P_cole_you_wary.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_you_wary.text: Command wants you at the tower. That's all they tell me.

P_cole_you_acquaintance.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_you_acquaintance.text: You're not in our military. Doesn't stop you acting like it.

P_cole_you_friend.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_you_friend.text: Tell them we held the line. If I'm not there to, you tell them.

P_cole_you_close.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_you_close.text: Trust me — I'm glad you're on our side of the wall.

P_cole_news_start.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_news_start.text: Engineers are reinforcing the barricades. Again.

P_cole_news_allied.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_news_allied.text: Two thousand three hundred soldiers, six hundred forty Operators. Feels like more when you're next to them.

P_cole_news_masks.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_news_masks.text: Strange signatures past the perimeter. Too orderly.

P_cole_news_unbound.speaker: CAPTAIN ADRIAN COLE
P_cole_news_unbound.text: Whatever's in NOVA, she got the evacuation routes right. I'll take it.

P_ilyra_fracture_1.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_fracture_1.text: When I sing, the small cracks close. I never knew why. Now I do, and it doesn't help me sing any better.

P_ilyra_fracture_2.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_fracture_2.text: Every crack is a question somebody didn't finish asking.

P_ilyra_place_1.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_place_1.text: This city is very loud. I like it. Eldergrove was so quiet I could hear the world worrying.

P_ilyra_place_2.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_place_2.text: The plaza in the morning sounds like a choir that hasn't met yet.

P_ilyra_you_wary.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_you_wary.text: I know you. I don't know from where. That makes me careful.

P_ilyra_you_acquaintance.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_you_acquaintance.text: You walk loudly for someone who keeps being hunted.

P_ilyra_you_friend.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_you_friend.text: I was angry with you for longer than this world has had a name. I'm not anymore.

P_ilyra_you_close.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_you_close.text: You were our promise. You still are. Promises aren't things you keep. They're things you are.

P_ilyra_news_start.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_news_start.text: The water at the falls told me you were coming.

P_ilyra_news_allied.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_news_allied.text: Four of us in one city. It hasn't happened since the sanctuary.

P_ilyra_news_masks.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_news_masks.text: The Choir listens for my song. I sing anyway.

P_ilyra_news_unbound.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_news_unbound.text: The lighthouse in your ear is brighter every day.

P_ilyra_news_kept.speaker: ILYRA SEN
P_ilyra_news_kept.text: A kept door. Elenya was always the wisest of us.

P_auren_fracture_1.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_fracture_1.text: Forty years I drew roads that didn't exist. They always arrived. The Fracture's just the world catching up with my maps.

P_auren_fracture_2.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_fracture_2.text: You can't wall in a road you haven't walked yet.

P_auren_place_1.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_place_1.text: Good coffee. Terrible directions. My kind of café.

P_auren_place_2.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_place_2.text: This avenue's on every map I ever drew. It's never in the same place twice.

P_auren_you_wary.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_you_wary.text: You're late. The map said noon.

P_auren_you_acquaintance.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_you_acquaintance.text: I drew you this morning. You looked taller.

P_auren_you_friend.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_you_friend.text: Every road out of the end of the world goes through you. Lucky roads.

P_auren_you_close.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_you_close.text: I asked you once to map a world where you didn't have to choose. You found a better one. One where you got to.

P_auren_news_start.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_news_start.text: The glass map stopped drawing us. It's drawing the sea.

P_auren_news_allied.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_news_allied.text: The trader still wants his map. He's standing on it.

P_auren_news_masks.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_news_masks.text: A road past the edge of the glass. Nobody's spilled that ink yet.

P_auren_news_unbound.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_news_unbound.text: The map drew a road through the Heart and out the other side.

P_auren_news_kept.speaker: AUREN THALE
P_auren_news_kept.text: There's an edge again. Isn't that wonderful?

P_nyx_fracture_1.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_fracture_1.text: Fractures smell like ozone and wet stone. You learn it or you don't last.

P_nyx_fracture_2.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_fracture_2.text: Corner of your eye. That's where everything dangerous lives now.

P_nyx_place_1.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_place_1.text: Too loud. Too bright. Too many people looking up instead of around.

P_nyx_place_2.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_place_2.text: The plaza's fine. The rooftops above it are better.

P_nyx_you_wary.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_you_wary.text: Kael says you're all right. Kael's been wrong before.

P_nyx_you_acquaintance.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_you_acquaintance.text: You talk to your machine. It talks back. I've stopped finding it weird.

P_nyx_you_friend.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_you_friend.text: You'd make a decent tracker if you ever learned to shut up.

P_nyx_you_close.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_you_close.text: Teo would have liked you. He liked idiots who walk into things for other people.

P_nyx_news_start.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_news_start.text: Strangers in the canopy, asking the trees questions.

P_nyx_news_allied.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_news_allied.text: Collectors left the valley. All but one. Not anymore.

P_nyx_news_masks.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_news_masks.text: Bending coats in the market again. I counted six.

P_nyx_news_unbound.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_news_unbound.text: Your lamp looked at me today. Like she knew me.

P_nyx_news_kept.speaker: NYX
P_nyx_news_kept.text: The herds went north. They're coming back. So am I.

P_goliath_fracture_1.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_fracture_1.text: Bullets didn't work on the first ones. I did. Turns out I'm a type of bullet.

P_goliath_fracture_2.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_fracture_2.text: Things should be on the ground. Fractures disagree. I disagree back.

P_goliath_place_1.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_place_1.text: Precinct's quiet. I like quiet. Quiet means my mum's goats are safe.

P_goliath_place_2.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_place_2.text: Somebody has to stand at the front. I'm the widest.

P_goliath_you_wary.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_you_wary.text: Voss sends his regards. And me. Mostly me.

P_goliath_you_acquaintance.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_you_acquaintance.text: You're smaller than the recordings. Everybody is.

P_goliath_you_friend.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_you_friend.text: Stand behind me. That's not an order, that's physics.

P_goliath_you_close.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_you_close.text: My mum asks about you. She wants you to sit down more. So do I.

P_goliath_news_start.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_news_start.text: The desert's trying to kill us. I'm trying harder.

P_goliath_news_allied.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_news_allied.text: Gertrude the goat is avenged. That's all you need to know.

P_goliath_news_masks.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_news_masks.text: Bending coats, floating rocks, underground. I hate all of it.

P_goliath_news_unbound.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_news_unbound.text: Your NOVA cried at the sunrise. So did I. Sand in my eye.

P_goliath_news_kept.speaker: MARCUS "GOLIATH" REYES
P_goliath_news_kept.text: Emotional sand. It's a real thing. Ask anyone.

P_cipher_fracture_1.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_fracture_1.text: I volunteered. They opened a door in my head and left it a little open. It's how I read the map.

P_cipher_fracture_2.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_fracture_2.text: The Fracture isn't chaos. It's grammar we never learned.

P_cipher_place_1.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_place_1.text: The café has a socket that works and nobody asks what I'm charging.

P_cipher_place_2.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_place_2.text: I used to work up there, in the Spire. The view was better. The company wasn't.

P_cipher_you_wary.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_you_wary.text: Don't touch anything with your hands. It remembers fingerprints. So do I.

P_cipher_you_acquaintance.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_you_acquaintance.text: Severance comes in many forms. Mine was a truck of Crane's equipment.

P_cipher_you_friend.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_you_friend.text: Tallis would have written a terrible poem about you. I'll do it instead. It'll be worse.

P_cipher_you_close.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_you_close.text: You let the memories go instead of taking them back. That's the bravest thing I've seen anyone do with a door.

P_cipher_news_start.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_news_start.text: The glass map has been drawing my face for three days.

P_cipher_news_allied.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_news_allied.text: The forge is shut. I hope it stays shut.

P_cipher_news_masks.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_news_masks.text: Crane copied everything before we shut it down. Of course he did.

P_cipher_news_unbound.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_news_unbound.text: Mum reads the bus-stop poem every night. Terrible. She loves it.

P_cipher_news_kept.speaker: ARI "CIPHER" VOLK
P_cipher_news_kept.text: Crane asks people now. I'm almost proud of him.

P_crane_fracture_1.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_fracture_1.text: Humanity doesn't survive this by hiding behind walls. It survives by becoming something that doesn't need them.

P_crane_fracture_2.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_fracture_2.text: The Fracture is the first honest thing to happen to our species in a thousand years.

P_crane_place_1.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_place_1.text: I like the plaza. Everyone here is afraid of me. It's restful.

P_crane_place_2.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_place_2.text: The Spire has the best view in Nexus. You should come up. Without a weapon, this time.

P_crane_you_wary.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_you_wary.text: Do you follow me, or do I follow you? It's getting hard to tell.

P_crane_you_acquaintance.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_you_acquaintance.text: You keep breaking my things. I keep building better ones. A productive relationship.

P_crane_you_friend.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_you_friend.text: Everyone comes to me in the end. You came to ask. That was new.

P_crane_you_close.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_you_close.text: A seat at the table. Given, not built. You were right. I hate it when people are right.

P_crane_news_start.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_news_start.text: The core is five names and a sixth nobody wanted remembered.

P_crane_news_allied.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_news_allied.text: The shield over the eastern districts. Thirty thousand people. Good publicity.

P_crane_news_masks.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_news_masks.text: The volunteers have names now. Lune insists.

P_crane_news_unbound.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_news_unbound.text: We ask people what they want before we change them. Revolutionary.

P_crane_news_kept.speaker: PREFECT LYSANDER CRANE
P_crane_news_kept.text: The Ascendancy stands at the door. Shields up. No cheating.

P_oda_fracture_1.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_fracture_1.text: Eighty years under the sea keeping a voice in a box. The Fracture's just the box getting bigger.

P_oda_fracture_2.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_fracture_2.text: The sea always wins, eventually. We make eventually take a very long time.

P_oda_place_1.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_place_1.text: The garage has proper pumps. I like a place with proper pumps.

P_oda_place_2.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_place_2.text: Surface air is very thin. Nobody warned me.

P_oda_you_wary.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_you_wary.text: Surface people. We don't get many. We don't want many.

P_oda_you_acquaintance.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_you_acquaintance.text: You got every pod out. Every one. I don't forget that.

P_oda_you_friend.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_you_friend.text: You and your lamp. Come down sometime. The palace is dry enough for socks.

P_oda_you_close.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_you_close.text: My grandmother would have liked you. She liked people who went back.

P_oda_news_start.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_news_start.text: The voice in the walls got louder nine days ago.

P_oda_news_masks.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_news_masks.text: Somebody cut the eastern pumps. I want a name.

P_oda_news_unbound.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_news_unbound.text: A centimetre a minute. The city's breathing again.

P_oda_news_kept.speaker: CHIEF ODA
P_oda_news_kept.text: Thalassia's pumped out. I've seen three sunrises now. Still on fire.

P_vesper_fracture_1.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_fracture_1.text: The Fracture was the best thing that ever happened to my business. I'm not proud. I'm rich.

P_vesper_fracture_2.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_fracture_2.text: Everybody in this city is wearing something over something. The Fracture just made it obvious.

P_vesper_place_1.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_place_1.text: The night market. Every secret in Neon passes through here eventually. Most of them stop to eat.

P_vesper_place_2.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_place_2.text: My little room. Should I be flattered or should I be running?

P_vesper_you_wary.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_you_wary.text: The famous survivor. I've heard prices for you.

P_vesper_you_acquaintance.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_you_acquaintance.text: You pay. You don't haggle. You're terrible at this.

P_vesper_you_friend.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_you_friend.text: For you, the good secrets. Half price. Don't tell anyone I have a heart.

P_vesper_you_close.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_you_close.text: If anyone ever asks me where you are, I'll sell them the wrong answer. Free.

P_vesper_news_start.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_news_start.text: Silver hair, eyes like a bruise. Paid in Genesis credit.

P_vesper_news_allied.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_news_allied.text: The ledger's gone. Everyone's very nervous. Business is wonderful.

P_vesper_news_masks.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_news_masks.text: Bending coats asked first. They always ask first.

P_vesper_news_unbound.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_news_unbound.text: Someone bought every map of the Shattered Expanse in the city. Twice.

P_vesper_news_kept.speaker: VESPER
P_vesper_news_kept.text: Neon City has a door now. I've already got people selling tickets.

P_gloria_fracture_1.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_fracture_1.text: The crash site landed on my crew's lunch break. Nobody hurt. The sandwiches did not make it.

P_gloria_fracture_2.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_fracture_2.text: The Fracture is a twelve-week cleanup job. We're on week thirty. I've stopped counting weeks.

P_gloria_place_1.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_place_1.text: The crash site. Hard hats past the tape. I don't care who you are; the tape doesn't either.

P_gloria_place_2.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_place_2.text: Thirty years of building. First time I've been asked to un-build something that fell from the sky.

P_gloria_you_wary.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_you_wary.text: Past the tape, you wear a hat. No hat, no past.

P_gloria_you_acquaintance.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_you_acquaintance.text: The operator. You keep off my scaffolding. I appreciate that.

P_gloria_you_friend.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_you_friend.text: You're welcome on site any time. Hat's on the hook with your name on it.

P_gloria_you_close.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_you_close.text: If I ever get a crew of people like you, I'll have this done in a week. Don't give me ideas.

P_gloria_news_start.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_news_start.text: Vanguard wants the wreck's core by Friday. Friday was two Fridays ago.

P_gloria_news_allied.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_news_allied.text: The bastion sent engineers to help. Actual engineers. I nearly cried.

P_gloria_news_masks.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_news_masks.text: The plaza business kept my crew home a day. A day! Somebody owes me a day.

P_gloria_news_unbound.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_news_unbound.text: They've reopened the lab under the bastion. My crew built the walls around that thing in the nineties. We never asked what it was.

P_gloria_news_kept.speaker: GLORIA HAYNES
P_gloria_news_kept.text: The crash site's clear. Clear. I'm taking a holiday. First one since the Fracture.

P_kai_fracture_1.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_fracture_1.text: Mid-race when it hit. The road bent. I made the corner anyway. That's the whole story and it's a good one.

P_kai_fracture_2.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the avenue a track. Potholes, debris, purple light. Best course in the city.

P_kai_place_1.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_place_1.text: Meet's at midnight on the avenue. Nobody official. Everybody fast.

P_kai_place_2.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_place_2.text: This corner's where you line up. Don't line up unless you mean it.

P_kai_you_acquaintance.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_you_acquaintance.text: You held your line at the meet. Most don't.

P_kai_you_friend.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_you_friend.text: You beat me once. Once. I think about it more than I should.

P_kai_you_close.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_you_close.text: You're the only one I'd give my car to. Don't crash it. I would know.

P_kai_news_start.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_news_start.text: Vanguard shut the midnight meet. We moved it. They haven't found it.

P_kai_news_allied.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_news_allied.text: A captain from the bastion came to the meet. Didn't shut it down. Watched. Fast eyes.

P_kai_news_masks.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_news_masks.text: The masks blocked the avenue at midnight. Cost us a race. Somebody's going to pay for that.

P_kai_news_unbound.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_news_unbound.text: Heard your voice-in-the-ear can see every camera on the loop. Tell it to look away at the finish.

P_kai_news_kept.speaker: KAI TANAKA
P_kai_news_kept.text: Avenue's open end to end. Clean. Fast. The meet's never been bigger.

P_vex_fracture_1.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_fracture_1.text: The casino lights went purple. The gamblers didn't look up. I've never respected them more.

P_vex_fracture_2.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_fracture_2.text: The Fracture's the only thing that's ever got past me on this door. Once.

P_vex_place_1.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_place_1.text: Neon Crown Casino. The rope's the law. I'm the judge.

P_vex_place_2.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_place_2.text: Casino Row. Everything's for sale, including the people selling it. Not me. I'm just the door.

P_vex_you_wary.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_you_wary.text: Dress code's whatever I say it is. Tonight it's 'not you'.

P_vex_you_acquaintance.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_you_acquaintance.text: The operator. Weapon on the counter, you can go in. Weapon on your hip, you can go home.

P_vex_you_friend.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_you_friend.text: You're on the list. Permanently. Don't make me regret the ink.

P_vex_you_close.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_you_close.text: Anybody gives you trouble inside, you find me. Then they find out why the rope's the law.

P_vex_news_start.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_news_start.text: Syndicate's got a new boss and new rules. The rules change nightly. The boss doesn't.

P_vex_news_allied.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain came through Neon. Didn't gamble. Asked about Sable. Everyone asks about Sable.

P_vex_news_masks.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_news_masks.text: Masks on the Row last night. Syndicate's idea of a party. I didn't let them in.

P_vex_news_unbound.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_news_unbound.text: Heard your companion's got a past the Syndicate wants to buy. Tell it the rope's the law.

P_vex_news_kept.speaker: VEX MORALES
P_vex_news_kept.text: The Row's calmer. Fewer fights at the door. I'm bored. I'm not complaining.

P_hana_fracture_1.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_fracture_1.text: The club's lights synced to the rift's hum the night it happened. They never un-synced. It's the best set we've ever had.

P_hana_fracture_2.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_fracture_2.text: The Fracture gave Neon its colour. Before that it was just neon.

P_hana_place_1.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_place_1.text: Neon Afterglow. Guest list, best sound in the city, lights that follow the rift. You're on it. Obviously.

P_hana_place_2.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_place_2.text: The Nightlife quarter never sleeps. Neither do I. It's a problem.

P_hana_you_acquaintance.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_you_acquaintance.text: Oh you're the operator! Come in, come in, the floor's yours.

P_hana_you_friend.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_you_friend.text: You dance like someone who's been shot at. It works. Honestly it works.

P_hana_you_close.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_you_close.text: The booth's yours. The good one. Don't make me explain to the DJ.

P_hana_news_start.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_news_start.text: Syndicate took over the door money. I'm pretending I didn't notice.

P_hana_news_allied.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain came in. In uniform. On a Friday. The floor cleared like a rift.

P_hana_news_masks.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_news_masks.text: Masks on the Row! We did a masked night. Then the real masks came. Awkward.

P_hana_news_unbound.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_news_unbound.text: Everyone's talking about your ghost. The voice. I want to put it on a flyer.

P_hana_news_kept.speaker: HANA SATO
P_hana_news_kept.text: Best month we've had. The lights still follow the rift. Softer now.

P_dex_fracture_1.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_fracture_1.text: Fixed an implant the week after that wasn't from any company on Earth. Or so I say. I say it a lot.

P_dex_fracture_2.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_fracture_2.text: The Fracture fried every screen in Neon. I've had a queue ever since.

P_dex_place_1.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_place_1.text: Tech-repair, Neon Mods. Cracked screen, fried implant, cursed drone — same price.

P_dex_place_2.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_place_2.text: This stall's held together with tape and spite. Like most of Neon.

P_dex_you_wary.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_you_wary.text: Broken something? No? Then you're in the way.

P_dex_you_acquaintance.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_you_acquaintance.text: You bring me weird parts. I like weird parts.

P_dex_you_friend.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_you_friend.text: You're the only customer who asks what I did instead of what it costs.

P_dex_you_close.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_you_close.text: That implant I don't talk about? I'll show you. Nobody else. Don't be weird about it.

P_dex_news_start.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_news_start.text: Syndicate's buying up every rift-touched part in Neon. I'm hiding mine.

P_dex_news_allied.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain's people bought thirty comms units. Paid full price. I didn't know how to react.

P_dex_news_masks.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_news_masks.text: The masks had cheap transmitters. Syndicate stock. I've got six on the bench.

P_dex_news_unbound.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_news_unbound.text: Pulled a log off a Syndicate relay. Your companion's name's in it. Older than the Fracture. I didn't say that.

P_dex_news_kept.speaker: DEX OKORO
P_dex_news_kept.text: The queue's shorter. The parts are cleaner. I'm almost out of excuses.

P_lin_fracture_1.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_fracture_1.text: The broth's been simmering since the Fracture. Never stopped. Neither have I.

P_lin_fracture_2.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_fracture_2.text: The night it hit I fed two hundred people for free. Some of them still come back and pay.

P_lin_place_1.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_place_1.text: Noodle stall, Neon Metro. Twenty years. The broth's older than the metro.

P_lin_place_2.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_place_2.text: Eat first. Whatever's chasing you can wait for noodles.

P_lin_you_acquaintance.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_you_acquaintance.text: You eat everything. Good. I don't trust people who leave broth.

P_lin_you_friend.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_you_friend.text: You're family now. Family eats first and pays later. Much later.

P_lin_you_close.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_you_close.text: If you ever need a place to be, this stall is it. Day or night. The broth's always on.

P_lin_news_start.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_news_start.text: Syndicate came for protection money. I gave them noodles. They left.

P_lin_news_allied.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_news_allied.text: A captain from Nexus ate here. Two bowls. Said nothing. Tipped well.

P_lin_news_masks.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_news_masks.text: The masked crowd came past the metro. I shouted at them. They moved. Masks don't like noodles.

P_lin_news_unbound.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_news_unbound.text: Someone says your companion was built in Nexus long ago. So was the metro. Both still work.

P_lin_news_kept.speaker: LIN YUE
P_lin_news_kept.text: Full stall every night. People talking, not whispering. That's the sound of a city.

P_rhea_fracture_1.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_fracture_1.text: I was off duty in the casino. The lights went purple and every alarm went off at once. I worked that night anyway.

P_rhea_fracture_2.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made Neon honest for one night. Then it was Neon again.

P_rhea_place_1.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_place_1.text: Neon beat. Casino Row to the metro. Every door's got a bribe behind it and I don't take them.

P_rhea_place_2.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_place_2.text: The Row at night's the most honest place in the city. Everyone's lying, so nobody's fooled.

P_rhea_you_wary.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_you_wary.text: Weapon stays holstered on the Row. That's not advice.

P_rhea_you_acquaintance.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_you_acquaintance.text: The operator. You've behaved. Keep behaving.

P_rhea_you_friend.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_you_friend.text: You're the only armed stranger in Neon I don't follow. Take that as the compliment it is.

P_rhea_you_close.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_you_close.text: If the Syndicate ever comes for you, I'll be there before they are. That's not in my job description.

P_rhea_news_start.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_news_start.text: The Syndicate's got a new boss. The old one's 'retired'. Nobody's found him.

P_rhea_news_allied.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_news_allied.text: Nexus sent a captain to coordinate. Straight as a rail. The Row doesn't know what to do with her.

P_rhea_news_masks.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_news_masks.text: Masks on the Row. Syndicate stock. I've filed it. It'll go nowhere. I filed it anyway.

P_rhea_news_unbound.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_news_unbound.text: The Syndicate's asking about your companion. Loudly. Watch your back on the Row.

P_rhea_news_kept.speaker: OFFICER RHEA BANKS
P_rhea_news_kept.text: Fewer calls. Fewer bodies. The Row's still the Row, but quieter.

P_marco_fracture_1.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_fracture_1.text: Twenty years in Neon. The Fracture's the only thing that ever surprised me. Took about a minute.

P_marco_fracture_2.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_fracture_2.text: The Fracture didn't change Neon. Neon was already broken. It just lit it better.

P_marco_place_1.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_place_1.text: This beat's a joke. The Row, the metro, the casino. Everybody's guilty; I just pick who's guilty today.

P_marco_place_2.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_place_2.text: I like the metro steps. Good view of everyone pretending not to see me.

P_marco_you_acquaintance.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_you_acquaintance.text: The operator. Not in my notebook yet. That's a good place to not be.

P_marco_you_friend.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_you_friend.text: You're all right. Neon doesn't do all right. Enjoy it.

P_marco_you_close.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_you_close.text: You're the only one in this city I'd call if it mattered. Don't tell Rhea; she thinks it's her.

P_marco_news_start.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_news_start.text: Syndicate's recruiting kids off the Row. I move them on. They come back.

P_marco_news_allied.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain's running joint patrols. Paperwork's doubled. Arrests have too. Fine.

P_marco_news_masks.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_news_masks.text: The masks were Syndicate. Everyone knows. Nobody says. I said. Nobody listened.

P_marco_news_unbound.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_news_unbound.text: Your companion's name's on a Syndicate buy list. Someone thinks it's worth money. Someone's going to try.

P_marco_news_kept.speaker: OFFICER MARCO DIAZ
P_marco_news_kept.text: A quiet Row. I've got nothing to do. I'm going to sit on the steps and hate it.

P_juno_fracture_1.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_fracture_1.text: I was in the undercity. The screens all showed the same face for a second. I've been trying to find it since.

P_juno_fracture_2.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_fracture_2.text: The Fracture rewrote the Neon grid. Somebody had to read it. It was me. I didn't want it to be.

P_juno_place_1.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_place_1.text: The undercity. Under the metro. Clean nodes, bad lighting, nobody looking. Perfect.

P_juno_place_2.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_place_2.text: Don't go past the third pillar. Not because of me. Because of what's past it.

P_juno_you_wary.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_you_wary.text: D-don't look at me. Look at the wall. Thanks.

P_juno_you_friend.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_you_friend.text: I pulled your feed off the Syndicate's grid. They see nothing. You're welcome.

P_juno_you_close.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_you_close.text: You're the only one who knows where I sleep. That's… that's trust. Don't waste it.

P_juno_news_start.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_news_start.text: Syndicate's scanning the undercity for implants. I'm hiding. It's going well. It's not going well.

P_juno_news_allied.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_news_allied.text: Nexus sent a captain. Her people don't scan the undercity. I checked. Twice.

P_juno_news_masks.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_news_masks.text: The masks had Syndicate transmitters. I counted them. Four hundred. Someone paid for a crowd.

P_juno_news_unbound.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_news_unbound.text: I saw the lab logs. NOVA. Pre-Fracture. Built to find someone. I didn't tell anyone. Except you.

P_juno_news_kept.speaker: JUNO PARK
P_juno_news_kept.text: The grid's quiet. I came up for air. The sky's fine. I went back down. Baby steps.

P_silas_fracture_1.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_fracture_1.text: The night the sky cracked, the house lost for the first time in thirty years. Rift-roulette. Someone won big and vanished.

P_silas_fracture_2.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_fracture_2.text: The Fracture is the only thing I have ever seen beat the house. I do not intend to let it happen twice.

P_silas_place_1.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_place_1.text: Neon Crown. The floor is mine. Every table, every camera, every tell.

P_silas_place_2.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_place_2.text: The house always wins. Lately the house has been nervous. The house does not get nervous.

P_silas_you_wary.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_you_wary.text: The tables are for guests. Are you a guest?

P_silas_you_acquaintance.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_you_acquaintance.text: The operator. You do not gamble. I find that suspicious and admirable.

P_silas_you_friend.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_you_friend.text: You are welcome on my floor. Few are. Fewer deserve it.

P_silas_you_close.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_you_close.text: The private room is yours whenever you need to not be seen. No questions. No charge. That is unheard of.

P_silas_news_start.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_news_start.text: The Syndicate has new management. New management wants a percentage. I am negotiating.

P_silas_news_allied.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain toured the floor. She counted the exits. So do I.

P_silas_news_masks.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_news_masks.text: Masks on the Row. Syndicate theatre. I closed the floor for an hour. It cost me. It would have cost more.

P_silas_news_unbound.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_news_unbound.text: There is a buyer asking about your companion. The price is high. The buyer is not Syndicate. That worries me more.

P_silas_news_kept.speaker: SILAS CRANE
P_silas_news_kept.text: The floor is calm. The house wins again. I am almost disappointed.

P_tasha_fracture_1.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_fracture_1.text: Every car in the Neon garage started at once. Empty. I turned them off one by one. Took an hour. Loved it.

P_tasha_fracture_2.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_fracture_2.text: The Fracture's the best thing that ever happened to tuning. Rift static does things to a turbo.

P_tasha_place_1.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_place_1.text: Neon Mods, the garage side. Dealer's next door. I'm the one who makes it go.

P_tasha_place_2.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_place_2.text: This bay's mine. The one with the pink light. Don't ask about the pink light.

P_tasha_you_wary.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_you_wary.text: Need a tune? No? Then mind the hoist.

P_tasha_you_acquaintance.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_you_acquaintance.text: The operator! Your ride's got a rattle. I can hear it from here.

P_tasha_you_friend.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_you_friend.text: You're the only one who lets me do what I want to an engine. It shows.

P_tasha_you_close.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_you_close.text: I built you something. It's in the back. Don't tell the dealer; it's not on any list.

P_tasha_news_start.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_news_start.text: Syndicate wants a cut of every tune. I've started doing them at night.

P_tasha_news_allied.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain's people brought in six trucks. Fleet work! Steady money!

P_tasha_news_masks.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_news_masks.text: The masks blocked the garage for an hour. I tuned a car anyway. Nobody stops a tune.

P_tasha_news_unbound.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_news_unbound.text: Heard your ghost can see every camera on the loop. Ask it where the Syndicate parks.

P_tasha_news_kept.speaker: TASHA GREENE
P_tasha_news_kept.text: Garage is full, nobody's shooting, and I got the pink light fixed. Best week.

P_benny_fracture_1.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_fracture_1.text: I was on the metro when it hit. The train stopped. Then it kept going. Nobody was driving. I got off. Fast.

P_benny_fracture_2.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_fracture_2.text: The Fracture doubled my runs. Everyone wants everything now, and now's a bit later than it used to be.

P_benny_place_1.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_place_1.text: Neon Metro's my hub. Every line, every exit, every shortcut nobody's supposed to know.

P_benny_place_2.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_place_2.text: The Row's quick money, the undercity's quiet money, the metro's where I breathe.

P_benny_you_wary.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_you_wary.text: You in my lane? You're in my lane.

P_benny_you_acquaintance.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_you_acquaintance.text: Hey! The operator! You're fast, I've seen you.

P_benny_you_friend.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_you_friend.text: You and me, we're the fastest things in Neon that aren't on fire.

P_benny_you_close.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_you_close.text: Best person on the Row. I'd race you for the title but I'd lose and I know it.

P_benny_news_start.speaker: BENNY REYES
