P_benny_news_start.text: Syndicate's got runners on the Row. They're slow. They're armed. Slow and armed is a bad mix.

P_benny_news_allied.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain's people hired me for a run. Paid upfront. Who does that?

P_benny_news_masks.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_news_masks.text: The masks slowed me down ten minutes. Ten! I went through the undercity.

P_benny_news_unbound.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_news_unbound.text: Dex says your companion's in a Syndicate log. Dex says a lot. Dex is usually right.

P_benny_news_kept.speaker: BENNY REYES
P_benny_news_kept.text: Metro's running on time. On time! I've got nothing to complain about and it's weird.

P_ivy_fracture_1.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_fracture_1.text: Every cabinet in the arcade played itself. All night. High scores everywhere. I kept them. Felt right.

P_ivy_fracture_2.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_fracture_2.text: The Fracture gave Rift Runner its best level. It wasn't there before. Nobody coded it.

P_ivy_place_1.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_place_1.text: The arcade, Casino Row. Tokens, cabinets, one machine that eats every third coin. It's a feature.

P_ivy_place_2.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_place_2.text: High score on Rift Runner hasn't moved in a week. The name's 'NOVA'. Don't ask me.

P_ivy_you_wary.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_you_wary.text: Tokens are a Nex each! No, you can't have a free one.

P_ivy_you_acquaintance.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_you_acquaintance.text: Hey, the operator! You beat Rift Runner level three. Nobody beats three.

P_ivy_you_friend.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_you_friend.text: You're the only one who plays the broken cabinets. I think they like you.

P_ivy_you_close.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_you_close.text: I'll tell you the secret: the third-coin machine gives them back at midnight. Only to me. Now to you.

P_ivy_news_start.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_news_start.text: Syndicate wants the arcade for a 'meeting room'. Over my high scores.

P_ivy_news_allied.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain came in. Played one game. Won. Left. Terrifying.

P_ivy_news_masks.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_news_masks.text: The masks came in for a photo. I charged them. Tokens, each. Nobody argued.

P_ivy_news_unbound.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_news_unbound.text: The 'NOVA' high score just updated. It's higher. Nobody was at the cabinet.

P_ivy_news_kept.speaker: IVY CHEN
P_ivy_news_kept.text: Full arcade, every night. The broken cabinet fixed itself. I'm not asking.

P_moss_fracture_1.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_fracture_1.text: The sky's a screen, friend. The Fracture's a crack in the screen. I've said it for forty years. Now people listen.

P_moss_fracture_2.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_fracture_2.text: I saw the sky crack and I laughed. Not because it was funny. Because I was right.

P_moss_place_1.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_place_1.text: Casino Row. The loudest place in the world to say the quiet thing.

P_moss_place_2.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_place_2.text: I preach from the metro steps. The trains agree with me. Listen.

P_moss_you_wary.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_you_wary.text: Count the stars tonight. Then count them again.

P_moss_you_acquaintance.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_you_acquaintance.text: You again. You listen. Most walk. Listening's the first step.

P_moss_you_friend.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_you_friend.text: You've seen what's behind the screen. I can tell. We're the only two who have.

P_moss_you_close.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_you_close.text: When they switch the screen off, you'll be the one who notices. I'm glad. Somebody has to.

P_moss_news_start.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_news_start.text: The Syndicate thinks it runs Neon. The screen runs Neon. The Syndicate's just a pop-up.

P_moss_news_allied.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_news_allied.text: A captain from the wall came through. Honest eyes. The screen doesn't like honest eyes.

P_moss_news_masks.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_news_masks.text: Masks! Faces on faces! The screen laughed. I heard it.

P_moss_news_unbound.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_news_unbound.text: The voice in your ear is older than the crack. I told you. I told everyone. Now you know.

P_moss_news_kept.speaker: OLD MOSS
P_moss_news_kept.text: The crack's closed. The screen's still a screen. Don't forget. Nobody else will remember.

P_sable_fracture_1.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_fracture_1.text: The night the sky cracked, every camera in Neon went blind for nine seconds. I made more in those nine seconds than in the year before.

P_sable_fracture_2.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_fracture_2.text: The Fracture is a market. Everything else is a rumour about the market.

P_sable_place_1.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_place_1.text: Casino Row. Every shortcut has an owner. You are standing on mine.

P_sable_place_2.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_place_2.text: Neon City. Twenty-two million cameras. Nine of them are mine. The rest can be rented.

P_sable_you_wary.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_you_wary.text: Every camera sees you. Every camera can lie. Tonight they are saying you are nobody.

P_sable_you_acquaintance.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_you_acquaintance.text: You won on the loop. The Syndicate wants your name. I have not sold it. Yet.

P_sable_you_friend.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_you_friend.text: Weapons, vehicles, secrets. For you, slightly less than everything. That is as generous as I get.

P_sable_you_close.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_you_close.text: Thinking like you do is expensive. I have decided to invest.

P_sable_news_start.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_news_start.text: The Syndicate's new boss is buying rift-grade parts by the crate. Someone is building something.

P_sable_news_allied.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain is asking about me. I have told the cameras to show her a nice view of the harbor.

P_sable_news_masks.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_news_masks.text: The masks were a count. Four hundred transmitters. Someone wanted to know how many of you there are.

P_sable_news_unbound.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_news_unbound.text: The relay under the Aegis tower was pointed at your apartment eleven days before the Fracture. You already know. I just know who paid.

P_sable_news_kept.speaker: FIXER SABLE
P_sable_news_kept.text: The market is quiet. Prices are down. I find I do not mind. Do not tell anyone.

P_neri_fracture_1.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_fracture_1.text: I was airborne when the sky cracked. The instruments gave up. I did not. That is the whole of flying.

P_neri_fracture_2.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the air routes unstable. I fly them anyway. Engineering, stubbornness, a little luck.

P_neri_place_1.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_place_1.text: Thalassia's air terminal. Seaplanes for the hops, a submersible for the deep. I fly the first and hum through the second.

P_neri_place_2.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_place_2.text: Thalassia sits deeper than most maps admit. The maps are being modest.

P_neri_you_acquaintance.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_you_acquaintance.text: We are crossing between continents. Strap in and say nothing clever.

P_neri_you_friend.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_you_friend.text: You jumped out of my aircraft once. I have forgiven you. I have not forgotten.

P_neri_you_close.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_you_close.text: I would fly you through the seam itself if you asked. Please do not ask.

P_neri_news_start.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_news_start.text: Currents are restless under the dome. The shadow in the lane has been seen twice this week.

P_neri_news_allied.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain is asking for flights to the Isles. I have told her the weather. The weather is me.

P_neri_news_masks.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_news_masks.text: The surface has masks in its plazas. The dome has kelp. I prefer the kelp.

P_neri_news_unbound.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_news_unbound.text: The archive says your companion was built before the first Fracture. The Archivist says it with respect. That is rare.

P_neri_news_kept.speaker: PILOT NERI
P_neri_news_kept.text: Clear skies between continents. I did not think I would say that again.

P_coral_fracture_1.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_fracture_1.text: I was at forty metres when it hit. The light went violet. I surfaced into a cracked sky. Best dive ever. Worst.

P_coral_fracture_2.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the deep sing. You can hear it through the hull. I like it. The others don't.

P_coral_place_1.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_place_1.text: Thalassia port, the diver's locker. Pressure seals, locked. Lights, violet past forty. Don't look up.

P_coral_place_2.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_place_2.text: The dome's the only city where the ceiling's the ocean and nobody minds.

P_coral_you_wary.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_you_wary.text: Keep the seal locked till the chamber's clear. Please. For me.

P_coral_you_acquaintance.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_you_acquaintance.text: The surface walker! You held the port while the dock cycled. I saw.

P_coral_you_friend.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_you_friend.text: You're the only surfacer who doesn't panic at violet. I've decided that means something.

P_coral_you_close.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_you_close.text: I'll take you to the deep lane. Where the shadow lives. Nobody else. Say the word.

P_coral_news_start.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_news_start.text: The shadow in the lane's circling more. The Archivist says it's listening. To what?

P_coral_news_allied.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_news_allied.text: Pilot Neri's running more flights to the surface. Something's coordinating up there.

P_coral_news_masks.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_news_masks.text: Surface news: masks in the Nexus plaza. Down here we just have fish. Prefer it.

P_coral_news_unbound.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_news_unbound.text: The archive found a record with your companion's name. Pre-Fracture. The Archivist went quiet for a day.

P_coral_news_kept.speaker: CORAL ADEYEMI
P_coral_news_kept.text: The lane's calm. The shadow's gone deep. The dome's lights stopped flickering. I miss the singing a bit.

P_mae_fracture_1.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_fracture_1.text: The ferry was mid-crossing when it hit. The sea went still. Flat. Then it remembered. We made the dome.

P_mae_fracture_2.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_fracture_2.text: The Fracture is a tide. It goes out. It comes in. You learn the hours.

P_mae_place_1.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_place_1.text: Ferry agent, Thalassia port. Next boat to the dome on the hour, weather permitting. Weather rarely permits.

P_mae_place_2.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_place_2.text: Seasick bags are free. Use them. The crossing's honest about what it is.

P_mae_you_wary.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_you_wary.text: Ticket? No? Then step back from the rail, love.

P_mae_you_acquaintance.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_you_acquaintance.text: The surfacer. You held the dock. The whole port talks about it.

P_mae_you_friend.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_you_friend.text: You're the only passenger who's never used a bag. I'm impressed and a little suspicious.

P_mae_you_close.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_you_close.text: Front of the queue, every crossing. I've told the crew. Don't make me wave at you.

P_mae_news_start.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_news_start.text: Crossings are down to two a day. The shadow in the lane's got the captains nervous.

P_mae_news_allied.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain booked passage. In writing. We don't get 'in writing' down here.

P_mae_news_masks.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_news_masks.text: Surface news comes down slow. Masks in a plaza, they say. Sounds like a surface problem.

P_mae_news_unbound.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_news_unbound.text: The Archivist's been asking about your companion. Politely. She's always polite. It's unnerving.

P_mae_news_kept.speaker: MAE OKONJO
P_mae_news_kept.text: Four crossings a day again. Calm sea. The captains are bored. Good.

P_rook_fracture_1.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_fracture_1.text: The storm came the day the sky cracked and it never left. Out here that's just weather now.

P_rook_fracture_2.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_fracture_2.text: Sand gets into everything. The Fracture got into the sand. Work it out.

P_rook_place_1.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_place_1.text: Solara garage. Dune Gate's that way, the Ribcage past it. Don't go to the Ribcage.

P_rook_place_2.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_place_2.text: This is the only shade for twenty miles. I sell it by the hour. For you, the day.

P_rook_you_wary.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_you_wary.text: I can fix it. The bill might hurt more than the crash.

P_rook_you_acquaintance.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_you_acquaintance.text: You won the convoy run in a storm, in that. I'm still annoyed about it.

P_rook_you_friend.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_you_friend.text: More than you have, usually. For you, we negotiate. Don't tell the racers.

P_rook_you_close.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_you_close.text: There's a car in the back bay. It's yours. I built it. Don't say anything; the front end's listening.

P_rook_news_start.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_news_start.text: Raiders hit a convoy past the mesas. The storm got them first. The storm's on nobody's side.

P_rook_news_allied.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain wants trucks that'll cross the dunes. I told her the trucks are fine. The drivers aren't.

P_rook_news_masks.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_news_masks.text: News from the cities: masks, crowds, politics. Out here the sand doesn't care what you wear.

P_rook_news_unbound.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_news_unbound.text: Your companion talked to my truck's radio last night. Fixed a fault I've chased for a year. Didn't ask. Didn't say thanks.

P_rook_news_kept.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
P_rook_news_kept.text: Storm's calmer. Convoys are through. I've got time to fix my own truck. First time in a year.

P_zahra_fracture_1.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_fracture_1.text: The caravan was three days out when the sky cracked. We saw it from the dunes. We kept walking. What else?

P_zahra_fracture_2.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made water the only currency. I sell water. Draw your own conclusions.

P_zahra_place_1.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_place_1.text: Solara terminal, the trader's row. Water first, stories second, everything else third.

P_zahra_place_2.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_place_2.text: Shade costs extra. Everything costs extra. This is the desert.

P_zahra_you_wary.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_you_wary.text: Water's two Nex. Stories are free. Pick one.

P_zahra_you_acquaintance.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_you_acquaintance.text: The convoy winner! Rook's still complaining. It's wonderful.

P_zahra_you_friend.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_you_friend.text: You're the only customer who pays for shade. I've started giving it free. Don't tell.

P_zahra_you_close.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_you_close.text: Family rate. Water, shade, the good dates. You've earned the dates.

P_zahra_news_start.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_news_start.text: The caravan's late. Sandstorm or raiders. Either way, prices go up.

P_zahra_news_allied.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain's buying water by the truck. For a district. I asked which. She said 'mine'.

P_zahra_news_masks.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_news_masks.text: Cities have masks. Deserts have sand. The sand's more honest.

P_zahra_news_unbound.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_news_unbound.text: Old traders say your companion is older than the Fracture. Out here, old things that still work are worth more than water.

P_zahra_news_kept.speaker: ZAHRA HADDAD
P_zahra_news_kept.text: Caravans on time. Water's cheaper. I'm making less. I don't mind. Write that down; it won't last.

P_idris_fracture_1.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_fracture_1.text: Every panel on the array lit up purple. Fed the grid at ten times rating. For a minute. Then they sulked for a week.

P_idris_fracture_2.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the sun louder. The arrays hear it. I clean them at dawn so they can listen.

P_idris_place_1.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_place_1.text: The solar fields. Every panel feeds the city; every grain of sand fights it. I'm the referee.

P_idris_place_2.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_place_2.text: We clean the arrays at dawn. You're welcome to help. It's beautiful. It's also miserable.

P_idris_you_wary.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_you_wary.text: Mind the cables. Mind the panels. Mind everything, actually.

P_idris_you_acquaintance.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_you_acquaintance.text: The operator! You cleaned a panel once. Badly. I was touched.

P_idris_you_friend.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_you_friend.text: The arrays like you. I don't know how I know. They sing a bit when you're near.

P_idris_you_close.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_you_close.text: Dawn tomorrow, the north array. I'll show you what the sun sounds like. Nobody else gets that.

P_idris_news_start.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_news_start.text: Raiders cut the east cable. Again. I fixed it. Again. We're in a rhythm.

P_idris_news_allied.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain wants panels for the bastion. I sent forty. She sent a thank-you. Nobody sends those.

P_idris_news_masks.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_news_masks.text: The cities have their crowds. The arrays have the sun. I know which I'd rather read.

P_idris_news_unbound.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_news_unbound.text: The arrays sang when the Nexus lab opened. Across the whole continent. Your companion's in that song.

P_idris_news_kept.speaker: IDRIS BELLO
P_idris_news_kept.text: Full output, no storms, clean arrays. The sun's singing in tune.

P_kest_fracture_1.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_fracture_1.text: The glacier moved the day the sky cracked. Glaciers do not move in a day. This one did.

P_kest_fracture_2.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_fracture_2.text: The storm does not kill you quickly. It convinces you to stop moving. The Fracture taught it that.

P_kest_place_1.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_place_1.text: Frostveil, the lower camp. The glacier's up. The caverns are in. The summit's for people who've stopped listening.

P_kest_place_2.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_place_2.text: Check your heat pack before your weapon. Every time. The cold doesn't care about your aim.

P_kest_you_wary.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_you_wary.text: Whoever sent you should be careful.

P_kest_you_acquaintance.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_you_acquaintance.text: You climbed to the caverns in my prints. Every one. Good.

P_kest_you_friend.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_you_friend.text: That answer is why I agreed to guide you. I don't guide twice.

P_kest_you_close.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_you_close.text: The crew we pulled out of the crown. Nine people. They ask about you. I tell them you'll come.

P_kest_news_start.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_news_start.text: A research team went silent on the north glacier. I'm going to look. Don't follow.

P_kest_news_allied.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain asked for a route over the pass. I gave her the honest one. She thanked me for the honesty.

P_kest_news_masks.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_news_masks.text: Cities and their masks. Up here the storm's the only mask and it fits everyone.

P_kest_news_unbound.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_news_unbound.text: The crown's log named your companion. The crew remembers it. Older than the storm.

P_kest_news_kept.speaker: RANGER KEST
P_kest_news_kept.text: The glacier's still. Properly still. First time since the sky. I don't trust it. I'm enjoying it.

P_anya_fracture_1.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_fracture_1.text: I was in the terminal when it hit. The snow outside turned violet. I took a photo. I don't look at it.

P_anya_fracture_2.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_fracture_2.text: The Fracture delayed my flight by a year. I stopped counting. I started walking.

P_anya_place_1.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_place_1.text: Frostveil terminal. My flight's delayed. It's been delayed three times. I've made friends with the chairs.

P_anya_place_2.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_place_2.text: The lights in the ice are beautiful. That worries me. Beautiful things up here usually want something.

P_anya_you_wary.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_you_wary.text: Are you… from the airline? No? Oh. Okay.

P_anya_you_acquaintance.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_you_acquaintance.text: Oh! It's you! You came back from the caverns. Everyone said nobody does.

P_anya_you_friend.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_you_friend.text: You're the only person in this terminal who isn't waiting for something. It's… calming.

P_anya_you_close.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_you_close.text: If my flight ever leaves, I'm not going. I decided. Don't ask why. You know why.

P_anya_news_start.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_news_start.text: The ranger went up the north glacier alone. The whole terminal's pretending not to watch the door.

P_anya_news_allied.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain came through on a transport. She looked at the ice and didn't flinch. Everyone flinches.

P_anya_news_masks.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_news_masks.text: Surface news on the terminal screens. Masks. Crowds. It looks warm, at least.

P_anya_news_unbound.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_news_unbound.text: The ice sang when the crown came down. The glaciologist cried. I cried too. Don't tell him.

P_anya_news_kept.speaker: ANYA VOLKOVA
P_anya_news_kept.text: My flight's boarding. Actually boarding. I'm not getting on. I'm staying. Hi.

P_lars_fracture_1.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_fracture_1.text: The ice is singing at a frequency it shouldn't. Started the day the sky cracked. I've recorded every note.

P_lars_fracture_2.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_fracture_2.text: Forty years studying glaciers. These ones are studying me back. The Fracture introduced us.

P_lars_place_1.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_place_1.text: Frostveil research, the terminal lab. Ice cores, seismographs, a kettle that's older than the station.

P_lars_place_2.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_place_2.text: The summit array's a machine. Was a machine. Is a machine again. I've stopped using tenses.

P_lars_you_wary.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_you_wary.text: Don't touch the cores. Don't breathe on the cores. Stand… there.

P_lars_you_acquaintance.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_you_acquaintance.text: The operator! The ice changed key when you arrived. I have it on tape.

P_lars_you_friend.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_you_friend.text: You're the only one who listens to the recordings all the way through. All forty hours. Twice.

P_lars_you_close.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_you_close.text: I've named a frequency after you. It's the one the ice sings when it's calm. Don't be modest; it's science.

P_lars_news_start.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_news_start.text: The north glacier's singing a distress call. Eighteen seconds, looping. I've sent the ranger.

P_lars_news_allied.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain asked for my data. All of it. I gave it. Someone should have it who'll act.

P_lars_news_masks.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_news_masks.text: The cities and their masks. The ice has no face. I find that restful.

P_lars_news_unbound.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_news_unbound.text: The crown's log: nineteen years of memory. One of them belongs to your companion. I've archived it. Respectfully.

P_lars_news_kept.speaker: LARS HOLM
P_lars_news_kept.text: The ice is singing in tune. Calm, slow, low. I've recorded it. I'll play it at my funeral. Not soon.

P_draev_fracture_1.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_fracture_1.text: The war ended the week before the sky cracked. The Fracture reopened every grave. I have been closing them since.

P_draev_fracture_2.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_fracture_2.text: The Fracture is a wound in a land built from wounds. We know how to dress it. Slowly.

P_draev_place_1.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_place_1.text: Obsidian Reach. Every ridge is a battlefield nobody cleared. My people live between the craters.

P_draev_place_2.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_place_2.text: The Ash Outpost. The line. Everything past it was somebody's and is now the Reach's.

P_draev_you_wary.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_you_wary.text: Not all disagreements survive the first shot.

P_draev_you_acquaintance.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_you_acquaintance.text: You held fire on the ones who ran. Most hear that as a suggestion.

P_draev_you_friend.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_you_friend.text: Now you ask the right question. Keep asking it.

P_draev_you_close.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_you_close.text: Peace is a discipline, not a holiday. You keep it. So do we. The Accord stands.

P_draev_news_start.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_news_start.text: Raiders from the wastes, armed with Syndicate money. The ruins will burn unless someone stands.

P_draev_news_allied.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_news_allied.text: The Nexus captain and I have spoken. She counts her people. I respect anyone who counts.

P_draev_news_masks.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_news_masks.text: Masks in the Nexus plaza. Here we have no masks. We know every face. That is worse and better.

P_draev_news_unbound.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_news_unbound.text: Your companion's origin is known to the Reach. We fought beside its makers once. We do not speak of it.

P_draev_news_kept.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
P_draev_news_kept.text: The ridges are quiet. The craters are being filled. My people are planting. Planting.

P_ruth_fracture_1.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_fracture_1.text: I was on the line when it hit. The old battlefield lit up. Every crater. I've never seen the dead so bright.

P_ruth_fracture_2.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the night louder. The battlefields hum. You learn to sleep through it. You don't.

P_ruth_place_1.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_place_1.text: The Ash Outpost. The marshal's line. Stay inside the lights after dark; the craters get ideas.

P_ruth_place_2.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_place_2.text: Every crater out there has a name. We say them at the gate at dusk. All of them.

P_ruth_you_acquaintance.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_you_acquaintance.text: The one who held the left flank at the ruins. Fine work. Don't let it go to your head.

P_ruth_you_friend.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_you_friend.text: You're the only outsider the marshal's let past the line twice. Don't waste it.

P_ruth_you_close.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_you_close.text: If the line ever breaks, I want you on it. That's the highest thing I say to anyone.

P_ruth_news_start.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_news_start.text: Raiders probing the ruins every night. Syndicate weapons. Someone's paying for a war.

P_ruth_news_allied.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_news_allied.text: The Nexus captain's people drilled with us. They're soft. They're learning. Fast.

P_ruth_news_masks.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_news_masks.text: Masks in the cities. Here you take your helmet off at the gate so we see your face. No exceptions.

P_ruth_news_unbound.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_news_unbound.text: Your companion's makers fought here once. The marshal won't say more. I've stopped asking.

P_ruth_news_kept.speaker: CORPORAL RUTH MBEKI
P_ruth_news_kept.text: A night without the hum. A whole night. I slept. I dreamed of nothing. It was perfect.

P_gus_fracture_1.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_fracture_1.text: Twelve hours down the shaft when it hit. The obsidian glowed. Foreman said don't look. I looked. I'm fine. Mostly.

P_gus_fracture_2.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the deep veins sing. We mine quieter now. Out of respect. Out of fear. Same thing.

P_gus_place_1.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_place_1.text: The obsidian mines, past the outpost. Twelve-hour shifts, gloves that last a day, veins that glow.

P_gus_place_2.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_place_2.text: The ancient forge is down there somewhere. We don't dig toward it. We don't dig away from it either.

P_gus_you_wary.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_you_wary.text: Mind the edge. Obsidian cuts gloves like paper. Skin like nothing.

P_gus_you_acquaintance.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_you_acquaintance.text: The operator. You went down the shaft and came back up. Not everyone does.

P_gus_you_friend.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_you_friend.text: You're the only one who's asked what the veins sound like. I'll show you. Bring gloves.

P_gus_you_close.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_you_close.text: There's a piece of the deep vein in my locker. It's yours. It's warm. It's always warm.

P_gus_news_start.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_news_start.text: The deep veins are glowing brighter. Foreman says don't look. We're all looking.

P_gus_news_allied.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_news_allied.text: The Nexus captain wants obsidian for armour. Good armour. Bad for gloves.

P_gus_news_masks.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_news_masks.text: Masks in the cities. Down the shaft we wear masks for the dust. Different thing. Same face underneath.

P_gus_news_unbound.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_news_unbound.text: The forge woke when the Nexus lab opened. Across the continent. Your companion's in the song. The veins said so.

P_gus_news_kept.speaker: GUS VARGA
P_gus_news_kept.text: The veins are glowing soft. Steady. Safe to look. First time. I looked for an hour.

P_kiri_fracture_1.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_fracture_1.text: Every cargo scale on the dock read zero the second it hit. Everything weightless. Then everything heavy. I lost a crate to the sea.

P_kiri_fracture_2.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the eastern seam. The seam makes crosswinds. The crosswinds make my job interesting.

P_kiri_place_1.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_place_1.text: Azure Isles cargo dock. Seaplanes for the hops, big jets for the mainland. Nothing flies free.

P_kiri_place_2.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_place_2.text: The sky dock's past the signal spire. Don't go near the spire. It's listening.

P_kiri_you_wary.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_you_wary.text: Cargo? No cargo, no dock. Rules.

P_kiri_you_acquaintance.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_you_acquaintance.text: The one who held the sky dock. Neri still swears about it. Fondly.

P_kiri_you_friend.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_you_friend.text: You're the only passenger who's helped unload. I've decided that's worth a seat.

P_kiri_you_close.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_you_close.text: Any flight, any hop, you're cargo-rated. That's a joke. It's also true.

P_kiri_news_start.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_news_start.text: The seam's wider. Crosswinds doubled. Two hops cancelled. Hope's not cargo but it's getting heavy.

P_kiri_news_allied.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_news_allied.text: The Nexus captain wants a supply route to the mainland. I've got the planes. She's got the nerve.

P_kiri_news_masks.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_news_masks.text: Mainland's got masks and crowds. The Isles have wind and fish. Fish are leaving. That's our news.

P_kiri_news_unbound.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_news_unbound.text: The spire's log named your companion. The spire's been quiet since. I don't trust quiet spires.

P_kiri_news_kept.speaker: KIRI TANE
P_kiri_news_kept.text: Seam's closed. Crosswinds gone. The fish came back. The resorts are full. I've got no complaints and it's unsettling.

P_leilani_fracture_1.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_fracture_1.text: The resort pool went purple. The guests kept swimming. I handed out towels. That's hospitality.

P_leilani_fracture_2.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the sunsets better. I'm not supposed to say that. The guests say it for me.

P_leilani_place_1.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_place_1.text: Welcome to the Isles! Shuttles to every resort from the kerb. Sunset cruise at six. Bring a jacket.

P_leilani_place_2.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_place_2.text: The sky dock's the only ugly thing on the island and we've made it a viewpoint.

P_leilani_you_wary.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_you_wary.text: Welcome! Are you… checking in? No? Still welcome!

P_leilani_you_acquaintance.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_you_acquaintance.text: The operator! You held the sky dock. Neri told everyone. Loudly.

P_leilani_you_friend.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_you_friend.text: You're the only guest who tips the shuttle driver. He's named a route after you.

P_leilani_you_close.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_you_close.text: The sunset cruise? Yours. Any night. I'll be at the rail. Don't make it a thing.

P_leilani_news_start.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_news_start.text: The resorts are full. The fish are leaving. The guests haven't noticed. I have.

P_leilani_news_allied.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain booked a room. Didn't use the pool. Used the viewpoint. Twice.

P_leilani_news_masks.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_news_masks.text: Mainland news: masks. We did a masked gala. Then we heard the news. We un-masked.

P_leilani_news_unbound.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_news_unbound.text: The spire went quiet. The whole island exhaled. Something about your companion. Neri knows.

P_leilani_news_kept.speaker: LEILANI KAHALE
P_leilani_news_kept.text: Full resorts, calm seam, fish back. Best season. I'm taking a day off. A whole day.

P_sol_fracture_1.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_fracture_1.text: I was out past the reef when the sky cracked. The fish stopped. All of them. Hung there. Then they ran.

P_sol_fracture_2.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_fracture_2.text: Forty years on these waters. The Fracture's the only thing that ever made them swim in circles.

P_sol_place_1.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_place_1.text: Azure Isles, the fishing dock. My boat's the blue one. The paint's older than the resort.

P_sol_place_2.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_place_2.text: Past the reef's the seam. Don't fish there. The fish don't.

P_sol_you_acquaintance.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_you_acquaintance.text: The one from the sky dock. You can tie a knot. I saw. Rare.

P_sol_you_friend.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_you_friend.text: You're the only one who comes to the dock just to sit. I like that. The sea likes that.

P_sol_you_close.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_you_close.text: Dawn, any morning. The blue boat. We'll go past the reef. I've never taken anyone past the reef.

P_sol_news_start.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_news_start.text: Fish are swimming in circles. Never seen it. Forty years.

P_sol_news_allied.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_news_allied.text: The Nexus captain bought my whole catch. For a district. Paid fair. Nobody pays fair.

P_sol_news_masks.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_news_masks.text: Mainland's got masks. The sea doesn't care what's on your face. Only what's in your net.

P_sol_news_unbound.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_news_unbound.text: The spire went quiet and the fish came back. Same hour. Your companion did that. Don't ask me how I know.

P_sol_news_kept.speaker: SOL NAVARRO
P_sol_news_kept.text: Nets full. Sea calm. Seam closed. I'm an old man and I'm happy. Write that down.

P_wanderer_fracture_1.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_fracture_1.text: The Fracture did not break the world. It woke it. The world has been answering ever since.

P_wanderer_fracture_2.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_fracture_2.text: I walked this coast before the sky cracked. The road remembered me. Now it remembers you.

P_wanderer_place_1.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_place_1.text: The Shattered Reefs. The drift, the vault, the spire, the deep. Eighteen things live here that are not on any map.

P_wanderer_place_2.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_place_2.text: This coast. Nothing marked. Everything watched.

P_wanderer_you_wary.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_you_wary.text: You cannot force a legend to notice you.

P_wanderer_you_acquaintance.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_you_acquaintance.text: The road remembers every traveler. It has started remembering you.

P_wanderer_you_friend.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_you_friend.text: The world has begun answering your actions. Listen to what it says.

P_wanderer_you_close.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_you_close.text: Some doors open for strength. Others for restraint. You have learned both. Few do.

P_wanderer_news_start.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_news_start.text: An expedition came back with one more member than it left with. Nobody asked who.

P_wanderer_news_allied.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_news_allied.text: A captain from the cities walked the drift. She marked nothing. I was surprised.

P_wanderer_news_masks.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_news_masks.text: The cities wear masks. The reefs wear tide. The tide is older.

P_wanderer_news_unbound.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_news_unbound.text: Your companion was built to find a host. It found a person instead. The world noticed that before you did.

P_wanderer_news_kept.speaker: THE WANDERER
P_wanderer_news_kept.text: The eighteen are quiet. Watching. The world is still answering. Keep walking.

P_brann_fracture_1.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_fracture_1.text: I was leading a group through the canyons when it hit. The crystals rang. Two people turned back. I didn't.

P_brann_fracture_2.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the badlands honest. The crystals ring when somebody lies near them. Try it.

P_brann_place_1.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_place_1.text: Crystal Badlands expedition post. Reinforced strip, reinforced boots, reinforced nerves. All three.

P_brann_place_2.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_place_2.text: Nobody goes past the rifts without me. Nobody comes back past them without me either.

P_brann_you_acquaintance.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_you_acquaintance.text: The operator. You crossed the prism fields. Alone. I'm annoyed and impressed.

P_brann_you_friend.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_you_friend.text: You're the only one who's come back from the rifts with the same number of people. Including you.

P_brann_you_close.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_you_close.text: The deep canyon. Nobody's been. I'll take you. We'll be the first. Or the last. Either's fine.

P_brann_news_start.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_news_start.text: Something in the rifts has come up to look. It's not hostile. It's attentive. That's worse.

P_brann_news_allied.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain asked for a crossing. I said the crystals would ring if she lied. She didn't blink.

P_brann_news_masks.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_news_masks.text: Cities and masks. Try wearing a mask near a crystal. It rings for an hour.

P_brann_news_unbound.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_news_unbound.text: The crystals rang when the Nexus lab opened. Every one. Your companion's name is in the ringing.

P_brann_news_kept.speaker: BRANN HALE
P_brann_news_kept.text: The rifts are calm. The crystals ring low. The badlands have decided you're honest. Don't disappoint them.

P_ines_fracture_1.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_fracture_1.text: My readings went off every scale the second it hit. I've had to invent new scales. Three of them.

P_ines_fracture_2.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_fracture_2.text: The Fracture gave me a specimen case I'm not allowed to open. I'm not allowed. I open it. Don't tell.

P_ines_place_1.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_place_1.text: The rift research post, Crystal Badlands. Please don't touch the specimen case. Please.

P_ines_place_2.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_place_2.text: The spire's a mile that way. It's the cleanest signal in the world and I can't read it.

P_ines_you_wary.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_you_wary.text: D-don't touch that. Or that. Or… just stand still, please.

P_ines_you_acquaintance.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_you_acquaintance.text: Oh! The operator! The readings spiked when you came in. Good spike. I think.

P_ines_you_friend.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_you_friend.text: You're the only one who asks what the numbers mean instead of whether they're dangerous. They're both.

P_ines_you_close.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_you_close.text: The specimen case. I'll show you what's in it. I've never shown anyone. It… it's beautiful. And it knows your name.

P_ines_news_start.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_news_start.text: The rifts are reading higher every night. Something's coming up to look. I'm not sleeping.

P_ines_news_allied.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain asked for my data. I gave her the third scale. She understood it. Nobody understands the third scale.

P_ines_news_masks.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_news_masks.text: Masks in the cities. The crystals would ring at a mask. That's… actually that's a good experiment.

P_ines_news_unbound.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_news_unbound.text: The readings have a signature now. NOVA's. Pre-Fracture. I've known for a week. I'm sorry I didn't say.

P_ines_news_kept.speaker: INES MOREAU
P_ines_news_kept.text: The readings are flat. Calm. I've invented a fourth scale for calm. It's my favourite.

P_ilya_fracture_1.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_fracture_1.text: The forest screamed the day the sky cracked. Every tree. I have not stopped hearing it.

P_ilya_fracture_2.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_fracture_2.text: The Fracture woke the roots. They have been moving since. We walk where they allow.

P_ilya_place_1.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_place_1.text: The grotto. The Warden's camp. The forest around it listens, so speak the truth or speak softly.

P_ilya_place_2.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_place_2.text: The living roots lead to what was taken. Follow them. Do not force them.

P_ilya_you_wary.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_you_wary.text: The forest will not forgive another invasion. Nor will I.

P_ilya_you_acquaintance.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_you_acquaintance.text: Answers have a cost. You have paid one. There will be others.

P_ilya_you_friend.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_you_friend.text: Then you have an ally here. The forest has heard me say it.

P_ilya_you_close.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_you_close.text: I hold you to every word. Gladly. The forest holds you too; that is rarer.

P_ilya_news_start.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_news_start.text: Outsiders took the heartwood. The trees took the outsiders. It is not finished.

P_ilya_news_allied.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_news_allied.text: A captain from Nexus walked the grove. She stayed on the moss. The forest let her.

P_ilya_news_masks.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_news_masks.text: The cities wear masks. The forest sees roots, not faces. It is not fooled.

P_ilya_news_unbound.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_news_unbound.text: Your companion's makers sought a host in this forest once. The forest refused them. It did not refuse you.

P_ilya_news_kept.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
P_ilya_news_kept.text: The forest is growing over the scars. Slowly. It remembers. It also forgives, slowly.

P_mira_fracture_1.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_fracture_1.text: I was in the canopy when it hit. The trees swayed with no wind. They've been swaying since. Softly.

P_mira_fracture_2.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_fracture_2.text: The Fracture made the paths change by dawn. I stopped marking them. I started remembering.

P_mira_place_1.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_place_1.text: The north grove. The elder tree, the falls, the grotto. I know the paths today. Tomorrow I'll learn them again.

P_mira_place_2.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_place_2.text: Stay on the moss. The forest keeps count of what you break.

P_mira_you_wary.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_you_wary.text: That is how it catches you off guard.

P_mira_you_acquaintance.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_you_acquaintance.text: The forest remembers footsteps. Yours, now, too.

P_mira_you_friend.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_you_friend.text: You did not burn anything. That was the first test. You keep passing.

P_mira_you_close.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_you_close.text: You remember the paths without marking them. The forest sent me to the Reefs for you. It does not send people.

P_mira_news_start.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_news_start.text: Something moves under the old grove. The Warden says wait. I'm waiting. Loudly.

P_mira_news_allied.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_news_allied.text: A Nexus captain walked the grove in my prints. Every one. I nearly liked her.

P_mira_news_masks.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_news_masks.text: The cities wear masks. The forest would eat a mask. Slowly. Politely.

P_mira_news_unbound.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_news_unbound.text: The elder tree knows your companion's name. It said so. Trees don't say things. It said so.

P_mira_news_kept.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
P_mira_news_kept.text: The forest is growing around the scars. The paths stopped changing. I miss learning them. A little.
